Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens who hold a foreign passport and comply with the relevant regulations set by the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC ”; 2. Ages from 18 to 30 (based on the time point of September 1 of the year of enrollment), and have obtained high school diploma or above; 3. Are physically and mentally healthy; meet the physical examination requirements for Chinese Visa and Residence Permit in China as well as the physical examination requirements for BSU programs so as to ensure their study and life in China; 4. Have no record of discipline violation, public security punishment or criminal conduct; show respect towards China and behave well; comply with Chinese laws and university regulations, and respect Chinese customs; 5. Have passed HSK Level 4 or above.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Applications who are originally Chinese citizens and obtained foreign nationalities afterward should provide the following materials (1)Valid passport and a certificate before April 30, 2019, for the cancellation of their original registered residence in China and the renunciation of the Chinese nationality should be provided. (2)The entry and exit seal page of visiting China on the applicant's passport from April 30, 2019, to the time of application. (3)The proof of residence abroad of at least 2 years by April 30, 2019 (9 months of residence abroad per year may be considered as one year, subject to entry and exit signatures). 2. Applicants should provide the following materials if one of or both of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens (1)Certificate of the applicant obtaining foreign nationality at birth or afterward. (2)The nationality or household registration certificate of both of the applicant's parents (passport or ID card). (3)For applicants who obtained foreign nationality at birth, if one of or both of the parents are Chinese citizens and have the permanent residence abroad, a certificate of the corresponding permanent residence needs to be provided. If one of or both of the parents are Chinese citizens but have not obtained the permanent residence abroad, certificate of the withdrawal from Chinese nationality of the applicant needs to be provided. * 3. Original certificate of no criminal record (1) Applicants currently in China must provide a certificate of no criminal record in China issued by the local exit and entry administration department or public security organ; (2) Applicants who are not currently in China must provide a certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security administration. * 4. Certificate of HSK * 5. Passport information page (valid after September 30, 2023) * 6. Recent electronic photo (cap-free, 2-inch size, plain white background) * 7. The transcripts of all senior high school courses in original or as certified copy in Chinese or English * 8. The senior high school diploma Studying certificate issued by senior high school for applicants graduating from senior high school in the current year) in original or as certified copy in Chinese or English. 9. Applicants under 18 years old (until June 1, 2023) should provide a notarized guardianship letter valid in China is required The guardian of the student has to be living in Beijing at present and must have a source of income regardless their nationality is Chinese or not. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens, have graduated from high school, and be over the age of 18. 2. Nationality Requirements Comply with the provisions of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (MOE) Document No. 12 [2020] (Jiaowaihan) For applicants who are former residents of Chinese Mainland (the Chinese mainland), Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan and have immigrated to a foreign country, and now apply as international students: They must obtain a valid foreign passport or nationality certification document by April 30, 2022, provide proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality, and have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Acumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) For applicants who were born with foreign nationality (where either or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad): They must have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (A cumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) Note: If an applicant is confirmed by Chinese public security authorities to hold Chinese nationality during the application, admission, or after enrollment, their application qualification, admission qualification, enrollment qualification will be cancelled, or they will be dismissed from school. 3. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide the certificate of HSK 4 or above (200 or above). 4. Transcript of the "China Scholastic Competency Assessment"(CSCA Test). The specific test subjects are as follows:

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Southeast University has been authorized as one of the qualified universities in China to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine. The program pays much attention to training qualified international medical professionals, giving due consideration to the possible needs of them to serve in their motherland or other countries. Students who achieve the total required credits will be conferred diploma by Southeast University and qualified students will receive the Bachelor Degree of Medicine Science (M.B.B.S.). Graduates will be able to enroll for Physician Qualification Exam because of the relative regulations of the respective country. International students can also pursue the science and practice of medicine courses. According to “ Provisional Regulations on Quality Control Standards of English-Taught Medical Undergraduate Education for International Students in China ”，the Ministry of Education of China has approved Southeast University as one of the qualified universities in China to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine. To accelerate its step of internationalization, Southeast University will continue to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine in the fall-semester of 2010. The program aims to cultivate qualified international medical professionals, giving due consideration to the possible needs of them to serve in their motherland or other countries. After completing the total required credits, students will be conferred diploma by Southeast University and qualified students will receive the Bachelor Degree of Medicine Science (M.B.B.S.). Graduates will have the opportunity to enroll for Physician Qualification Exam according to the relative regulations of the respective country. Taught in English, the program is open to international students in pursuit of the science and practice of medicine, whose courses are offered by Medical College, SEU. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses and internships for international students. 2.1 Chinese culture and natural science courses China's culture Chinese language Chinese medical terminology Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biology Physical education It is required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively. 2.2 Basic Courses Basic medical sciences behavioral science humanities Social science and medical ethics Preventive medicine Clinical medicine It is also required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively. 2.3 Internship The internship will be arranged by the institutions meticulously and the duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks). The Chinese language course will be given during the whole undergraduate medical program in English to facilitate international students' learning and life in China and contact with patients in their medical practice. SEU is authorized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program can apply to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. For more details, please visit the Medical Licensing Examination Guide. 2.4 Other Fees About 6000RMB-8000RMB/year for one occupancy in a room of two occupancies Insurance: 800 RMB/year 2.5 Enrollment Procedure We will check all the application documents and consider the qualification of each applicant. The best of the candidates will be enrolled. 3. Internship Editor Notes: Students can choose to do the internship/training in China, their home country or any other country. ​ Students who want to do an internship in China can choose a hospital from 20 hospitals in Nanjing. Students should first pass the HSK Level 5; otherwise, the university will arrange a Chinese student as a translator to assist during the process. Students who want to do the internship in another country need to do a qualification evaluation on the hospital which student chooses. In the internship year, the tuition fee is still RMB 30,600 per year and the accommodation of students who do an internship in China will be arranged by the relative hospitals. 4. Degree Conferring Editor Notes: I nternational medical undergraduates will be granted a MBBS degree certificate. MBBS Degree : Those who abide by Chinese laws and the regulations of SEU will be conferred bachelor’s degree of medical science by SEU after they have completed all required academic credits and obtain the graduation certificate. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). Students have to pass the HSK 3 (New HSK 4) to get the diploma before graduation. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Southeast University has become a comprehensive university of high reputation. Southeast University (SEU) is one of the national key universities administered directly under the Ministry of Education of China. It is also one of the first universities accredited by the State Council to determine and approve the qualifications of professors, associate professors, and doctoral supervisors. It is also one of the universities of Project 211 and Program 985 that is financed by the central government to build as a world-class university , Learn More>> 6. Medical College Editor Notes: The College of Medicine has been an important base in the national medical education. Medical College wins a good reputation at home and abroad for its long history and high-quality education. More than 80 professors and 150 associate professors are in the faculty of the College of Medicine, including 30 doctoral supervisors and 200 master's supervisors, the majority of whom have the experience of studying infamous foreign medical schools and have obtained a Doctor's degree. There are 400,000 copies of books and 1500 kinds of foreign periodicals in the library. 19 hospitals are affiliated to the College of Medicine and more than 40 laboratory hospitals spread across the country. Overview of Medical College, SEU Medical College of Southeast University, originating from Nanjing Railway Medical College, whose origin can be traced back to the Medical College of the Central University founded in 1935, was merged to Southeast University in 2000. It enjoys its prestige home and abroad for its long history and high-quality education. College of Medicine, Southeast University (SEU), is located by the scenic Xuanwu Lake in Nanjing, a historic and cultural city of China, bordering Hunan Street, a national famous business street. The campus boasts beautiful sceneries all around the year. The College of Medicine has been an important base in the national medical education. In the past years, it has cultivated more than 20,000 graduates, including some academicians of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and other many noted medical experts home and abroad. College of Medicine, SEU is composed of School of Basic Medical Science, School of Clinical Medicine and School of Public Health. The College offers six Ph.D. programs, twenty-nine Master’s programs, one 7-year program for both Bachelor’s and Master’s degree and seven Bachelor’s programs. There are over 80 professors and 150 associate professors in the faculty of the College of Medicine, including 30 doctoral supervisors and 200 master’s supervisors, majority of whom have the experience of studying in famous foreign medical schools and have obtained Doctor’s degree. Additionally, there are 87 part-time professors and 226 associate professors in the attached hospitals and laboratory hospitals. With 193,000 sq. m. of modern teaching and laboratory buildings, gymnasiums and libraries, College of Medicine, SEU covers the total area of 263,000 sq. m. The libraries collect 400,000 copies of books and 1500 kinds of foreign periodicals. The Clinical Experimental Center, which is under construction, will facilitate the medical students with modern clinical techniques, by means of the simulative electronic patient system. There are 19 hospitals attached to College of Medicine, SEU, more than 40 laboratory hospitals spreading across the country. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy a wonderful life on the campus. Ceremony Experience of Chinese Culture Note: Once admitted, students are required to pay a deposit in advance. Only after the payment can you get JW202 Form.

fields.description: Program Description Core course descriptions * Marine Science and Ocean Uses Introduction to basic marine processes, selected ocean uses and their policy issues. The course focuses on the interplay of public policy and marine science with an emphasis on implications for policy, such as resources and energy extraction. Students will gain a basic understanding of the topics covered in the main sub-field of oceanography, an understanding of the scientific methodology and knowledge of how oceanographic information is applied in representative public debates. * Marine Resources Economics The principles and application of economics to the management of marine resources, and conflicts and problems which arise in the exploitation of marine environments. Particular attention is paid to marine and coastal resources valuation, bio-economic models, environmental issues, marine resource damage assessment, and the management of renewable and non-renewable resources. After completion of this course, students will understand the causes of the many problems associated with renewable resource exploitation and the multiple uses of the marine environment. They will appreciate the role of economic analysis in framing methods for resolving these problems, and be able to appraise critically practical policy experiences at national and global levels. * International Ocean Law This course will examine the principles of international law as they relate to ocean management problems: jurisdiction in zones, such as territorial seas, exclusion zones and the high seas, as well as the problems posed by zonal approaches to ocean-use management. The course will provide the student with a solid grounding in: 1) the manner in which international ocean law is formulated and developed, and how the international legal system functions. 2) the role of international law as a significant tool for ocean use management; 3) the characteristics and nature of different offshore legal zones as well as the rights and obligations of states in those zones. * Marine Affairs This course consists of an interdisciplinary seminar conducted by the Marine Affairs programme faculty supplemented by guest speakers from research institutions, industry and government. It focuses on problems of marine resources development and management at the local, regional, national and international policy level. The course will introduce many topics in ocean and coastal related fields and challenge students to consider techniques for systematic analysis and decision-making. Through this course, students will broaden their topical knowledge, and develop their understanding of analytical approaches.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The Chinese language program is featured by Different Levels of Classes & Small Class Teaching. Different levels of teaching is our feature. We have nine different levels of classes for students to choose, ranging from beginners' to advanced, Students will take 20 hours Chinese class each week. Students are placed in appropriate class after a placement test upon registration. Small-class teaching is our tradition: 15-20 students class gives every student more opportunity to speak. We emphasize on students’ performance in the class and changing teacher-center class to students class thoroughly. 2. Study Duration and Study Mode Editor Notes: There are two phases for students to apply this program. Students can arrange their own timetables for their study. Duration of study is one semester or more. Different classes are arranged for beginners and students of advanced levels. Study in the College of Chinese Language and Culture. 3. Faculties and Curriculm Editor Notes: This program holds strong and committed teachers and full range of curriculum. Highly experienced and fully professional teachers make students improve their communicative ability by practicing in listening, speaking, reading and writing, and engage students in practical student-centered activity. Full range of courses are provided for students, such as Chinese history, Chinese literature, Chinese geography and so on. We also offer rich elective courses to students which can stimulate students’interests and make students have a better understanding of Chinese and Chinese culture, courses such as calligraphy, Kung-fu, Chinese ancient poetry and so on. 4. Study Atmosphere Editor Notes: BNU welcome foreign students from all over the world to study Chinese. BNU is the best place for international students to study Mandarin with a strong learning atmosphere. There are many international students come from different countries all over the world, and teachers as well as students here are also very friendly. 5. Entertainment & Extracurricular Activity Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized for international students during the program. We offer richly colorful extracurricular activities, such as Beijing Opera appreciation, Chinese language competition , culture tour and so on, which is an appropriate method for students to put their knowledge into practice. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: The University’s history is an epitome of the development of modern teacher training and Chinese higher education. Beijing Normal University has a history of more than 100 years, which is almost as long as the history of Chinese modern education. The University is a national base for Teaching Chinese as Second Language; it makes great efforts to expand programs for international students. At present, the university has established cooperative ties with over 200 universities, international organizations and enterprises from more than 30 countries and regions. Established in 2004, the Beijing Normal University- Hong Kong Baptist University United International College is the first united college jointly established by a Chinese mainland university and a Hong Kong SAR university. Learn More about Beijing Normal University(BNU). 7. College of Chinese Language and Culture Editor Notes: The College of Chinese Language and Culture has now become a national center for the research and instruction of Chinese as a foreign language. The College has formed close academic relationships with a number of overseas universities such as Princeton University, Dartmouth College, University of California, Ohio State University, San Francisco State University, Iowa University, London University, Kanazawa University, Osaka University of Foreign Studies, Meikai University, Kanagawa University, Seoul National University, Sung Kyun Kwan University, etc. The College has established two collaborative Confucius Institutes with San Francisco State University (USA) and Manchester University (UK) respectively. In 2011, the Confucius Institute at San Francisco State University was named an Outstanding Confucius Institute. The Dean of the College, Professor Xu Jialu, is a famous linguist, social activist and scholar of Chinese culture. The faculty at the College consists of 58 permanent members, including 10 professors, 24 associate professors, 19 lecturers and 5 administrative staff members. According to the evaluation conducted by the Degree Education Development Center of the Ministry of Education, this degree program has always been one of the top universities among all the 70 relevant universities in China.

fields.description: Program Description Program Structure Course name: Reading and Writing class preparatory, grade 1 (100-101-102) Course categories: reading and writing skills training Three semester teaching time: not less than 324 hours, 6 hours/week) Content summary: the teaching purpose of this course is based on the student to carry on the preliminary reading and writing skills training, trains the student to have the preliminary Chinese reading and writing ability. Teaching content including mandarin phonetics teaching, enable students to master Chinese language system of initials, finals and tones. Course name: Reading and Writing class, grade 2 (201-202) Course categories: reading and writing skills training Two semester teaching time: not less than 216 hours, 6 hours/week) Content summary: the teaching purpose of this course is through further Chinese reading and writing skills training, training students\' ability of reading mediocre Chinese articles and more fluent Chinese writing ability, so that the students can more freely in daily life and learning to use Chinese. Teaching contents are text reading teaching, further correct the students\' sound, rhyme and tone pronunciation. Course name: Reading and Writing class, grade 3 (301-302) Course categories: reading and writing skills training Two semester teaching time: not less than 216 hours, 6 hours/week) Content summary: the teaching purpose of this course is on the basis of reading and writing training, causes the student to expand vocabulary, improve the analysis and the ability to use words, to further improve their reading and writing ability, can make students more familiar, flexible, and accurately grasp and use Chinese, and be able to understand and appreciate Chinese at a higher level of rich and colorful language phenomenon. Paying attention to the combination of read and write, through introducing the reading skills training and knowledge of Chinese culture, reading, cultivate the students deep meaning of the text understanding ability; Writing, improve students\' ability in Chinese the use of written language and expression. Internship & Career Arrange all kinds of activities in our school to provide students with language practice opportunities.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study or research plan: (in Chinese or in English), no less than 800 words * 2. Certificate of HSK * 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 5. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 7. A letter of guarantee in Chinese or in English Students shall guarantee in the letter that they will abide by the laws and decrees of the Chinese government, and will not participate in any activities in China which are deemed to be adverse to the social order of China and are inappropriate to the capacity as a student. * 8. Resume Written in Chinese or in English * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Test Subjects: Specialized Chinese (Humanities or STEM) and Mathematics. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Scanned copy of the first page of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in English, graduation certificates should be translated into English. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Transcripts should be notarized; If not in English, transcripts should be translated into English. 6. Bank statement Bank statement of 20,000 RMB is required for applicants who apply for one academic year and above * 7. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 9. Work certificate (for those with work experience) 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The course is taught in Chinese and provides different levels of study. The program is divided into Elementary Level (A, B), Intermediate Level (C, D), and Advanced Level (E). In total, there are 18-week courses a term. Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese Reading Listening Comprehension Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Reading of Chinese Newspaper Reading of Chinese Periodicals Contents for Chinese culture Week Topic Week Topic 1 Introduction: Dos and Don’ts 7 Great Thinkers and Philosophers 2 Chinese Cuisine 8 Chinese Education 3 Chinese Languages 9 Chinese Religion 4 New China and Influencing Figures 10 Chinese Literature and Art 5 Chinese Customs 11 Chinese Festivals 6 Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events 12 Chinese Medicine and Massage, Qigong 3. Sample Curriculum Editor Notes: This curriculum is for reference only. Class Time Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Class A 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Chinese Character Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Class B 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Listening Class C 08:00 - 9:50 Intensive Reading Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Reading Writing Reading Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Class D 08:00 - 9:50 Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Writing Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Reading Reading Intensive Reading Writing Class E 08:00 - 9:50 Audio-Visual Chinese Business Chinese Chinese News Reading Business Chinese Chinese News Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Audio-Visual Chinese Audio-Visual Chinese Intensive Reading 4. Time and Duration Editor Notes: Here is the time arrangement and application time. 4.1 Time of Entrance Spring Semester: First Monday of March Fall Semester: First Monday of September 4.2 Duration of Study 1/2-2 years 4.3 Time of Application Spring Semester: The End of February Fall Semester: The End of August 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized usually and students lead a rich and colorful life. (Tai Chi Show) ​ (Chinese Contest)

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The stomatology in DMU had been set up for 8 years and taught by experienced teachers. The BDS program in English medium started in 2009. The duration of the program is 5 years including 1 year internship. All teaching faculty are local teachers with rich experience and abroad study or teaching experience. 2. Teaching Objective Editor Notes: The BDS program aims to decelop studnets with professional skills and knowledge. To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. 3. Main subjects & courses Editor Notes: There are 19 main courses for Stomotology. Biochemistry Physiology Medical Immunology Medical Microbiology Experiment of medical functional science Pathology Pharmacology Clinical Diagnostics Oral Anatomical Physiology Oral Histology and Pathology Internal Medicine Cariology And Endodontics Periodontics, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Prosthodontics Orthodontics Prevention of Oral Medicine Oral Mucosal Disease Study Surgery 4. Courses Arrangement Editor Notes: The following is the courses arrangement for its 10 terms. 1st semester to 6th semester: course for basic medicine Mathematics, Physical Education, Human Anatomy/Chinese Language, Medical Chemistry, Medical Physics, Physical Education, Chinese Culture/Computer, Histology & Embryology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry/Physiology, Microbiology, Immunology, Parasitology, Medical Statistics/Pathology, Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Hygiene, Epidemiology/Otolaryngology, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostics, Medical Imageology, Surgery, Oral Anatomy and Physiology, Oral Histology and Pathology 7th semester to 8th semester: course for clinical medicine Internal Medicine, Oral Medicine, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Prosthodontics, Orthodontic, Oral Material, Medical Ethics, Medical Chinese Language/Clinical Psychology, Oral Radiology, Public-health Dentistry, Pediatric Dentistry 9th semester to 10th semester: internship Oral Internal Medicine, Oral Surgery and Oral Rehabilitation 5. Knowledge and Ability to Master Editor Notes: Graduates are going to have a good command of the basic theoretical knowledge as well as its professional stomatological knowledge. Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine; Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research. 6. Internship and Employment Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly recruited by hospitals & universities. A total of 3,541 graduates of our school graduate in 2012, of which a total of 42 graduates of doctoral students, graduate students were 883 (including 27 foreign students, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan regions student; A total of 191 seven-year Accelerated Degree Graduation students, 2425 of undergraduate and the specialist graduates; More than 90 graduates from the Stomatology employed by hospitals in different provinces; Sixty four freshmen are recruited each year by the university; In recent years, 18 research projects in the school have been funded from state, provincial and municipal sources. 7. Brief Introduction to Dalian Medical University Editor Notes: One of the most famous medical universities for English taught MBBS program. Founded in 1947 as Guandong Medical College, Dalian Medical University ( DLMEDU ) has developed into a multi-disciplinary medical university, famous for its MBBS Programs , located in the coastal city-Dalian. As the biggest harbor city in Northeast China region, Dalian is an important international shipping center, logistics center and financial center in Northeast Asia. Owning excellent environment and temperate climate, Dalian was firstly listed as the “Best Tourist Cities” of China. In 2009, it was recognized by UNEP and awarded the highest prize of international garden city by IFPRA. Learn Mor e>> 8. About the College of Stomatology Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly recruited by hospitals & universities. The College and Hospital of Stomatology, Dalian Medical University is a key teaching base and specialized hospital engaging in teaching, research and medical treatment, which is directly administrated by Department of Education of Liaoning Province; The College of Stomatology aims to foster high-rank talents in the field of dentistry with all-round development and proficiency in practical skills and to popularize and improve the level of prevention and treament for odontopathy and oral-maxillofacial disease; The College of Stomatology includes two secondary subjects, dental basic science and clinical science, with dental basic science as the key discipline of Liaoning Province; The College of Stomatology has established cooperative relationships with Tokyo Medical and Dental University, Showa University, Okayama University and Chonnam National University, respectively; Dentistry in Dalian Medical University is the model major in Liaoning province, which was established in 1960 and is now a provincial-level key discipline; The college has master's degree awarded in both dental basic and clinical science with most of its outstanding staffs getting their degree overseas; The college owns first-rate teaching instrument, like dental teaching access system and simulation mould and 3 large-scale multimedia laboratories have been built; Recently, 40% of. undergraduates are enrolled as graduate students, and employment rate reaches 100%. 9. Colorful Life Editor Notes: Every year, DLMEDU will hold many activities for international students. Graduation & Degree Awarding Ceremony Volleyball Tournament

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements In order to be considered for admission, you must: -be a non-Chinese citizen, 18-45 years old, in good health, -have completed senior high school education or will receive a high school diploma by the summer before matriculation at SUFE in September 2026, AND -meet the Chinese language requirements through HSK: If your intended major is Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages , the entry requirement is HSK 4 ; applicants of other majors should present HSK 5, score 180 or above certification at the time of application. -It is mandatory to take the CSCA test and get the score report in advance. fields.description: Program Description Overview Finance is a field lush with great earning potential and rewarding career options in a wide range of industries. A finance degree allows you to work with the decision makers of outside organizations. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program is to cultivate international talents with a comprehensive knowledge of computer technology. International students undertaking th program will: Master the fundamental knowledg and theoretical principles underpinning computer science; Accquire knowledge and operating processes of core technologies an hardware; Be made familiar with the latest frontier knowledge and emerging technologies in computer science; Be trained to develop their research skills, and the creative and practical application of research; Adopt professional, entrepreneurial and application of their computer science skills and knowledge; Acquire, through theory and practice, cross-cultural literacy and improved proficiency in English, and enhanced Chinese language skills; 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program provides 10 main courses for international students. Calculus, Linear Algebra, Discrete Mathematics, Chinese Language, Introduction to Chinese Culture, Data Structure, Database, Program Design of High-level Language, Operating System, Principles of Compiling, Computer Network, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence. 3. Why Choose To Study This Course Editor Notes: It has Computer science basic theory teaching and practical application ability training. Besides learning basic computer course, this course also have artificial intelligence, multimedia technology, two professional direction course, cultivate innovative research and engineering applied talents Drawing on the sophisticated teaching and research facilities as well as rich experience of the professors with extraordinary research power The program puts much premium on the cultivation of students' innovative and analytical thinking and ability Encouraging students to participate in research project with a view to acquiring hands-on experience under the guidance of professors. 4. Career Prospects Editor Notes: This program offers different kinds of careers for international students in the future. Graduates will possess the capabilities needed to work in industrial organizations, research departments, and computer hardware/software development organizations, and governmental departments. They will also be equipped to contribute in the areas of computing research, engineering development, and other related fields. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: SCUT is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. There are 2 doctoral programs, 4 master degree programs, as well as 4 undergraduate programs. Computer application technology is one of the key disciplines in Guangdong province, and computer science and technology is the first batch of brand-name professional in Guangdong province. 6.2 Facilities and Achievements Facilities: The three research centers includes Next generation network technology, High performance computing, and Enterprise computing technology. fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program aims at cultivating elementary doctors of high quality. To be able to engage in medical practice with effectiveness and security after graudation under the guidance of senior doctors. Have proper foundation to further study through their lives. To make advanced in a certain discipline field of the medical science. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program lasts for 6 years. The Pre-Med Education for Chinese language training and English instruction of high school level courses in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry will be taught in the first year. The medical courses in Tongji Medical College then will be taught. Clinical practice will be taught in the last year. 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: This progam includes 12 main courses. Human Anatomy Histology and Embryology Medical Microbiology Medical Immunology Biochemistry Physiology Pathology Pathophysiology Pharmacology Diagnostics Internal Medicine Surgery Note: ​​ Please download the curriculum of MBBS program . ​​ Please see MBBS Teaching Plan . 4. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: There are no requirements on HSK level for students to get the diploma, but before internship, students need to pass the HSK Level 5. Students should complete the requirements of the teaching program and pass the graduation examinations successfully. A graduation certificate and a medical degree will be given by HUST. The degree in English copy will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). If students obtain MBBS Degree, they are eligible to apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council to get registered and practice medicine. Graduates with MBBS degree can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Graduates can also open up his own clinic or pursue study for master’s degree. 5. Internship Editor Notes: The internship is arranged in the last year and students can do it only in China. If students want to communicate well with Chinese patients, they need to pass the HSK Level 5 before internship. One of the affiliated hospitals - Tongji Affiliated Hospital and Union Affiliated Hospital will be choosen for internship. The Union Affiliated Hospital is the large comprehensive hospital directly under the MOH. Tongji Hospital has 2,500 beds, of Level A and Grade III. Students should pay RMB 40,000 per year as the tuition fee in the internship year. The final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation should be taken before graduation. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: The university is actively involved in international academic exchange activities with universities abroad. The Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a national key university directly under the administration of the Ministry of Education of P. R. China, and is among the first Universities joining the national "211 Project" and "985 Project". It was founded on May 26, 2000 as a result of the merger of the former Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Tongji Medical University and Wuhan Urban Construction Institute , Learn More>> 7. Tongji Medical College Editor Notes: The college has kept a friendly mutual relationship with Germany for a long time. ​ Inter-university project cooperation have been established with more than 40 universities, institutes, hospitals and companies. The College is a medical college which was built by the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Health in China. There are 3 key laboratories of MOE and 2 of MOH. The college owns the largest experiment and clinical research center in China. The buildings along three streets into shops for science and technology trade have been built by the College.​ The college has a staff of 10,000 and 8,800 students are studying on campus, among them, about 500 are international students in MBBS program. There are about 100 students from Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe coming here to study this program. ​ 8 . Campus Life ​ Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Sports Meeting ​ Recreational Activities ​

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Objectives Editor Note: The graduates of this program are required to master the basic theories and skills in modern communication systems and communication networks. Based on the characteristics of overseas students and making full use of our educational resources, we design the program to bring up students mastering the basic theory of electronic and information fields, as well as reasonable knowledge framework. The graduates in this program are required to develop the systems and technologies which drive the information age, from acquiring information, transmission, processing to applications. They are required to master the basic theories and skills in modern communication systems and communication networks. They are able to participate in the design and development of various communication and information systems. The graduates are equipped with strong professional English in telecommunication engineering, good personality and innovative initiatives. They are qualified to design, integrate and develop communication systems and technologies in information and communications industries, research institutes, universities and other related communities. 2. Learning Outcomes Editor Note: Students are required to master the following abilities upon graduation. 1. A knowledge of liberal arts and social sciences, an understanding of social, professional and ethical responsibility, and an ability to communicate effectively in oral, written and visual forms. 2. An ability to apply knowledge of mathematics, science, and engineering with the specialty in telecommunications. 3. An ability to design and conduct experiments, analyze and interpret data, and report findings. 4. An ability to design a communication system, component, or process to meet specifications. 5. An ability to identify, formulate, analyze and solve telecommunication engineering problems. 6. An ability to use the techniques, skills, and modern engineering tools necessary for telecommunication engineering practice. 7. Innovative thinking, team spirit, a preliminary ability to conduct scientific research, and an ability to function in multi-disciplinary teams. 8. An understanding about the impact of engineering solutions in a global and societal context, a knowledge of laws and regulations relevant to engineering, environmental protection and sustainable development. 9. International vision, a recognition of the need for lifelong learning, and an ability to engage lifelong learning to remain effective in a climate of continually emerging technologies. 10. An ability to read English references and conduct inter-cultural communication and cooperation. 3. Credits Hours and Units Editor Note: You can find more course credits and practicum credits information below. Minimum Credits of the curriculum (Comprising course system and intensified internship practical training):149.5 credits Course Credits Hours and Units Practicum Credits 4. Main Courses Editor Note: There are about 12 main courses for students to learn. Circuit Theory, Data Structure, Signal and Linear Systems, Analog Electronics, Digital Circuit and Logic Design, Principles of Microcomputer, Electronic Circuits of Communications, Principles of Communications, Fundamentals of Information, Digital Signal Processing, Stochastic Process݆, Electromagnetic Field and Wave 5. Course Schedule Editor Note: As it may change every year, the courses information listed in the following form are only for reference. 6. Introduction of Huazhong University of Science and Technology Editor Note: It is among the first Universities joining the national "211 Project" and "985 Project". The Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a national key university directly under the administration of the Ministry of Education of P. R. China, and is among the first Universities joining the national "211 Project" and "985 Project". It was founded on May 26, 2000 as a result of the merger of the former Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Tongji Medical University and Wuhan Urban Construction Institute. Learn More>> 7. Colourful Life Editor Note: International students will enjoy a happy life in HUST. New Year Gala HUST International Day

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program includes three parts, which are Chinese culture and natural science courses, other 6 courses, and internship. The basic courses in 5-level are prone to strengthening the students’ abilities of listening, speaking, reading, writing. As students' Chinese levels are different, translation will be offered accordingly. There are some relevant culture courses like calligraphy, Chinese painting, Taiji Boxing (the Chinese shadow boxing), Chinese gardens, etc. This program includes 6 levels and every level is for one semester. Students who pass final exam will study the high grade of Chinese Course in the next semester. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This progam can be divided into 6 levels. 2.1 Level A 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the beginners of Chinese language, which focuses on training the students to use the simple Chinese in daily communication. When finishing this course, students are required to master 50 basic Chinese grammatical points, 900 words, basic simple sentence patters and some basic conversation modes and language functions, having the ability of making simple conversation on the most common topics in daily life. 2) Courses Listening,Conversation,Reading & writing 2.2 Level B 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the students who have mastered more than 800 Chinese vocabularies. After about four months study, the students basically shall be able to understand familiar and short sentences in daily social life, and can introduce themselves or other people simply, can communicate with others on familiar topics. the course especially pays attention to the training of the students’ knowledge and ability of HSK. 2) Main Courses Listening and speaking Reading & writing Extensive reading ​2.3 Level C 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop the students' ability of oral communication, and students’ reading and writing ability with the proficient use of new words, to comprehensively improve the communicative competence of listening, speaking, reading and writing for Intermediate level learners. The students are required to master about 800 multiplex words and about 120 ways of expression. 2) Main Courses Reading & writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.4 Level D 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop students' ability in Chinese through relatively separate and mutually complementary listening and speaking exercises, and acquire 200 Chinese idioms and traditional sayings. Students are also encouraged to contribute with texts and problems from their ongoing course or project work. 2) Main Courses Reading and Writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.5 Level E 1）Teaching Objectives Emphasis on outlining the overall features of the Chinese culture and describing dynamically its heritage. The students are required to take an active part in analysis, comparison, exchange and discussion in class to enrich their relevant knowledge. The materials are mainly selected from Chinese and foreign movies and programs on TV according to students’ interests and language proficiency. 2) Main Courses Advanced Chinese Reading &Writing Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Advanced AVO Chinese Timetable Sample 2.6 Class Size The minimum size of each class is 15 and the average is about 20. 2.7 Completion certificate Completion certificate will be awarded to students who passed the final exam. ​3. School Introduction Editor Notes: Shanghai University is well-known for its vigorous international exchanges and cooperation. ​ Shanghai University is one of the key universities in the "Project 211". The current president of the university is Professor CHIEN Weichang, a famous educator, scientist, social activist and member of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The Party Secretary of Shanghai University is Professor YU Xinhui and the Executive Vice President is Professor ZHOU Zhewei , Learn More>> 4. College of International Exchange Editor Notes: The School has built up academic links and cooperated with lots of foreign universities. The School provides short- or long-term courses of Chinese language, culture, and economics. There are also lots of optional courses and special lectures. The School will offer services of visas, accommodation and emergency aids for international students. 5. What Students Say Editor Notes: The School has lots of international students. ​ Name: Ou Chen From:​ Kenya Program: International Trade Subject: Why does he choose SHU? "The large population, long history and rapid development in the economy make China wonderland for me. Meanwhile Shanghai, as the economic center of China means more opportunity for learning and self-development. After checking the website, I found that I could not only find majors I liked here, but also many fun loving companions. These are the reasons I chose Shanghai University." ​ Name: Victoria From: Russia Program: Chinese Language and Literature Subject: How to get into the campus "Getting used to life here is easy. You can try to find your compatriots, but if you can't, don't worry, go to the ISU (International Students Union) in the dormitory hall, and you will get help. But, I think the best way to get yourself inside is to find a Chinese peer. After that I believe you will soon have a group of Chinese friends. Of course, if you still have any problem, go to the CIE office for help." Name: Yang Ling From: Thailand Program: Sociology Subject: One sentence to freshman "Welcome to Shanghai University! Here we have beautiful environment as well as many athletic facilities. In turn, you should work really hard, and you will find studying here is a real strain. After all, I believe studying abroad in Shanghai University will be your most cherished experience and you will also have deep love for this city." 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Self-supporting Applicants: applicants aged between 18 and 35 (up to and including December 31 in the year of application) Non-Chinese citizens who have graduated from high school or above and are in good health; 2. Applicants who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, or who have been a foreign national since birth must meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12; 3. Applicants under the age of 18(before August 31,2026) must have a guardian living in mainland China with a stable source of income. When applying, the following guardian materials need to be submitted:.Guardian is a Chinese citizen: upload a scanned copy of the resident ID card; bank deposit certificate (amount not less than RMB 100,000, with a validity date later than January 31,2027): - Guardian is a foreign national: Upload a scanned copy of the passport (information page);non-student residence permit (valid after January 31, 2027); bank deposit certificate (amount not less than RMB 100,000, with a validity date beyond January 31,2027): -Guardian Guarantee Letter 4. Certificate of HSK5 Chinese Proficiency Test with a score of 180(inclusive) or above (valid for 2 years) -Chinese Language of The International School (Economics and Trade Oriented/TeachingChinese to Speakers of Other Languages) undergraduate entrance requirements: First year: New HSK Level 4, 180 points or above; Second year (transferred student): New HSK Level 5, 180 points (inclusive) or more, one year of Chinese learning experience (only Chinese language courses or undergraduate majors taught in Chinese at a Chinese mainland university/college are accepted): Third year (transferred student): New HSK Level 6, 180 points (inclusive) or more, two yearsof Chinese leamning experience (only Chinese language courses or undergraduate majors taught in Chinese at a Chinese mainland university/college are accepted). -If the high school education was conducted in Chinese, a proof of Chinese-medium instruction must be submitted, and the HSK certificate is exempted. 5. The required test subjects vary by major. For details, please refer to: 2026 CSCA Test Subject Arrangement for International Undergraduate Students at Tongji University, download here .

A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 6. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants (at least 18 years old; under 25 years old in principle) must be non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health and holding valid foreign passports in accordance with Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. 2. If both or one of the parents are Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, and the individual possesses foreign nationality at birth, they do not possess Chinese nationality. As a foreign student applicant, they shall meet the provisions of the Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating Work Related to the Acceptance of Foreign Students by Domestic Colleges and Universities (JWH [2020] No. 12). 3. Applicants must have a high school degree in minimum with good academic records. 4. Language proficiency requirements: Majors taught in English ①Applicants who are native speakers of English are exempt from English proficiency certificates. ②Applicants who are not native speakers of English must provide a TOEFL certificate (scored 80 or above), or IELTS certificate (scored 6.0 or above), or other certificates demonstrating an equivalent level of English proficiency; ③Applicants who are not native speakers of English but acquired their highest degree through a program taught in English can provide, instead of an IELTS/TOEFL certificate, a certificate demonstrating the program was taught in English. 5. CSCA certificate For Liberal Arts programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering the Mathematics subject) is required. fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction The course is designed in accordance to the latest trend in the world, so as to make it globally acceptable as well as to incorporate the requirements of SAARC countries. Since it's beginning in 2001 the university has enrolled nine batches of medical students from Nepal, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Singapore, USA, Canada, Korea, Fiji, Cameroon etc into the MBBS courses. Six batches of international MBBS students have graduated from this medical school as of 2011. The MBBS graduates have excelled in the medical council licensing examinations in their respective countries including Nepalese Medical Council Licensing Examinations and Medical Council of India Screening Test Examinations while other graduates have passed USMLE licensing Examination to practice in USA and Australia Medical Council Licensing Examination to practice in Australia and average rate of acquiring Medical License is 90%. Graduates of this medical school have been employed in reputed government or private hospitals in their home countries. SCU is listed in the WHO World Directory of Medical Schools and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, ECFMGetc. For more details, please visit the Medical Licensing Examination Guide. Study duration 6 years, including two years of basic medical science, three years of clinical science training and one year of internship Main Courses Introduction to Clinical Medicine, Diagnostics, Pathology, Diagnostic Radiology, Medical Psychology, Introduction to Surgery, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Pediatrics, Ophthalmology, Otorhinolaryngology, Neurology, Infectious Diseases, Dermatology, Psychiatrics, Nuclear Medicine, Medical Genetics, Clinical Epidemiology and Clinical Research Design, Forensic Medicine, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Geriatrics etc. Selective courses: Acupuncture, Modern Oncology, Clinical Pharmacology, Rehabilitation, Emergency Medicine Internship Students can choose to do the internship/training in China, their home country or any other country. If international students would like to do the internship in China, it would be done in The First University Hospitalthe which is also called as Huaxi Hospital. And studetns need to pass the HSK 3 to contact with patients. If students want to do the internship in other country, SCU need to do an qualification evaluation on the hospital which student choose. Students only need to pay for the processing fee and examination fee. And, students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in SCU. Degree Awarded Applicants are required to pass HSK test (level 3) before the graduation. Note: The requirement of the level of HSK may be changed according to the Ministry of Education of P.R.C.. MBBS Degree : upon graduation, students need to pass the HSK 3 to get the diploma. On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the SCU, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). After obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Except this, one can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master’s degree.

Students who study undergraduate program related to Chinese language for one semester in any Chinese university with New HSK level 4 (a total of no less than 195) can apply to study from the second semester of the first academic year. Students who study undergraduate program related to Chinese language program for one academic year in any Chinese university with New HSK level 5 (a total of no less than 180) can apply to study from the second academic year. Students who study undergraduate program related to Chinese language for two academic years in any Chinese university with Chinese proficiency of New HSK level 5 (a total of no less than 210) can apply to study from the third academic year. Students who study undergraduate program related to economics and trade for one academic year in any Chinese university with New HSK level 6 (a total of no less than 180) can apply to study from the second academic year. ★Applicants who want to start from the second semester of the first academic year, the second or the third academic year, need to pass the entrance examination. Entrance examination will be held on July 14, 2026 for students who want to start from second and third academic year. The entrance examination will be held online at 2 p.m. Beijing time. Detailed information about the entrance examination will be sent by email. Those who pass the entrance exam and with good grades from the previous university can be enrolled in the corresponding grade to study.

Applicants must have a bachelors degree and be under the age of 35. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as the university rules. 3. Language proficiency requirements For Chinese-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit HSK-5 certificates with a minimum score of 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants who complete their undergraduate study in Chinese are allowed to be exempted from providing HSK Certificates.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study or Research Plan 1000 words at least, in Chinese or English You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Study Experience Resume The start and end time of each education experience must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior high school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Applicants of School of Architecture are requested to submit E-work Collection and Video Presentation * 5. Acceptance Letter from TJU Supervisor Remember to upload it to the application system if you get the Acceptance Letter. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Contacts of professors You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Photocopy of passport (Ordinary passport expires after September 2026). * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submitted before registration. * 11. Scanned Copy of Highest Diploma Scan copy of Pre-graduation Certificate is required if the applicant has not gained degree certificate before the application deadline. Once admitted, students are required to present their original Bachelor Degree Certificate with the Degree Authentication Document upon registration for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment. * 12. Two Recommendation Letters in English or Chinese from two professors or associate professors. You can download a template or sample from here . * 13. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. (Fresh graduates are required to submit a certificate that shows the applicant's good record of conduct and performance in their university). 14. Published papers * 15. Digital Signature Please sign your name on a white paper, and send us a scan copy of it; We will only use it to help you digitally sign some related documents during the application process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description Application Time each year before the end of June Term begins each year on September (follow the Enrolment Notice) Accomodation If you need dormitory on campus, room reservation should be made when application. If dormitories are full, we don't accept any room reservation.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1) Requirements on Citizenship Non-Chinese citizens who meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Document [2020] No. 12, which requires those who emigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan applying to study in ZUST as international students, should meet the following additional requirements: the applicants must hold valid passport or other relevant internationally recognized documents for at least 4 years; meanwhile, in the latest 4 years (by each April 30th of the year of University registration), the applicants must have lived overseas for 2 years (Living overseas for 9 months can be converted to 1 year, which is subject to the exit-entry stamp on visa). 2) General Requirements Age ≤35; High school education or above; Good health; No criminal record; No history of drug use. 3) English language proficiency certificate required. 4) According to the requirements set by the higher higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs are required to attend CSCA tests. CSCA Subjects download here .

fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program aims to make all students to be senior engineering technicians . To train high-level application-oriented senior engineering technicians . Grasp the fundamental theories, knowledge and skills in relevant branches of civil engineering design, construction, research and management . The graduates of this major receive basic training for being registered engineers and reached the requirements to be a trainee civil engineer. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: It will be very enriching during the study period, students may study over 15 courses in the program. Introduction to Civil Engineering Engineering Drawing ＆ Computer Aided Drawing Theoretical Mechanics Material Mechanics Civil Engineering Materials Building Architecture Principal Theory of Steel Structure Foundation Engineering Civil Engineering Construction Masonry Structures Design of Building Steel Structures Civil Engineering Budget Estimate High-building Structures and Earthquake Resistance Appraisal and Reinforce of Engineering Structure Development and Management of Real Estate, etc. 3. Graduation Orientation Editor Notes: After graduation, students can work in different fields of civil engineering design, research, construction, education, management, investment . Mainly work on the field of civil engineering design, research, construction, education, management, investment and so on . Can work in the infrastructure sector of some Design and Research Institute, Construction Units, Supervision Companies or Real Estate Companies after graduation . Also work on the relative vocation of civil engineering in the Municipal, Transportation, Finance or Education Departments. fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program aims to train students for innovative thinking and international perspective. After graduation, student can have basic theory, knowledge and skill in engineering, technology, design and interdisciplinary; basic ability of food production, research and development, analysis and management; basic quality of entrepreneurship, marketing, innovative thinking, international perspective; engaged in scientific research, technology development, engineering design, production management, quality control, product sales, inspection and quarantine, teaching in food production, processing, distribution, import and export, supervision, safety management and other departments. 2. Enrollment Advantage Editor Notes: The courses of this program are all taught in English and will format distinct characteristics. All courses of this class are given in English. After graduation, student can have basic theory, knowledge and skill in engineering, technology, design and interdisciplinary; basic ability of food production, research and development, analysis and management; basic quality of entrepreneurship, marketing, innovative thinking, international perspective. Relying on Provincial Key Lab for Chem&Bio Processing Technology of Farm Products, Provincial Key Innovation Team of Farm Products Chem & Bio Processing, Provincial Universities First-Level Disciplines Platform, and with advanced teaching and experimental equipment in food R&D and analysis, this class will format distinct characteristics. 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: It will be very enriching during the study period, students may study over 12 courses in the program. Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry Organic Chemistry Biochemistry Microbiology Food Chemistry Food Analysis Food Nutrition Food Machinery and Equipment Project Management and Case Study Vegetable and Fruit Processing Food Biotechnology Advances in Food Science and Technology, etc. 4. Graduation Orientation Editor Notes: After graduation, students can work in different fields of engineering, production management and quality control . Research and development, engineering, production management, quality control, sales, inspection and quarantine, teaching in food production, processing, distribution, import and export, supervision, safety management and other departments. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Located in Zhejiang Province, which is one of the most prosperous provinces in China. Zhejiang University of Science and Technology (ZUST) is a multi-disciplinary university with an emphasis on engineering, and incorporating disciplines in science, arts, economics, management, and education. Combining the successful administrative experience of German universities of applied sciences with its own experience, ZUST explores ways of cultivating international talents with innovative spirits and strong skills.​ Learn More>> 6. I like this city a lot! I’m very happy I had the opportunity to study at ZUST, a place where I was able to enrich myself. Live your life on purpose! " 7.
