fields.description: Program Description ​ 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The clinical medicine program in ZZU ranks top of universities in China and holds many advantages. Students are to be taught with clinical and clinical interpersonal skills and get in contact with patients at an early stage. The theoretical teaching of clinical medicine combines well with students' clinical experiences arranged by ZZU. ZZU specially set up a Clinical Skills Training Centre for international students to master clinical skills so that they can receive timely and effective training. ZZU employs both domestic and international experts and professors to give lectures and students would have access to global patients to acquire practical and various experiences from different emergency cases. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The clinical medicine program offers about 14 courses for students during their study in ZZU. Anthroponomy Histo-embryology Physiology Biochemistry Pharmacology Pathology Preventive Medicine Microbiology Immunology Diagnostics Internal Medicine Surgery Obstetrics-gynecology Pediatrics 3. The MBBS Curriculum Editor Notes: During the 6 years' study, there are 12 semesters for the MBBS program. 4 key themes shall be emphasized and integrated: Human Biology in Health and Disease; Professional Skills: Diagnostic, Problem Solving, Effective Communication and Clinical Management; Population Health, Health Services, Economics, and Policy; Medical Ethics, Professional Attitudes, and Behaviour. Year I Semesters 1 and 2 Introduction to the Art and Science of Medicine (around 28 weeks) The Block aims to provide an introductory overview of the structure and function of the human body. This also aims to strengthen students’ foundation in basic and health sciences, give an overview of the processes of diseases and introduce the therapeutic strategies for modulating disease processes. From the beginning, students are encouraged to develop an understanding of the ethical and economic implications of modern medical care, medical humanities, as well as the importance of an approach to patient care that is based on sound scientific evidence. Year II Semesters 3 and 4 Respiratory System, Cardiovascular System, Urogenital System, Gastrointestinal System, Musculoskeletal System In the entire second year, the first semester and the first half of the second semester of Year 3, the curriculum is based on a ‘human systems’ approach. Through these nine interdisciplinary modules, each of around 4-5 weeks, students learn the structure and functions of the body systems through these modules as they relate to the patient both as an individual and as a member of a wider population group. Year III Semester 5 Central Nervous System, Head and Neck Block, Haematology and Immunology System Year III Semester 6 Endocrine System Integrated Block (A) (4 Weeks) Elective (around 12 weeks) Students are given the opportunities to take a "core-plus-option" approach to learning during the duration of at least 12 weeks. During the period, they are required to prepare for the undertaking of a health research project and are exposed to the clinical setting through various clinical visits and attachments. In addition, they are encouraged to follow voluntary and community services, participate in overseas exchanges and/ or initiate their own learning activities, which are subject to formal approval by the Elective Sub-Committee. Year IV Semesters 7 and 8 Integrated Block (B) (around 8 weeks) The Block adopts a 'life-cycle approach' to studying multi-system problems is introduced. The aim is to help students integrate the knowledge they have acquired during the earlier parts of the curriculum and prepare them for the subsequent clerkships. Junior Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, Multidisciplinary Block, (around 8 weeks each) The emphasis shifts to the clinical management of patients. During the clerkship phases, students are directly involved in the day-to-day care of patients. They are expected to understand the basic concepts that underlie their patients’ problems and apply the knowledge they have gained in earlier parts of the course. Much emphasis is put on the clinical aspects of care in diagnosis, treatment and patient management. Students learn to apply their clinical and clinical interpersonal skills in an increasingly sophisticated fashion. During the period of the Specialty Clerkship, students are required to reside in the Madam S.H. Ho Residence for Medical Students or in an approved teaching hospital for specified periods. Year V Semester 9 Senior Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, Multidisciplinary Block, (around 8 weeks each) Year V/VI Semesters 10 and 11 Specialty Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, O&G Block, O&T/Emergency Medicine Block, Psychiatry/Family Medicine, and Primary Care Block, Paediatrics & Adolescent Medicine Block, (around 8 weeks each) Year VI Semester 12 Revision Block Final Examination Elective The tenth semester comprises a revision block preceding the Final Examination, which is followed by a 4-week elective. During the elective period, students can explore areas of individual interest by means of either clinical attachment or laboratory/clinical research. Students then proceed to a 4-week pre-internship program comprising practical tips workshops, hospital attachments, and orientations organized by the Hospital Authority and the hospitals. 4. Internship Editor Notes: Students can do their internships ZZU's 9 affiliated hospitals, which are all top hospitals in China. In the 6th year, students shall do their internship in China or outside China. Students could do their internships in the 9 affiliated hospitals. Although there is no limit to students' Chinese level when conducting an internship in China, students shall be able to communicate with patients simply. Students can do an internship with famous domestic hospitals in Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Chongqing, Guangzhou, Xi'an, etc. since ZZU has cooperation and exchange agreement with them. Also, students could conduct an internship in medical institutes in the U.S., Germany, Japan, Canada, U.K., Swede, Norwegian, Denmark, Austria, Holland, etc. 5. Job Availability Editor Notes: After graduation, students could work in public or private hospitals or open their own clinic or go on further study. To get registered and practice medicine, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council. (The MBBS graduates of ZZU who have taken the medical licensing examinations have a high passing rate). According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. An MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government and private hospitals, nursing homes or other health facilities. Also, one can start his own clinic or go on to further study for a master's degree. 6. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: If everything goes smooth, students will get their MBBS degree diploma. If meeting the degree regulations of the host institution, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the host institution upon completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). Students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in ZZU before graduation. After attending the graduation ceremony, students can get a diploma. 7. Affiliated hospitals of ZZU Editor Notes: The comprehensive strength of ZZU's 9 affiliated hospitals ranks top in China. The 9 affiliated hospitals of ZZU include 8 Grade III Class A hospital and 1 Grade II-Class A hospital. As for the 9 hospitals, there are more than 15,000 beds, reaching 400,0000 out-patients per year. With strong and proud technical capability and advanced equipment, the hospitals could have 300 international students of undergraduate clinical medical majors do their internships at the same time. 8. Faculty Editor Notes: The Clinical Medicine Department of ZZU has strong teaching resources. The school owns 2 academicians, 19 special professors at the provincial level, 48 guest professors,44 Ph.D.supervisors, 269 MA student supervisors, 150 doctor teachers, and 397 master teachers. With over 30% of the teachers who have studied or worked overseas, full English-medium classed can be conducted absolutely. ZZU invites outstanding graduates to be back to school as the tutor of some crucial and key courses. 9. Experimental facilities Editor Notes: ZZU provides a great platform for students' clinical-stage skills training with its complete and advanced laboratories and experimental centers. ZZU has invested to build up specified clinical skills experimental centers for international students, including Clinical anatomy laboratory, Surgical skill laboratory, internal medicine skills laboratory, etc. These laboratories are set up with Simulated Operation Room, Animal Laboratory, Electronic patient training room, Simulated ward, ICU ward, Clinical Specimen Exhibition Hall, etc. These advanced teaching instruments and equipment cover various experimental teaching functions in internal medicine, chirurgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology as well as Pediatrics, etc. 10. Introduction to ZZU Editor Notes: ZZU is supported by “The Midwest Universities Comprehensive Strength Promotion Project” and Co-sponsored by the Henan Provincial Government and the Ministry of Education. At present, the enrolled number of full-time students in Zhengzhou University is over 36,000, with 6,639 graduate students and 342 international students. The University Library contains about 4.2 million volumes and 1.05 million volumes of electrical books. It has altogether four campuses, i.e. the New Campus, the South Campus, the Institute of Technology and the Medical School. Learn More about Zhengzhou University. 11. The Medical School Editor Notes: The Medical School of ZZU is one of the three earliest universities that conduct full English-medium undergraduate clinical medicine in China. One of the earliest Chinese medical higher education institutions recognized by WHO (World Health Organization) and approved to offer master and doctor degree programs in China. One of the earliest universities offering EMI (English Mediated Instruction) medical programs in China. More than 1000 undergraduate students have completed their medical studies with degrees since 2000. For Now, about 940 undergraduate students are studying medicine in Zhengzhou Universities who are from Nepal, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Eritrea, Botswana, Myanmar, Peru, Maldives, Zimbabwe, the U.S.A., Canada, Austria, the UK, etc. 12. Extracurricular Activity Editor Notes: Zhengzhou University has many interesting Extracurricular Activities for international students. International Student Football Team Students Learning Calligraphy

fields.description: Program Description The aim of the major is to provide students with great Chinese language ability and communication competence. Students are expected to grasp the basic theories and knowledge of Chinese language and humanities; be familiar with the situation and social culture of the country; master some basic methods for document retrieval and reference enquiry. Graduates are capable of conducting elementary scientific research and work; or being advanced and qualified Chinese talents for economic and culture exchange between China and foreign countries. Compulsory Courses Compulsory courses of basic knowledge for Chinese language undergraduates are set as follows: Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced Chinese Comprehensive; Reading; Listening; Speaking; Writing; About China; Contemporary Chinese Literature; Classical Literature; Translation (English—Chinese, Korean—Chinese, Russian—Chinese); Modern Chinese Rhetorics; Business Chinese; Chinese Foreign Trade; Selected Commercial Periodicals and so on. According to professional characteristics, CICE upholds offering knowledge in proper sequence and combing with professional skills. Integrated language course are provided each year with courses on improving language sills and Chinese culture, etc. Thus, students could improve and consolidate their knowledge during the process. Selected Courses The courses are set to extend students\' professional knowledge and perfect their knowledge structure. Course are as follows: Chinese Culture; Chinese Masterwork Selected; Selected Poems from Tang and Song Dynasties; Chinese Information Disposal; Spoken Chinese idioms; Speech and Eloquence; Social Survey; Tourism Geography; Playing Chinese Musical Instrument Guzheng; Chinese Martial Art and so on. The courses are matched reasonably, which could help students deepen their basic knowledge and discover their potentials, and also arouse their interests and enlarge their knowledge scope. Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the bachelor\'s thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with BA diploma. Good News HEU will give excellent applicant of B.A Degree of Chinese Language Program for Beginner 50% discount of tuition fee .

fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: The graduates can master the knowledge of Economics, Management, Economic Law, as well as the basic skill and method on Business Management. To be familiar with the rule of operation, trade and the knowledge of business economic benefit analysis. To be engaged in management, teaching and researching in a business unit, government department, or research institute. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This major aims at cultivating the high-level management talents . To cultivate students with good knowledge structure of Management, higher management quality and stronger innovation competence, familiar with policies and regulations of enterprise management. To be fit for the management post in the enterprises, institutions and department of administrative management and suitable for management research. Students can find employment of management system development, integrated management, planning management, quality management, management training, engineering project analysis, etc. This major belongs to the first brand majors of Jiangsu University and the brand major of Jiangsu Province. This major conducts chiefly the teaching and training in terms of the main functions of business enterprise management. It opens only when there are over 10 applicants. ​​ ​ ​ 3. The Key Courses The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years include: Principles of Management Operation Management Principles of Economics Human Resource Management Operational Research Organization Behavior Management Information System Business Operation Strategy Business Statistics Economic Law Accounting Business & Ethic Financial Management Management Communication Marketing International Trade You could download Curriculum Schedule for the BA Program here 4. Internship & Future Career Editor Notes: The employment rate of this program is very good. To be familiar with the rule of operation, trade and the knowledge of business economic benefit analysis. To be engaged in management, teaching and researching in a business unit, government department, or research institute. The employment situation of this major is good. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities, Learn More>> 6. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be aged between 18 and 30 years old, non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders, healthy and well-behaved, with an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma, without any criminal records. Applicants should abide by the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and related rules of university, honor the Chinese social morality and customs, and will not participate in any activities which are inappropriate to the capacity as a student. 2. Chinese Proficiency Requirements (1) Applicants for science and engineering program taught in Chinese must have HSK 4 certificate (with 180 points or above). HSK 5 certificate (with 180 points or above) is required for applicants for liberal arts, economic and management program. The certificate must be in valid period. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate by providing the academic documents. (2) Applicants who haven't reached the required language level, can apply Chinese language program in the International Exchange College (hereinafter as "IEC"). After achieving HSK certificate, they can apply for the degree study. 3. According to the Document No. 12〔2020〕of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China (see Appendix 1), If the applicant's parents or one of the parents are Chinese or the applicant has emigrated from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality for, they must be naturalized for 4 years or more and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during the past 4 years (Actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). ---- Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship and become foreign citizens should provide: (1) Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship; (2) Documents certifying the acquirement of foreign citizenship; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. ---- Applicants who have acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen should provide: (1) Documents certifying acquiring foreign citizenship at the time of birth; (2) Documents certifying parent's (with Chinese citizenship) permanent residence in foreign country before the birth of the applicant; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Course Introduction Editor Notes: This program fosters engineering and technical talents suiting the world aviation industry development needs. Students gain the following knowledge and ability: Comprehensive professional education of aircraft design and maintenance; Master the technologies and theory of related fields, including mechanics, materials science, electronics, measurement and control, market economy and other basic knowledge; Professional knowledge of broad aircraft design and maintenance and have comprehensive ability and engineering innovation capabilities. 2. Main Subjects and Courses Editor Notes: There are two main subjects -- basic medicine and clinical medicine as well as 16 main courses for the program: Semester 1: Engineering Graphics 1, Linear Algebra 1, Algebra & Trigonometry 1, Programming in C Language 1, Orientation Program 1, Basic Chinese Speaking 1, Comprehensive Chinese(1) 1, An Introduction to China 1, Physical Education 1-7 Semester 2: An Introduction to Aeronautics, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (1), Physics (1), Physics Experiments (1), Basic Chinese Listening, Comprehensive Chinese (2), Chinese Culture 2, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (2), Essential English Writing Semester 3: Physics Experiments (2) 3, Physics (2), Comprehensive Chinese (3), Academic English Writing, Engineering Training, Engineering Economics, Reading in Chinese, Communication in Chinese, Information Retrieval & Utilization Semester 4: Numerical Analysis, Mathematics Foundation for Information System, Electronic Circuit, Engineering Electromagnetic Field, Digital Circuit, Course Project: Electrical & Electronic Technique, Electronic Circuit Experiment, Principles of Communication, FPGA and its Applications, Probability & Statistics, Matlab Applications, Intermediate Chinese Semester 5: Control System Engineering, Electric Machinery, Analogue Electronics, Microwave Technique and Antenna, Signals and Systems, An Introduction to Industrial Engineering , Project Management, Chinese-to-English Translation, Software Engineering, Random Signal Analysis Semester 6: Power Electronics Technology, Electric Power Engineering, Principles of Micro-computer, Linear Control Systems, Positioning and Navigation System, Principles and Applications of DSP, Digital Image Processing, Speech Signal Processing, Basic Writing in Chinese 6 Semester 7: Modern Testing Technology, Digital Signal Processing, Modern Control Theory, Flight Control System, Digital Control System: Theory and Design, Aerospace Power Supply System, Digital Control in Power Electronics, Spread Spectrum Communication, Professional Ethics, Multi-media Technology & Applications Semester 8: Graduation Project 3. Future Career Fields After Graduation​ Editor Notes: The prospect of employment looks very promising. Aircraft Production and Design Industries Robotics and Mechanical Engineering Industries Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), Drones Air and Space-based telecommunication industries Aircraft Maintainance Industries Further Research Military Service and other related technology-intensive fields 4. Accreditation Editor Notes: Accredited by the Ministry of Education, China. NUAA's degree is accepted worldwide. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. NUAA has partnered with top universities in the USA, Australia, and EU where some students take their third or fourth year of study. Career Prospects: NUAA recent graduates have been employed by organizations such as: 5. Brief Introduction to Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: NUAA is now a comprehensive university especially featured with Aerospace Engineering. Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA), established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More about Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics 6. About IEC Editor Notes: IEC has carried out a wide range of multi-level and diversified international cooperation education. The earliest institution in Jiangsu Province to set up Sino-foreign cooperatively-run schools. The aim is to cultivate an international higher vocational college with international vision and complementary advanced cultures between the East and the West. Carried out exchange student programs with high-level universities in the United States, Britain, France, Australia, Sweden and Ukraine. Joint training programs have been carried out with universities in Britain and Australia, and recruited students from nearly 20 countries. Rapid development of school-running scale and the continuous improvement of school-running quality is distinctive international education characteristics.

Program Overview Editor Notes: After meeting requirements of core course, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing, international students will graduate successfully. This program fosters young talent to become superior researchers and engineers engaging in design, manufacturing, R & D and management in the fields of mechanical engineering and its automation, as well as in civil aviation engineering. Systematic study and engineering training help students to gain the following sectors of expertise and capabilities. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: This program aims to train international medical health care service talents. This program will refer to international standards for medical education, mainly aiming at cultivating internationally universal medical practitioner with substantial medical preclinical knowledge, normative clinical skills & favorable professional quality, taking international requests of source countries of international students the requests of the students to return to their motherland to serve other country into appropriate accounts, allowing the graduates to become practitioner to offer service of medical treatment, education research in medical health care service sectors. Lectures of this major will be given in English all the way to top students of all countries in the world who aspire to study research medical science. Graduates may participate in the Examination of Doctors Qualifications as per the relevant rules of the countries after graduation. 2. Major courses Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses for international students. Systematic Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Preventive medicine, Evidence-based Medicine, Diagnostics, Introduction to Surgery, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Neurology, Psychiatry, Medical Ethics, Chinese, etc. 3. University Size Editor Notes: Now GXMU has 5 affiliated hospitals and 11 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals. Currently,GXMU has five affiliated hospitals under its direct administration. Among them, the first Affiliated Hospital, the Affiliated Tumor Hospital and the Hospital of Stomatology are the largest"Grade 3 Class A" hospital in Guangxi.They play a leading rolein higher medical education,medical scientific research and health services in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. GXMU has 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals in 7 major cities of Guangxi.These hospitals are the largest hospitals in these cities and they are also teaching hospitals of GXMU. 4. Scientific Research Innovation Editor Notes: GXMU has advantages in scientific research and has won fund project and grants. GXMU has advantages in the researches on common diseases and frequently-occuring diseases in Guangxi and reached the international advanced level, such as prevention and treatment of regional high-incidence tumor, prevention and treatment of thalassernia,hemoglobin research,snake venom research,prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease,drug research,liver transplantation,finger repantation,perlpheral blood stem cell transplantation,etc. Since the 11th Five-Year Plan,GXMU has won one National Key R&D project,one National Social Science Fund project, and has won grants from the National Science Foundation of China for 808 research projects,ranking in the forefront of universities in Guangxi. Researchers of GXMU have published 3079 SCI papers in top internatiinal journals such as New England Journal of Medicine, Nature Biotechnology and Nature Genetics as the first author or correspondent.More than 270 projects have won National Science and Technology Award,Ministry of Education Science and Technology Award,Guangxi Science and Technology Progress Award and Guangxi Science Award. 5. Joint Degree Program Editor Notes: GXMU will provide more and more joint degree program in the near future. In 2013, the joint bachelor's degree program in Information Management and Information Systemin collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approved by the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. In 2014, the joint bachelor's degree program in Public Service Administration in collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approvedby the Ministry of Education. 6. University Brief Introduction Editor Notes: Guangxi Medical University is recognized by the WHO. Guangxi Medical University (GXMU), founded in 1934, is one of the 22 oldest medical institutes in China and one of the first 8 qualified to enroll international students. It is located in a border city-Nanning, capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. The school covers an area of 98.8 acres and enrolls 8,800 students. Beginning in 1978, international education in GXMU has become rather mature and complete. Currently, more than 300 foreign students from Vietnam, Indonesia, Nepal, India, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and the United States are studying here. The Clinical Medicine in Chinese was set up in 1978, and the English-medium program started in 2001. GXMU has rich experiences in medical education. And, there were graduates for years; the average rate of acquiring Medical License is 90%. In 2008, the English-medium MBBS program is recognized by MOE as the first batch of qualified universities. Now it recruits about 700 international students from India, Nepal, Vietnam, Indonesia, Mauritius, and Sri Lanka, etc. GXMU is recognized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. Learn More>> 7.Campus Life Editor Notes: Students will have a wonderful campus life in GXMU. Campus Gate Xinghu Lake SIE Building

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: The professional training in the coming 6 years will help student acquire new knowledge, attitudes, and skills to become a specialized personnel in medical services, education and scientific research. The program of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery includes three parts During pre-clinical year, the core basic science knowledge which needed to succeed in clinical clerkships will be taught prior to the core clinical knowledge, while the richness of more advanced science is best suited to students when they preparing for the basic medical courses coming ahead. In addition, exposing to Chinese culture is an indispensible experience through the entire process. This part of the curriculum includes Chinese Language, Physics, Chemistry, etc. Following the intellectual transformation that occurs during first year, students will be more receptive to basic medical courses which include Medical Biology, Systematic Anatomy, Regional Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Medical Genetics, Medical Immunology, Medical Microbiology, Parasitology, Pathology, Medical Psychology, Medical Statistics, Clinical Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Diagnostics, Forensic Medicine, Clinical Nutrition, Community Medicine, Laboratory of Cell and Molecular Biology, Laboratory of Microstructure and Laboratory of Functional Experiment. After the first 3 years of the program, emphasis is placed on the clinical sciences. The venue of education transfers from classrooms to the multiple hospitals, clinics, and medical care facilities affiliated with the School. Clinical clerkship last 72 weeks and supplemented by a longitudinal multidisciplinary curriculum that incorporates mentoring, assessment, and ambulatory care experiences. Chinese students under combined bachelor’s/master’s degree programs will participate in this process and mutual help will play a great role in the learning progresses of both side of students. Since this internationalized education program lay emphasis on the liaison between theoretical knowledge and practical skill, students who finish it are expected to be qualified physicians who can manage common diseases independently and adapt easily to healthcare system in their homeland. 2. Major Courses Editor Notes: Please be noted that the courses listed below may change every year. During the 6 years of the curriculum, emphasis is placed on the following courses: Chemistry, Physics, Medical Biology, Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Medical Immunology, Medical Microbiology, Parasitology, Pathology, Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology and Pediatrics. 3. Curriculum Editor Notes: Every semester's curriculums will be adjusted according to the university arrangement at that time. 4. Clinical Clerkship and Clinical Internship Editor Notes: Students can choose to do the internship/training in China, their home country or any other country. The core clinical curriculum includes clinical labs, clinical clerkships and assessment of clinical internship. All students are required to complete the 16-week Medicine, 16-week Surgery, 8-week Pediatrics and 8-week Obstetrics and Gynecology internship. 5. Graduation Editor Notes: Students are required to meet requiremts of graduation before awarding MBBS degree. Students in the international medical undergraduate program must graduate with qualified grade and complete all courses in this program to receive their degree according to Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Academic Degrees and Detailed Rules for degree granting in QDU. 6. About Qingdao University (QDU) Editor Notes: Qingdao University is situated in the eastern coastal city of Qingdao, which is a famous tourist destination and leisure city of China. Qingdao University , situated in the Chinese eastern seaside city Qingdao, faces the Yellow Sea to its south and Mount Fushan as its background, creating a beautiful academic setting. Qingdao University, authorized by the National Committee of Education and Shandong Provincial Shandong Provincial Government in 1993, is a comprehensive university incorporating the former Qingdao University, Shandong Textile Engineering College, Qingdao Medical College and Qingdao Teachers' College, and is now the largest university in Shandong Province. Learn More>> 7. Colourful Life Editor Notes: More colourful activities are provided by QDU. New Year Gala Sports Meeting

fields.description: Program Description 1. Teaching Objective Editor Note: The main objective is to foster engineering and technical talents. Students will learn the principles of chemical engineering and chemical technology, and practice techniques and skills in chemical engineering experiments. The program also offers a foundation in engineering practice, products and technology development, design of manufacturing equipment, research and design methods, and computer application etc. The program aims to cultivate qualified personnel who have strong capabilities in chemical engineering, petrochemical engineering, and coal chemical engineering, as well as matters of environment, biology, medicine, food, metallurgy etc. The students will learn the skills required for research, development and management in chemical engineering and technology. 2. Requirements Editor Note: The graduates would acquire the following knowledge and abilities to become a qualified graduate. Students will have steady foundation in chemistry, mechanics and automatic control, etc. They are able to use Chinese to read Chinese books and magazines of their own specialty and have some skills such as listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, etc. Students will grasp the basic theory and professional knowledge of engineering science required of their specialty. They will possess preliminary capability to use basic applied theory and knowledge to be engaged in the production of chemicals, materials, fuels and pollution control, and to analyze and solve practical problems on chemical engineering, and the potential for technological improvement, scientific development and applied research. Students will have fairly good abilities for experiment test, calculation and expression, and master document retrieval and other methods to acquire scientific and technological information. Students will have a better self-study and work adaptation capability, computer operation and application ability and innovative consciousness. Students will have insight and ability to apply systematic engineering ideas and modern operational knowledge to production and organization management. 3. Why Choose to Study This Program Editor Note: Students will accept morality, intellectuality, physical fitness and engineering training altogether. To cultivate qualified personnel with advanced chemistry technology and engineering knowledge to meet the requirement of modern chemical industry. Graduates will be able to contribute to chemical factories in design, construction, operation and management areas. Graduates will be capable of doing technology development and application research through the all-round morality, intellectuality and physical fitness training and engineering training on production of chemicals, materials, fuels, and pollution control. This program opens only when there are over 10 applicants for this program. 4. Main Courses Editor Note: There are 15 main course set for the program: Inorganic Chemistry Analytical Chemistry Organic Chemistry Physical Chemistry Functional Polymer Instrumental Analysis Chemical Experiments Chemical Technology Chemical Safety Engineering Principles of Chemical Engineering Chemical Equipment Chemistry of Fine Chemical Production Chemical Engineering Instrument & Automation Oil Refinery Technology Introduction to Environment Engineering 5. Internship and Career Development Editor Note: Graduates from this program have many choices to be employed to offer consulting or testing service etc. Chemical engineers can specialize in production of chemicals, materials, fuels, and pollution control. You also can move into other areas such as entrepreneurship and consulting or engineering sales which involves the service and testing for various types of equipment in the industry. 6. Further Study Editor Note: After the undergraduate study, students may choose to pursue a master degree. Graduates with bachelor degree in chemical engineering enjoy an advantage when proceeding further study and applying for a master degree in the leading technological areas such as polymer material, environmental protection, energy engineering, petroleum processing, fertilizer industry, etc. One third of the undergraduates can be admitted to master degree program, since those who have excellent performance during undergraduate study can excuse from examination and directly go on postgraduate study. 7. School Introduction Editor Note: SDUST has the excellent academic performance, deep foundation of culture and a modern open environment. Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More>> About College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering There are 90 staff in the College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, including 17 professors, 6 doctoral supervisors, 41 associate professors, 58 teachers holding doctoral diploma. It sets up the Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Applied Chemistry, Department of Environmental Science & Engineering, Department of Biological Engineering, Department of Energy and Chemical Engineering and Basic Research Center etc. 8. Campus Life Editor Note: By experiencing Chinese life and culture, international students enjoy themselves a lot. Learn Tai-chi Learn in Practice Make "jiaozi"

fields.description: Program Description 1.Program Brief Introduction Editor Note: Students will gain strong abilities in the areas of engineering application and technological innovation. Students on this program will learn fundamental theories of mechanical design, micro-electronic technology, fluid transmission and control technology, computer technology, and information processing technology etc. The program aims to cultivate qualified personnel who have a solid foundation in math and mechanics, and interdisciplinary knowledge of mechatronics, electronics, control and computer technology etc. 2. Teaching Objective Editor Note: This program aims to foster high-level technical professionals with strong ability to solve problems. This program mainly focus on fundamental theory of mechanical design, Microelectronics technology, fluid drive and control technology, the basic knowledge of computer technology and information processing technology. This program cultivates specialists who are proficient in the knowledge of mechanical and electrical hydraulic control, and have fundamental knowledge in the field of major program and professional knowledge of related field. The graduation students would be high-level technical professionals with scientific thinking manner and creative thoughts. 3. Why choose to study this program? Editor Note: Students will be trained to be practical technicians to adapt to the fiercely competitive world. This major is designed to cultivate international practical technical personnel with: Basic principles and knowledge about modern mechanical & electronic technology; Practical skills needed in mechanical designing & mechanical manufacturing; Operating of digital control processing. 4. Main Courses Editor Note: Students will have 8 main courses to study this program. Engineering Mechanics Mechanical Design Mechanical Manufacturing Electrical and Electronic Technology Mechanical Engineering Materials Fundamentals of Manufacturing Technology Digital Control Technology CAD/CAM Technology You can download the newest curriculum here >> 5. Internship and Career Development Editor Note: Graduates generally work as product or management service provider. Graduates are prepared for employment in: Product design, product manufacturing, digital control programming and equipment maintenance in related enterprises. Business management and technology management etc. 6. Further Study Editor Note: After the undergraduate study, students take an advantage to pursue a master degree in various fields. Graduates could apply for a master degree in the leading technological areas such as mechanical and electronic engineering, mechanical design and theory, vehicle engineering, material processing and control engineering, machine design, manufacturing and automation, etc. One third of the undergraduates can be admitted to master degree programs, since those who have excellent performance during undergraduate study can be excused from examination and directly go on postgraduate study. 7. School Introduction Editor Note: One of the best engineering university in China. Shandong University of Science and Technolog y (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More >> 8. College of International Exchange Editor Note: The College is able to offer the best education in cutting-edge disciplines to international students around the world. The College of International Exchange at Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), established in 2007, is an administrative institution for the education of international students, and promotion of the Chinese language and international cooperative education programs, etc. The College attaches great importance to the quality of teaching, and has conducted an all-round innovation in its teaching philosophy, its program delivery model and its management strategies. Ever since its establishment, the number of international students has been on a rapid increase. The College organizes a variety of campus activities for international students each year, including a New Year's party, Graduation Party, Chinese Language Proficiency Competition, Photography Contest, and sports, etc. 9. fields.description: Program Description Length: 5 years Overview: The objective of the program is to train and prepare well-rounded personnel engaged in the field of international economics and trade with solid theoretical foundation of economics and high proficiency in Chinese, who understand the development trends of international economics and the rules, conventions of international trade as well as China's policies on foreign trade. Main courses: Chinese courses: Comprehensive Business Chinese, Spoken Business Chinese, Business Chinese Listening Comprehension, Chinese Characters' reading and Writing, Chinese Visual-Audio-Oral, Newspaper and Periodical Reading, Business Documents Writing, Translation and Interpretation, overview of China, Business English, Contemporary Social Value, survey of China's Laws, etc. Professional courses: Basic Knowledge of Economics, Principal Theory of Economics, Overview of China's Economy, International Marketing, Contract Law, Business administration, Theory of International Trade, International Finance, China's Foreign Trade, International Trade Practice, International Settlements, International Taxation, Introduction to World Economy, Accounting, International Trade in Technology, Securities Analysis and Investment, WTO Rules, Business Negotiations, Politics and Economics in Northeast Asia, etc. Advantages: (1) Teaching professional knowledge and training practical skills in the field of international economics and trade. (2)Attaching great importance to training the practice and application of Business Chinese. (3) Deepening students' understanding of China's condition and culture. (4) Improving students' overall quality, social adaptability and the ability of acquiring new knowledge. General teaching plan It's a five-year undergraduate program and does not require the applicants having Chinese learning experience. We, in the first academic year, prepare our students with Chinese language capabilities for subject learning. And we, in the following four academic years, provide our students with courses in the subjects of economics and trade as well as that of advanced Chinese learning.

In good physical and mental health; in excellent academic standing and with good conduct; abide by the laws and decrees of China and comply with rules and regulations of Chongqing University. 3. Chinese language proficiency: HSK 4 (≥210) or equivalent.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report Applicants shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. * 2. Financial statement or bank statement The available balance should be no less than 30,000 RMB (The minimum amount of financial proof for full scholarship applicants may be appropriately lowered). * 3. A Personal Statement No less than 800 words, stating your basic personal information, hobbies and expertise, motivation, study plan, etc. * 4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form The form shall be filled by the physician in Chinese or English. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the form with a suggestion filled by the doctor. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Attachments of examination results (Laboratory exam report, Electrocardiograph and Chest X-ray report) shall also be uploaded. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. Applicants in China can take the physical examination at the international travel health care center. You can download a template or sample from here . 5. Other Attachments For Arts programs, applicants must have related academic background and are required to submit the portfolio (such as paintings, story scripts, short movies, etc.). 6. Study or Work certificate For applicants who are currently studying or working in an institution, a Certificate of Enrollment or Employment issued by the institution is required. * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Information Page of Ordinary Passport. The passport must remain valid until after September 2025. For applicants who are already in China, a photocopy of Visa or Residence Permit with entry customs stamps should be provided as well. * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. High school official transcripts Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 11. Notarized high school diploma Applicants who have already graduated from high school shall submit graduation certificate of high school. Prospective diploma recipients shall submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by the high school, and bring the official degree diploma for registration if admitted, otherwise the admission qualification will be cancelled. If the original copy is in a different language, a notarized translated version in Chinese or English must be submitted together * 12. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders. 2 Under the age of 25, applicants must have graduated from high school (those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide the graduation certificate no later than registration). 3 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect the normal study. 4 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent resident in foreign country should be obtained prior to the birth of the applicant. Applicants must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022, and must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Note: If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese Citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required. 5 Language Proficiency Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have HSK certificate. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate. No Chinese proficiency is required for the applicants to English-taught programs. If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). 6 Requirements on China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) Please refer to the program catalog.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program is authorized as the most important educational program in Ningbo city. NBU-UM BBA Program (Bachelor Degree), jointly launched in 2006 by Ningbo University in China and the University of Manitoba (UM) in Canada , is the first authorized joint educational program in Ningbo. It adopts the advanced teaching philosophy and teaching administrative system through the introduction of curriculum, course outline and teaching methodology from UM. Both institutes admit credit transfer within the program. Modules Modules Period Location Tuition Fee Diploma/Degree 2+2 The 1st and 2nd years Ningbo University RMB 18,000 per year Undergraduate Diploma and Bachelor Degree by both UM and NBU The 3rd and 4th years University of Manitoba CAD25,000 per year (including tuition fee and moderate living expenses) 4+0 Four years Ningbo University RMB 18,000 per year Undergraduate Diploma and Bachelor Degree by NBU Remarks 1. Students are free to select one of the above-listed modules, upon their first registration at NBU; 2. Regular university scholarships, as well as Overseas Study Scholarship, are available to excellent students; 3. 2+2 module students can further their postgraduate study at UM. 2. Main Course(s) Editor Notes: The main courses are Economics Basic Statistical Analysis Fundamentals of Marketing and Fundamentals of Production and Operations Management, and there are also some other courses in this program. Economics, Introduction to Management and Organization Theory, Basic Statistical Analysis, Introductory Financial Accounting, Commercial Law, Fundamentals of Marketing, Introduction to Organizational Behavior, Human Resources Management, Corporate Finance, Information Systems for Management, Fundamentals of Production and Operations Management. Click here for BA course(s) list 3. Internship and Career Development Editor Notes: This program aims to cultivate the talent of the business strand after student graduate from University joins the enterprises or government maybe is a good choice. The program aims at fostering versatile, innovational, and practical international business managerial professionals equipped with international vision, English proficiency and business expertise in fields of trade, management and research either in the enterprises or in the governments. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Administration 4. Ningbo University Introduction Editor Notes: Rich extra-curriculum activities at Ningbo University will sparkle your boring study time. The University is located in the historical and cultural city of Ningbo of Zhejiang Province, bordering on the East China Sea. Ningbo has long been acclaimed as a thriving commercial port and a shining pearl near the East Sea, and it has gradually grown to be a major city in the Southern part of the Yangtze Delta and a key trading port in the East China. The University has five campuses, covering an area of over 160 hectares, with a floor space totaling 560,000 square meters. The main campus, adjacent to Ningzhen Road in the north and Yongjiang River in the south, offers wide space for study and research with magnificent buildings and pleasant lawns and greenery. Learn More>> 5. Extra curriculum Activities Editor Notes: Rich extra-curriculum activities at Ningbo University will sparkle your boring study time. Ningbo University offers plentiful opportunities for international students to participate in various activities such as Kongfu, Painting, Calligraphy, Dancing, Chess and Traditional Instruments.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens and meet the requirements stipulated in the JWH [2020] No.12 Document issued by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. Applicants shall be physically and mentally healthy and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China and the regulations of Wuhan University. 2. Applicants shall be between 18 and 25 years of age as of Sep. 1, 2025. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit a guarantee letter from their guardians in China when applying. 3. Language Ability Applicants for English-taught programs shall hold a TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essential 8+ or IELTS 6.0+ certificate. Applicants whose mother tongue is English or who have previous degrees taught through the medium of English can be exempted from TOEFL, TOEFL Essential and IELTS if approved by Wuhan University. 4. Identity Verification of Ethnic Chinese If one or both of the applicant's parents are Chinese, or the applicant has emigrated from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality, according to the No.12 Announcement of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), they shall be naturalized for four years or more (before Apr. 30, 2025) and have more than two years of residence in foreign countries during this period (actual residence in a foreign country of more than nine months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). Applicants born in a foreign country are required to meet the above criteria and provide a personal birth certificate and the parents' nationality certificates.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Objectives Editor Notes: After the students complete the 6 years education, the students should be able to obtain some medical skills. Training doctors for the medical and health institutions with good medical professionalism. A solid grasping of the scientific and medical expertise with preliminary clinical competence. Good communication skills, Critical Thinking Self-learning and lifelong learning ability and team spirit of the primary clinician. continue their studies after graduation and practice in various health care systems to lay the necessary foundation. 2. Professional Characteristics and Training Requirements Editor Notes: The objective of the MBBS program is to produce medical undergraduates of international standard. I. Moral and professional requirements: Establish a scientific world outlook, outlook on life, values, and the socialist concept of honor. Care of patients, with a humanitarian spirit; Disease prevention, get rid of the pain and to provide hospice care as their moral responsibility. The concept of lifelong learning, recognizing the importance of continuous self-improvement. In professional activities, focus on medical ethical issues, respect the patient's privacy and personal integrity. Respect for the individual patient beliefs, cultural background and understanding of others' cultural values. Respect for colleagues and other healthcare professionals, there is a collective spirit of cooperation and team work concept of health services. Establishing the legal concept of law practice, learn to use the law to protect the patient and their own interests. In the application of technology to pursue all possible accurate diagnosis or alter the disease process, should take into account the interests of patients and their families, and pay attention to play the maximum effectiveness of available health resources. Spirit of innovation and critical analysis. To perform maintenance of medical ethics obligations. II-knowledge requirements: Master the knowledge of medical-related life sciences, behavioral and social sciences and others and scientific methods, and use them to guide future learning and practice of medicine. All stages of life to master the normal structure and function of the human body, the normal state of mind. All stages of life to master a variety of common disease causes, awareness of environmental factors, social factors and behavioral and psychological factors on the formation and development to the disease, recognizing the importance of disease prevention. All stages of life to master a variety of common disease pathogenesis, clinical manifestations, diagnosis and prevention principles. Master the basic knowledge of Pharmacology and clinical principles of rational use of drugs. Knowledge of normal pregnancy and childbirth, prenatal care and family planning . To master the basic knowledge of general medicine, health education, disease prevention and screening principles, knowledge of mitigation and improvement of illness and disability, rehabilitation and Hospital-related knowledge. Master the knowledge and methods of clinical epidemiology, understand the important role of scientific experiments in medical research. Master the basic rules of the occurrence, development and spread of infectious diseases, and master the principles of prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. III-main skills: The capacity of a comprehensive, systematic, properly to capture the history. The systemic physical and mental examination, specifications, maintaining written records. Strong clinical thinking and communication skills. Good knowledge of various common diseases and their diagnosis and treatments. The general diagnosis, first aid and emergency handling capabilities. According to the clinical circumstances, use the appropriate technology, choose the most appropriate and economical means of diagnosis, treatments. Using the principles of evidence-based medicine to check clinical problems. Ability to engage in basic community health services. Ability to communicate effectively with the patients and their families. To make independent use of books and reference materials. To educate patients and the public about healthy lifestyles, disease prevention and knowledge. With independent learning and lifelong learning s-kills. ​ 3. Teaching Schedule Editor Notes: The minimum credit required for graduation is 239.5 and the following information is for reference only. 4. Graduation Requirements and Other Conditions Editor Notes: International medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree. 1. Course design and teaching arrangements: Combined with our school curriculum reform of clinical medicine, teaching in six-year, specific arrangements as detailed in the teaching schedule. Required courses are divided into general theory classes and practical classes. 2. Performance appraisal: Ideological and moral, Theoretical knowledge and practical skills, Comprehensive evaluation of the ability and physical fitness. Professional assessments focused on student’s academic performance, basic theory, basic skills and proficiency of subspecialities branches (including infections, neurological, psychiatric), surgery, obstetrics and gynaecology etc. 3. Graduation and degree MBBS programs provides students to complete a full course of study and practice of the training and achieve the credits required for graduation, passing the exams. At the time of graduation, a degree is issued according to the conditions of Wuhan University Bachelor degree certification. 5. Requirements for Experimental and Practical Teaching & Internships Editor Notes: WHU would arrange the internship at one of its 2 affiliated hospitals - Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University and Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University. Body functional experiment, Medical Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Diagnostic laboratory, Surgical experiments. Encourages students to take part in a comprehensive and designing experiments, stipulated in the Wuhan University. General practice in internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynaecology, Pediatric. Practical classes conducted before test on completion of a course. Internship: 48 week total of 24 credits. For students who would like to do the internship in China, they should pass the new HSK 4 to contact with the patients. The hospitals have 2800 beds, 15 million out-patients per year, 50,000 in-patients per year, 25,000 major operations and a full list of disciplines covering 100 clinical and auxiliary departments and 30 laboratories. For those who do their internships in other countries, WHU need to do a qualification evaluation on the chosen hospital. After the internship, if they have finished the graduation thesis and thesis defense in the first five years, they can get their diploma. If they can't return to China, the school can provide mail service. Students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in WHU before graduation. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: Wuhan University is a Public, 985 Project Comprehensive university. Wuhan University , is a key university directly under the administration of the Education Ministry of the People's Republic of China. It is located in Hubei Province's capital Wuhan known as "The thoroughfare leading to nine provinces". The university has rolling physical features with the scenic Luojia Hill in it and the beautiful East Lake by its side, seeming in picturesque disorder, Learn More>> 7. School of Medicine Editor Notes: Clinical Medicine is "undergraduate brand specialty" among medical schools under Ministry of Education of China. The school has two Provincial Demonstration Centers of Experimental Teaching. There are 11 indirect affiliated teaching hospitals, which are all first class hospitals. It keeps good relationships and collaborates with hospitals and institutes. There are 5 schools, 6 research centers and 3 A-Level Grade Ⅲ affiliated hospitals. There are 5080 beds, 15 million out-patients per year, 50,000 in-patients per year, 25,000 major operations and a full list of disciplines covering 100 clinical and auxiliary departments and 30 laboratories in these hospitals. 1125 of faculty are professors, chief physicians, associate professors and deputy chief physicians with an impressive figure of 2500. The school involves more than 5,100 students, including 3,000 undergraduates, 1,500 graduates and 600 foreign students. 8. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Program Learning Recreational Activities

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study Plan * 2. Chinese Proficiency Certificate All applicants who want to apply for Chinese-taught program must provide HSK certificate. * 3. Self-support students must provide the guarantor’s passport copy and the certificate of work or income. * 4. Colored scanned copy of the passport Passport must open and applicants must provide scan copy of the first page and second page of passport. * 5. Digital photo(100-500K, with white background) * 6. Academic transcript of Highest Degree Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Highest degree of education (notarized copy) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report * 2. Notarized Highest Diploma (High school certificate) Prospective diploma winners must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 3. Academic transcripts (written in Chinese or English) Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 4. Financial Statement: Evidence of financial support 5. Others: all kinds of certificates, including sports, arts and other relevant certificates, are warmly welcome. * 6. Resume Your CV must be up to date, covering all your experiences, including education and employment experience. * 7. Certificate of HSK Level 4 or above. * 8. One photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. If you are not in China, please provide the Physical Examination form. If you are already in China, the valid visa page is required The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered as invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. Personal Statement Please write your personal introduction and study plan in your personal statement in Chinese or English. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Non-criminal proof * 3. Proof of Economic Ability Proof of on-the-job income, bank deposit, or other proof of economic ability. 4. Other materials Students majoring art&design must provide 5-10 photocopy of personal paintings or design works. * 5. Certificate of HSK * 6. Passport Information Page With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 7. Academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Notarized highest education Graduation Certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Prospective graduates who have not been awarded graduation certificates shall provide an official letter confirming the expected graduation. * 9. Study plan At least 800 words in Chinese. * 10. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements: (1) Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. (2) High school graduate (or above) with qualifications eligible for university admission. (3) Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. Nationality Eligibility In accordance with relevant regulations, including the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, the Measures for the Administration of School Recruitment and Cultivation of International Students (Joint Decree No. 42 of the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Public Security), and the Notice on Regulating the Enrollment of International Students in Higher Education Institutions in China Jiao Wai Han [2020]No. 12): (1) For applicants who were born in a foreign country and held foreign nationality at birth, the applicants' parent/s (Chinese-citizen side) must have obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants' birth. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad (outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2023, and April 30, 2027 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). 3. For the required CSCA test subjects , please refer to Fudan University 2027 English-taught Undergraduate Programs . 4. Proof of English proficiency. TOEFL iBT score of ≥ 90 (New TOEFL ≥ 4.5), or IELTS ≥ 6.5, or Duolingo English Test ≥ 110, or PTE Academic ≥61. Applicants whose native language is English or who graduated from a high school fully taught in English can be exempt from this requirement. 5. (1) Color weakness and color blindness are not suitable； (2) Applicants must have excellent Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology background.

fields.description: Program Description Course Introduction 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program is open to international students intending to pursue the science and practice of medicine. Aims to nurture high-caliber medical graduates with solid medical knowledge, competent clinical skills, and professionalism. Have the ability to work in medical and health institutions. Make meaningful contributions to the areas of patient care, education, and research. Emphasis on technical skills, interdisciplinary studies, and clinical practice. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: There are three main categories -- as well as 16 main courses for the program. Curriculum (for reference only) Course Categories Course Chinese Culture & Natural Science Courses Brief Introduction to China Chinese Language Medical Chinese Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biological Sciences Computers Organic Chemistry Liberal Arts & Basic Medicine Courses Histoembryology Anatomy Cell Biology Genetics Physiology Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Immunology Microbiology Parasitology Pathophysiology Pathology Medical Ethics Pharmacology Clinical Medicine Courses Diagnostics Diagnostic Imaging Medicine Surgery Obstetrics and Gynecology Pediatrics Preventive Medicine Epidemiology Medical Psychology Psychiatry Neurology Dermatology Oncology Ophthalmology Otolaryngology Stomatology Forensic Medicine Traditional Chinese Medicine 3. Internship Information Editor Notes: Students will have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The internship starts in the last 1 year. 11 affiliated hospitals, of which eight are level three first-class hospitals.. Have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The tuition for the internship year is still RMB 75,000/year. 4. Degree Awarded You'll be shown how the MBBS Degree is awarded and what you should do after obtaining your MBBS degree MBBS Degree Awarded: After completing the required number of credits, students will be conferred a diploma from Fudan University, and qualified students will receive a degree of Bachelor of Medicine and the Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS). After Obtaining MBBS Degree: Graduates will have the opportunity to register for medical licensing exams in accordance with the requirements of the relevant regulatory bodies of the countries in which they choose to practice. School Introduction 5. Brief Introduction to Fudan University Fudan University was established in 1905 as Fudan Public School. As one of the first participants in the 211 and 985 Projects, Fudan has developed into a comprehensive research university, with Departments of Philosophy, Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Management. After years of exploring and practicing, Fudan has now established its own curriculum and management system, both of which are unique and progressively improving. Learn More about Fudan University 6. About International Students Office(ISO) Take the charge of management and coordination of admission for international degree and non-degree students. Be responsibale for visa processing, residence permit application, insurance affairs. The duty of ISO is researching and drafting management policies regarding international students, management of the International Students Dormitory.
