fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

(2) Mathematics Mathematics exams are mandatory for all majors. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. High school graduate certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 2. High school academic transcript Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Study Plan (more than 800 words written in Chinese or English) * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. Passport(photo and visa page) * 8. Photo(bust portrait in dark clothes against white background) * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. An English proficiency of IELTS 6.0, a TOEFL score of 82 or passing NCU' s English test is required for programs taught in English. 2. A senior high school diploma. 3. 18-25 years old. Special Note: For all undergraduate programs, applicants are required to submit the Chinese Scholastic Competence Assessment for International Undergraduates (CSCA) transcript. Specifically: 1.For Chinese-taught programs in liberal arts and business, applicants must submit at least the Mathematics and Chinese (Humanities) scores. 2.For Chinese-taught programs in science, engineering, and medicine, applicants must submit at least the Mathematics (required), Chinese (Humanities), and either Physics or Chemistry scores. 3.For English-taught programs in liberal arts and business, applicants must submit at least the Mathematics score. 4.For English-taught programs in science, engineering, and medicine, applicants must submit at least the Mathematics (required) and either Physics or Chemistry scores.

fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction The university offers flexible language courses. Enrollments are available in March and September during each academic year. Students can enroll in Elementary, Intermediate, or Advanced Courses according to their level of Chinese proficiency. Small classes or individual teaching are available upon request. Teaching Objective Through the long-term learning and traveling, international students will have a better understanding of China. Besides, learning Chinese helps foreign students widen their horizons and acquire knowledge and experience for their future career. Courses or Lectures The university offers an excellent language learning environment. The teaching of Chinese as a second language includes such courses as Basic Chinese, Practical Chinese, and Works from Chinese Literature and HSK Training and so on. Courses offered are determined on the basis of the level and request of the students. Elective courses including: Bettering Pronunciation in Chinese, Reading and Writing Chinese Characters, Chinese Calligraphy with Pen, Ancient Chinese Language, A Brief History of China, Chinese Traditional Music, Chinese Opera for Appreciation, Taiji, Chinese Wushu, Chinese Painting, Preparations for HSK Test, etc.. click here for long-term Chinese language program curriculum Placement Test A placement test, both oral and written, is given at the beginning of a new semester to the new students to see the level of their listening, speaking, reading and writing. On this basis, they will be placed in different classes in order for the teachers to teach according to their respective level, thus ensuring the quality of teaching. Levels and Classes Classes are usually divided into elementary level, intermediate level, and advanced level, and each level may be subdivided if needed. Students will be recommended to study in a class which fits their level of Chinese according the results of the placement test. Courses and Textbooks We highly recommend the textbook series of Chinese as a second language published by Beijing University of Language and Culture for the teaching of language skills, language knowledge, and cultural aspects.

fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction This program is taught in BESU-Solbridge. International Finance is the branch of economics that studies the dynamics of exchange rates, foreign investment, and how these affect international trade. It also studies international projects, international investments and capital flows, and trade deficits. It includes the study of futures, options and currency swaps. All courses instruction and discussions of contemporary business issues are done in English, drawing on the vast knowledge and experience of our international faculty. You will acquire business knowledge and intercultural skills, which are highly sought after in a range of international institutions. Teaching Objective The aim is to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. Main Courses To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. China Financial Systems Financial Markets and Institutions International Investment Analysis M&A and Investment Banking Commercial Banking Private Equity and Venture Capital Financial Reporting and Analysis Internship and Career Development Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation.The school has so far signed an agreement about internship bases, with S.F-Express, chamber of commerce - China's ambassador to Thailand (including the Bank of China and , Haire company - Thailand branch ), Industrial and Commercial Bank of China- Indonesia branch. Graduate careers within the general domain of English and finance include administrative, managerial, accounting and consultancy positions within international organisations. You may also be able to pursue a career as a professional translator or interpreter. Additionally, the course provides a foundation for further graduate level study in the subjects of English language and finance. Degree Awarded After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .

There is international faculty and international environment. Here, you can get the best Chinese business studies, and language culture. Chinese Business Studies is a well-tailored, economics-based, multi-disciplinary program focusing on specific areas relevant to doing business in China. China's increasing integration into the world economy and strong economic growth has provided tremendous opportunities for international business. To seize these opportunities, foreign enterprises face the challenge of adjusting their way of doing business in China. We strongly believe that understanding the evolving business environment in China, especially the political economy of China's policy-making, is the key to successful business in China. Teaching Objective The aim is to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. fields.description: Program Description Economics is often emphasis on the teaching of theoretical knowledge than international trade or other courses. Main Courses and credits Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. More majors will be offered as enrollment expands such as Accounting and East Asian Studies (jointly offered with Nagoya University and Soongsil University) Compulsory Courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Accounting 3 Selected Topics in WTO and China 2 Intermediate Microeconomics 3 Chinese Economy 2 Intermediate Macroeconomics 3 Corporate Finance 3 Statistical Methods in Economics and Business 3 Investment Analysis 3 Legal Studies 3 Principles of Marketing 3 Econometrics 3 Chinese Business Law 2 Research Seminars 2 Applied Econometrics 3 Economics Research 3 Advanced International Trade Theory and Policy 3 History of Economic Thoughts 2 Financial Markets 3 Money and Banking 3 Principles of Management 2 Transnational Management 2 International Transportation and Logistics 3 Students may opt for one of the following two tracks or choose an individualized approach to complete 8 credits of courses across the tracks suggested below: Track 1 Track 2 Advanced Microeconomics 4 Applied International Economics 3 Advanced Macroeconomics 4 Applied Industrial Organization 3 Applied Public Finance 2 Internship and Career Development UIBE has special apartment to help international student find internship and employ chances in good companies and organizations. Thesis In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. The length of the thesis should be around 8000 words. The thesis is a milestone assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Specifically, students, must demonstrate the ability to apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills required for their disciplines as well as essential learning outcomes including the breadth and the depth of their knowledge, critical and creative thinking, problem solving, the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Economics Academic Semesters There are 3 semesters in one academic year: fall, spring and summer. Fall and spring semesters consist of 14 weeks of normal classes and a summer term consists of 8 weeks of classes (except Practicum and Internship). Fall Semester: the beginning of September to next January Spring Semester: the beginning of March to the beginning of July Summer Vacation: the beginning of July to the end of August Time Registration Time of Spring Semester: February 27-March 2 Beginning Time of Spring Semester: March 5 Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program cultivate students to be professionals in Business Administration. To train international students with high moral, good health, good knowledge and innovative spirit. Be able to engage in various fields of marketing, marketing management, senior international corporate marketing and global marketing. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program aims to cultivate students to be professionals in this field. Have a good knowledge of Chinese culture, politics, economy and history. Understanding Chinese language, including in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation proficiently. To master the necessary computer skills. Have the ability of the basic theory of economics, business management, marketing and international business, the basic knowledge and skills. To master certain analytical ability, creativity and decision-making ability. 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. Compulsory courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Principles of Management 3 Consumer Behavior 2 Principles of Marketing 3 Service Marketing 2 Introduction to Financial Accounting 3 Marketing Channels 2 Corporate Finance 3 Business to Business Marketing 2 Organizational Behavior 3 Advertising and Promotion 2 Business Research 3 Management Accounting 2 Strategic Management 2 Financial Statement Analysis 2 Transnational Management 2 Investment Analysis 2 Cross-cultural Management 2 Intermediate Microeconomics 3 Operation Management 2 Chinese Business Law 2 Human Resources Management 2 International Trade Practice 3 Leadership 2 International Finance 2 Global Marketing 2 International Business Environment 2 International Corporate Finance 2 Data Model and Decision Making 2 4. Academic Semesters Editor Notes: There are 3 semesters in one academic year: fall, spring and summer. Fall and spring semesters consist of 14 weeks of normal classes and a summer term consists of 8 weeks of classes (except Practicum and Internship). Fall Semester: the beginning of September to next January Spring Semester: the beginning of March to the beginning of July Summer Vacation: the beginning of July to the end of August Time Registration Time of Spring Semester : February 27-March 2 Beginning Time of Spring Semester: March 5 Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package. 5. Thesis Editor Notes: In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. ​ The thesis should consists of about 8000 words. The thesis shall be an assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Students should apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills. Students should use the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner.​ 6. Internship and Career Development Editor Notes: The program will cultivate students with professional skills to function effectively and competitively in social and global environment. The university participates actively in promoting business and economic cooperation between China and other countries. Students have the opportunities to do a part-time job or internship at the multinational or other big companies with various fields. Students can search on school website to find a good job, as lots of companies post their recruitment advertisement on the website. Students can either stay in China or return to their own countries to work for the company who have trade with China. Students can work in the sales of products or services and management, such as sales representatives, sales managers, sales consultants. Students can be suitable in circulation enterprises, production-oriented enterprises, the service sector and other industries engaged in marketing, research, planning or other management. 7. School introduction Editor Notes: UIBE is one of the important stations for talents' training and scientific research on Chinese economic and business development. ​ The University of International Business and Economics (UIBE) , situated in the northeast of Beijing, was founded in 1951. UIBE is a national key university under the leadership of the Ministry of Education, and is also a part of "Project 211", a governmental program aimed at turning about 100 Chinese universities into exceptionally high quality academic institutions in the 21st century , Learn More>> 8. Business School Editor Notes: The School pays much attention to the systematic integration of business management subjects. The University has established exchange projects with over 100 universities and institutes from more than 30 countries and regions around the world.​ ​ The School offers many opportunities to gain practical professional experience and understanding of Chinese culture & language. The School focuses on training business management talents with an international strategic vision. There are over 41 professional teachers and part-time teachers in this major. The School has rich teaching experience, professional high-quality, high academic qualification and reasonable structure. 9. Faculty Editor Notes: Two professors will be introduced specifically. Fan Libo, Associate Dean of Business School; Professor of Management; PhD; PhD Supervisor Research area : cross-national Management & Operation, Strategic Management, Innovation and Corporate Theory. Teaching area: (bachelor) principles of management, international business management, research methods and thesis writing; (master, including MBA) teaching management theory, strategic management, mergers and acquisitions and restructuring; (doctor) management theory. Shao Jing, Professor of Management; postdoctoral (The University of British Columbia) Research area: supply chain management, game theory application, operating and marketing fields Teaching area: principle of management 10. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Extracurricular Activities Recreational Activities ​

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports, with good moral character, in good physical and mental health, and have high school or equivalent qualifications, may apply. Applicants should be eighteen (18) years old or above, as of 31 August 2022. According to Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of China: if either parent is a Chinese citizen who has settled in a foreign country, so that the applicant has foreign nationality at birth, the applicant does not have Chinese nationality. From 2021 onwards, applicants for entry into this University for undergraduate education as international students must, in addition to meeting the school's other qualifications, hold a valid foreign passport that was obtained before 30 April 2018, or have a proof of nationality. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than two years between 30 April 2018 and 30 April 2022 (The actual residence in a foreign country for nine months of the year can be calculated as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps). Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan residents who apply to enter our undergraduate level as international students, after emigrating and acquiring foreign nationality, shall hold a valid foreign passport or a proof of nationality that was obtained before 30 April 2018. Such residents should also have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than two years between 30 April 2018 and 30 April 2022 (the actual residence in a foreign country for nine months of the year can be calculated as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps). Chinese program: Applicants whose native language is not Chinese need to provide HSK level 4 (inclusive) or above certificate.

fields.description: Program Description This program aims to train students to master systematically the fundamental theories, professional knowledge, and practical skills of acupuncture, moxibustion and tuina, as well as be equipped with independent learning ability. Graduates can engage in clinical practice in Acupuncture, Tuina or Chinese medicine departments in healthcare organizations, or in areas such as teaching, research and administration. Students will learn more than 2000 hours of compulsory Acupuncture, Moxibustion and Tuina courses and general education that are integrated throughout the curriculum. Acupuncture specialty courses include: Basic courses of Traditional Chinese Medicine (including Fundamental Theory of TCM, TCM Diagnosis, etc.); courses of the Classics of Chinese medicine (including Shang Han Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage); Jin Gui Yao Lue (Prescriptions from the Golden Coffer, etc.); Acupuncture-Moxibustion and Tuina courses (including Meridians and Acupuncture points, Acupuncture and Moxibustion Therapy, etc.); Basic Medical Courses (including pharmacology, pathology, etc.); Clinical courses of Chinese medicine (including Chinese Internal Medicine, Chinese Gynecology, etc.); and Clinical courses of Western Medicine (including Internal Medicine, Fundamentals of Diagnostics). General education courses include: Traditional Chinese Culture, Chinese Language and so on. Based on the learning content, course teachers will use different teaching and learning strategies, including classroom lectures, group discussion, bedside teaching, demonstration, practical skills training, clinical internship, and community service. The focus will be on developing the student’s basic professional skills in Acupuncture needling and Moxibustion, as well as Tuina manipulation techniques.

CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: This program aims to train medical undergraduates with systematic knowledge of basic and clinical medicine and basic abilities to work in clinical settings. To cultivate graduates who possess solid medical knowledge, professional clinical skills, good occupational qualities and preliminary clinical abilities. Help to lay a foundation for further education and the development in medical research, health administrative management, and so on. Aims to develop the knowledge of humanities, social sciences and natural sciences, the respect for individual beliefs, life and law, as well as team spirit and creativity. Students are to master basic medical knowledge, and fundamental theories and skills. Aims to develop scientific and critical thinking, the ability to independently acquire knowledge, raise questions, analyze questions and resolve questions, as well as the ability of lifelong learning and self-development. Students are to basically master Chinese language and knowledge of China and Chinese culture. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Students will study at least 20 relevant medical courses. Anthropotomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Medical Microbiology, Immunology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Hygiene, Physical diagnostics, Medical Imageology, Experimental Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Gynemetrics, Pediatrics, Neurology, Lemology, Emergency Medicine. 3. Teaching Schedule Editor Notes: Every year there may some changes, thus it is only for reference. School time totals to 306 weeks, with 158 weeks of teaching, 20 weeks of exam, 2 weeks of enrolment and graduation orientation, 70 weeks of graduation internship, 48 weeks of vacation and 8 weeks of flexible time. Teaching periods total to 3713 and credits total to 276.5, with 3506 periods and 191.5credits of required courses, 255 periods and 12.5 credits of elective courses,70 credits of graduation internship and 3 credits of graduation examination (of theories and skills). Schedulefor each semester is as follows. 4. Assessment Editor Notes: International students are required to abide by the rules of assessment. Required courses are assessed with either examination or evaluation. Credits are obtained when the course is passed. Results are measured with hundred-mark system. Examinationis arranged by the university and Evaluation is conducted at the end of the course by each teaching and research division. Elective courses are assessed at the end of the course by each teaching and research division and credits are awarded with a pass. The assessment of each course should be based on the syllable. Clinical internship and other practices are assessed by each clinical medical school with skill and theory exams organized by each teaching and research division. Inaddition to the assessment of each course, students must also pass graduation exams, which are scheduled in the 12th semester, including clinical skill exam and theoretical exam. 5. Internship Editor Notes: Mainly clinical clerkship and internship for not less than 70 weeks. Graduation internship is scheduled in the 10th, 11th and 12th semesters, of 70 weeks with 16 weeks of internal medicine, 16 weeks of surgery,6 weeks of obstetrics and gynecology, 6 weeks of pediatrics, 2 weeks of emergency,1 week of prevention, 1 week of nursing and 20 weeks of specialized internship or internship in home country, 2 weeks of orientation and 2 weeks ofassessment. The assessment is specified separately. 6. Graduation​ Editor Notes: After meeting graduation requirements, international students will be awarded MBBS degree. Students will be mainly engaged in clinical medical treatment, medical scientific research and medical teaching in medical and scientific research institutions and medical schools after graduation. Students who complete and pass all the courses required in the curriculum, obtain required credits for elective courses, pass graduation exams and meet the graduation requirements shall be allowed to graduate. Students who meet the requirements in "PRC Degree Regulations" and "Fujian MedicalUniversity Bachelor Degree Conferment Regulations" shall be granted Bachelor of Medicine& Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS). 7. Brief Fujian Medical University Editor Notes: A provincial key university for priority development focusing on medicine and paying attention to harmonious development of multiple disciplines, such as science, management, law, arts and engineering. Fujian Medical University (FMU), located in Fuzhou, the capital city of Fujian Province, serves as a center for teaching, research, treatment, and prevention, and provides other social services.Currently FMU has two campuses in Shangjie and Taijiang, with a total land area of about 87 hectares and a building area of 379,000 square meters. Learn More about Fujian Medical University>> 8. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are lots of activities that international students can choose to take part in. New Year Party Voluntary Service Activities

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: The program is aimed for making you to be medical professionals with strong potential to meet the needs of modern medical development. Designed to train students who are enabled to develop morally, intellectually, physically and aesthetically as clinical specialists. Be armed with sound basic knowledge expertise, and skills in modern medicine. Can be qualified for teaching and research work done in the field of clinical medicine. To do the internship in the JNU First Affiliated Hospital. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Students will study a various kind of medical courses. Systemic Anatomy, Histology & Embryology, Human Physiology, Pathology, Medical Microbiology, Pharmacology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics, Pediatrics, Preventive and Social Medicine, etc. Click here for more courses details >> 3. Graduation​ Editor Notes: Upon meeting the requirements and pass graduation exam, you will be awarded degree certificate. On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by Jinan University, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state Bachelor's degree in Medicine. 4. Brief Introduction to Jinan University Editor Notes: Chemistry, Clinical Medicine, Biology & Biochemistry, Pharmacology & Toxicology, Material Science, Engineering and Agricultural Sciences rank top 1% in the world. Jinan University, established in 1906, is a comprehensive university under the joint leadership of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the Education Ministry of P. R. China. The university is one of the top 100 national key universities in China. Adhering to the principle of "Oriented to students from overseas, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan", Jinan University now has over 23,000 full time students, including 10,609 students from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and foreign countries, which comprises the largest number of overseas students in China. Learn More about Jinan University>> 5. About School of Medicine Editor Notes: School of Medicine is recognized by WHO and faculty members are extremely excellent. The School of Medicine at Jinan University was the first medical school in China within a comprehensive university. Registered with the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1984, enabling international graduates to attend the qualification exam for doctors in their home countries. Rated as an Outstanding Doctor Training Pilot Project School and boasts a highly qualified and specialized teaching team. Faculty members have won national and/or provincial awards; and published articles in internationally renowned publications including Science, Nature Medicine and The Lancet.

The courses taught in English of this major offered by Management School. Students trained under this program should 1. have a good mastery of basic theory, expertise and skills in the field of management science, economics, accounting and auditing. 2. have a good mastery of qualitative and quantitative analysis methods in accounting and auditing. 3. have a reasonably strong ability of oral and verbal expression, inter-personal communication, information acquisition and basic ability to solve accounting and auditing problems. 4. keep well-informed of the policies and regulation in the accounting and auditing fields both at home and abroad and international accounting and auditing practices. 5. have a sound knowledge of the latest achievements and the trend of development in the academic field; 6. have a sound mastery of basic methods of literature retrieval; and be able to do practical work and scientific research. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Graduation from high school or equivalent educational background. Prospective graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school and obtain their high school diploma before enrollment. 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, in compliance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education, including the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC “, etc. 3. Good physical and mental health, with no criminal record. 4. English language requirements For non-native speakers of English, either TOEFL (iBT, code: 6210) or IELTS score is required. 4.1 TOEFL (iBT, including the Home Edition and Paper Edition): 90 or above; TOEFL Essentials: 10 or above. 4.2 IELTS: 6 or above. Exceptions: You may be exempted from providing any of these exams if your SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing score is 650 or above, if both your ACT Reading and English scores are 27 or above, or if you have recently completed at least 4 years of rigorous academic study in any of the following countries: Anguilla, Antigua, Barbuda, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Canada (except Quebec), Cayman Islands, Dominica, England, Federated, Northern Ireland, Scotland, Seychelles, Shetland Islands, St. Kitts-Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United States (other than Puerto Rico), US Virgin Islands, Wales, and Singapore. (Those in American Schools and British Schools abroad may also be exempted if at least 4 years of rigorous academic study have recently been completed and if test scores meet the above standards.) 5. Test Scores 5.1 China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), Score with Mathematics is required. Applicants who have not yet taken the CSCA may submit other Test score materials initially (such as SAT /AP/ACT /A-Level/IB (code: N010601)/UEC/UNT/SJTU entrance test/others). Those who pass the university's selection process will receive a pre-admission notice and must supplement their CSCA scores by June 30, 2026. Upon passing the final selection, a formal admission notice will be issued. a. SAT (code: 6563) or ACT (code: 6983) test scores. Scores with writing test scores are preferred. 2025 First-year admitted class test scores of Middle 50th percentile ranges: SAT total score: 1350-1450 SAT Math: 730-790 ACT total score: 30-33 ACT Math: 28-35 b. A-level scores, you need to apply with Math A or above. c. International Baccalaureate (IB), you need to apply with Math HL 5 or above or SL 7 in Math or above. Predicted A-level or IB scores are NOT accepted. d. Students with valid college entrance exam scores, please contact the International Undergraduate Recruitment Office at gc-admissions@sjtu.edu.cn (e.g., Malaysia UEC exam scores, Kazakhstan UNT scores. France National Exam scores, etc.) e. If you don’t have any exam scores mentioned above, you have an option to take the SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam in spring 2026 with other international students. SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam *Applicants for Engineering Cluster program in English must complete application Exam Registration: Applicants should log in to the Study@SJTU online application system to choose the undergraduate English-taught Program, fill in the application form, submit the electronic version of application materials and complete exam. Application Time: February 6, 2026~ March 10, 2026(Beijing Time, GMT+8) Exam Method: Online Exam Time: Scheduled for March 21–22, 2026. Detailed schedule will be notified via email later. Subjects for Test The outline and sample of the Written Test： Math: Outline Sample Physics: Outline Sample English: Outline Listening (The Hand book of the exam is to be announced later.)

fields.description: Program Description Founded in 1896, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is one of the internationally recognized, top-tier research universities in China, with strong commitment to nurturing future leaders with innovative drives and global visions. The Engineering Cluster Program is a new undergraduate international program designed to combine the strengths of engineering-related fields at SJTU. Offering all major courses in English or French, the Cluster Program welcomes prospective students with an interest in engineering studies from all over the world. The SJTU Undergraduate Engineering Cluster program in English includes: -The University of Michigan-Shanghai Jiao Tong University (UM-SJTU) Joint Institute (JI) -School of Materials Science and Engineering -School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering -School of Naval Architecture, Ocean and Civil Engineering -School of Mechanical Engineering The Cluster Program covers various engineering-related disciplines such as: -Mechanical Engineering -Electrical and Computer Engineering -Materials Science and Engineering -Computer Science and Technology -Information Engineering -Automation -Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering -Power and Energy Engineering -And more Cluster students will take introductory engineering courses in the first 1.5 years at the UM-SJTU Joint Institute. After meeting this requirement, Cluster students may choose to continue their studies at the UM-SJTU Joint Institute or transfer to another engineering school (in English or Chinese) to complete their bachelor's degree. Reminder: Although all Cluster courses are taught in English, Cluster students are required to take Chinese culture and language courses while enrolling in their respective degree programs. All Cluster students are expected to meet HSK 4 (Chinese Language Test) as the minimal Chinese language requirement for graduation. Exceptions include Cluster students enrolling in the UM-SJTU Dual Degree Program, JI-KTH 3+2 Bachelor's Program, or other international programs.

fields.description: Program Description Core curriculum: Fundamentals of Engineering Control, Material Mechanics, Engineering Mechanics, Engineering Measurement Technology, Fluid Mechanics, Machine Design, Advanced Design Methodology, Machinery Manufacturing Equipment and Technology, Machine Vision and Applications, Fundamentals of Robotics, etc. Mechanical Science and Technology is one of the broadest and most versatile of the engineering professions. This can be seen in the portfolio of current activities in the departments. Now, our Huazhong University of Science and Technology's faculty are involved in projects ranging from the use of mechatronic engineering to develop advanced manufacturing to the creation of multi-legged robots; from the design of mechanical products to the development of advance numerical equipment and technology. Teaching Objective This specialty fosters high-ranking engineering talents of product and equipment measurement, production process control, product quality assurance technology, and special equipment design and development in a variety of industries of manufacturing, energy, transportation, chemical engineering, medicine, and agriculture and forestry. The talents of this specialty possess solid mathematical and scientific basic knowledge with basic skills of light, mechanical, electrical, computer applications and other important and extensive technologies to benefit for the further work and research. Main Courses and Credits Courses Characteristic It carries out postgraduate training and scientific research of management science and engineering It emphasizes on engineering background of management discipline. From the point of view of system with information technology as a method, the industrial system, production system, management system, logistics system and supply chain management and all kinds of system operation process with its laws are studied. This specialty is jointly run by the school and Huddersfield University of England. The outstanding undergraduate can be directly recommended to study in the UK for the master's degree. Our undergraduate programs combine a broad-based education in the mechanical science and engineering with a strong grounding in advanced manufacturing, problem solution, mechanical design, and communications skills. By emphasizing both classic and creative methods, SMSE gives students the broad skills set which they can use to pursue their goals—working as an engineer, founding a company, continuing on to further study and research of mechanical engineering or other majors. We train independent learning by hands-on laboratory and manufacturing projects, and we help our students grow as talents with the spirit of striving, teamwork, agility, and responsibility. Course Structure The specialty direction of Mechanical Manufacturing and Automation includes mechatronics, manufacturing, and design. The students can choose the direction in accordance with social development and personal interesting to make the self-design and personality development of talents more responsive to social development click here for course details Futhur Study Graduate programs of SMSE attract students with a variety of backgrounds, interests, and talents. We provide extensive opportunities for graduate students to engage in advanced research and collaborate with faculty and colleagues.The mechanical engineering department provides opportunities for graduate work leading to the Master’s programs, PhD programs, Post-doctoral program . School of Mechanical Science and Engineering Introduction This program is taught by School of Mechanical Science and Engineering,which founded in 1593, the School of Mechanical Science and Engineering has the same history with HUST of over 60 years with 71 professors and 80 associate professors. It has won more than 50 national awards, owned more than 300 patents, fostered 7 high-tech industry companies in these years. The SMSE has held more than 10 international and domestic academic meetings and has carried out over 10 international joint research projects, as well as establishing an extensive cooperation in education and research with many renowned universities, research institutes and companies in America, Britain, Japan, Korea, Russia Australia, Singapore and so on. In 2014, SMSE has over 2000 undergraduates and 1250 graduates, including more than 100 international students.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The program requires students to understand the basic contents of the subject and its importance. It is required to pass the examinations of all courses respectively. The institutions shall meticulously organize the reasonable arrangement of the internship. The duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks). The Chinese language shall be a compulsory course during the whole undergraduate medical program in English for international students in China. ​ ​ 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: The whole program includes 3 main courses. 2.1 The curriculum planning shall include the following three parts: (1) Chinese culture and natural science courses, including an overview of China's culture Chinese language Chinese medical terminology mathematics physics chemistry biology physical education (2) Basic medical sciences behavioral science humanities social science and medical ethics preventive medicine and clinical medicine (3) Internship. The institutions shall meticulously organize the reasonable arrangement of the internship. The duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks). 2.2 Main Courses Pathology-II Pathophysiology Regional Anatomy Forensic Medicine Pharmacology-I Physical Diagnosis Pharmacology-II Introductory Surgery Dermatology Medicine-I Medicine-II Infectious Diseases Surgery-I Paediatrics-I Obstetrics & Gynaecology-I Medicine-III Surgery-II Paediatrics-II Obstetrics & Gynaecology-II Stomatology Ophthalmology Otorhinolarygology Nuclear Medicine Surgery-III Emergency Medicine Medical Technic Training before Clinical Internship 2.3 Curriculum You could download the Curriculum Schedule for MBBS as a reference here. 3. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: I nternational medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the UJS. ​MBBS Degree: Students should firstly complete the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully. International medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the UJS, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery).​ 4. Internship and Career Editor Notes: Students can choose to do internship in China, their home country or any other country. ​ The internship lasts for 1 year (at least 48 weeks). If students do internship in China, they must pass the HSK 6 and the university will help arrange the internship in the affiliated hospitals. Applicats can choose to live in the school dormitory or rent a house near the hospitals. After the internship, students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in UJS before graduation. After obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council. Students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. One can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master’s degree.​ 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Jiangsu University is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities, Learn More>> 6. School of Clinical Medicine Editor Notes: School of Clinical Medicine has undertaken rapid development, s ince the beginning of this century. The school has conducted research and academic exchanges with University of Montreal, Canada, the medical school of the University of Hong Kong, and other institutions. In the past few years, the employment rates of the students graduated are above 97% and the employers, winning high praise. Graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS etc. It is made up of a Research Center, a Teaching Experimental Center and 8 departments. It sets 11 provincial key disciplines and 5 national key construction disciplines. There are over 300 professors and associate professors, 6 PhD supervisors and 128 master’s supervisors. Each year about 90 international students from India, Africa, Canada and Pakistan etc 16 countries come to study MBBS. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. ​​ Chinese Customs JSU’s Medical School has first-class facilities on campus, purpose built for learning. The teaching and learning buildings are well-equipped with excellent seminar facilities and dedicated problem based learning rooms. The University’s Affiliated Hospital, is a state-of-the-art building offering a superb teaching environment with a dedicated clinical skills teaching area for the students. It possess excellent clinical and surgical facilities all of which each student gets chances to learn and work in. ​​

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants should be between18-35 years old(No later than Dec.31st of that year,Dec.31st included.),high school graduate or above, non-Chinese citizen with non-criminal record, in good health and with a good command of English (IELTS6.5/TOEFLIBT 85 or above). Applicants who are native English-speakers or have studied in English-taught high schools are not required to submit English proficiency certificates. The No.12 Document of 2020 issued by the Ministry of Education, PRC is administered by the University. Two important items of the Document are to note. First, according to Article 5 of Nationality Law of The People's Republic of China,‘a person whose parents are both Chinese nationals and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese national and has settled abroad, and who has acquired foreign nationality at birth shall not have Chinese nationality. Since 2021, those applying to study at universities or junior colleges as international students, should satisfy the following additional requirements: the applicants must hold valid foreign passport or other relevant international recognized documents for at least 4 years; meanwhile,in the latest 4 years(by each April 30th of the year of University registration), the applicants must live overseas for 2 years(Living overseas for 9 months can be converted to 1 year, which is subject to the exit-entry stamp on visa.). Second, those who immigrated to other countries from the Mainland China,HongKong, Macao or Taiwan and apply to study as international students at universities or junior colleges of China are required to satisfy the requirement of the first item. If the applicant is under the age of 18 before 31st August of the application year, the guardian is required to provide supplementary materials. See"IV. Application Materials" for details. For students applying for MBBS, the subjects of the CSCA exam you need to take are Mathematics and Chemistry (the test papers are in English).

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After systematic learning and meeting graduation requirements, students will be awarded MBBS degree. Students will be given the bachelor's degree of medicine if they pass the graduation exam (including exam on medical knowledge and exam on clinical skills) . The program pays much attention to cultivating clinicians who have profound professional integrity, solid ground of basic medicine and systematic knowledge of clinical medicine and have acquired basic clinical skills as well as the ability to deal with problems in clinical settings. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: There are foundamental, basic medical and clinical courses in this program. 2.1 Main Courses human anatomy, histoembryology, physiology, cytology and biochemistry, medical genetics, immunology, pathogenic biology, pathology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, diagnostics, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, traditional Chinese medicine, psychiatry, etc. 2.2 Teaching Arrangement for MBBS 2.3 Credit Requirements The students should complete 203.5 credits, among which premed pubic courses are 26.5 credits, basic medical courses 48.5 credits and clinical medical courses 54.5 credits. The clinical rotation makes 74 credits. 2.4 Internship and Career Internship: Tongji University has 5 affiliated hospitals (t he duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks) : Tongji hospital, Shanghai No. 10 People's Hospital, East Hospital, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Health Hospital. Notes: These are all high level hospitals and have 4,443 beds altogether. Students must take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in WHU. Career: The graduates will be able to apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council to get registered and practice medicine, when they obtain MBBS Degree. Students have to do the degree accreditation first because of the regulations in different countries. Students who obtain MBBS degree can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Students can also open his own clinic or continuely study for master's degree. 3. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: Students will be given a medical degree by Tongji University. MBBS Degree : Students who meet the requirements of the teaching program and pass the graduation examinations successfully will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the Tongji University. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: Tongji University has been included in the State-founded Project 211 and the 21st Century Education Rejuvenation Action Plan of China. After the establishment of the People's Republic of China in 1949, Tongji University became an engineering university following a nationwide restructuring of institutions of higher learning in 1952. It was the largest university of civil engineering and offered the most specialized engineering programs in China. The university has developed rapidly into a multidisciplinary university featuring sciences, engineering, economics, management, liberal arts and law, with the initiation of the open up policy under the authorization of the central government in 1978 , Learn More>> 5. The Medical School Editor Notes: Tongji University began recruiting foreign students since the 1950s. ​ The Medical School has cooperated with University of Leipzig, University of Phillip-Marburg. Student exchange has been carried out with Paris V, University of Ulm, University of Leipzig and University of Phillip-Marburg on. Three high-level cardiology workshops have been co-organized by American Cardiology College and the Medical School have. The Medical School has been authorized as the high-qualified university to offer MBBS program in English. 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Chinese Calligraphy Chinese Contest ​​ Talent Show

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. 2. Sufficient financial resources; no criminal record. 3. Applicants who meet the following conditions are eligible to apply as international students: (1) Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hongkong, Taiwan or Macao, and have obtained a foreign nationality. (2) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at the time of birth, and whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality (nationalities) and reside abroad. --- International applicants in the above situation must fulfill both two conditions following: ① Applicants must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), which means having acquired a foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. ② Applicants must have lived outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period from May 1, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (according to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year). 4. Age Requirements: Self-funded applicants: be at least 16 years old and under the age of 35. 5. Educational Background: have obtained a graduation certificate of higher secondary school, or its international equivalent, qualified for university entrance. 6. Language Proficiency: For Chinese-taught programs: a minimum HSK Level 4 Certificate (score ≥180) & provide HSKK score. Important Note: To enroll in an undergraduate program at Donghua University, applicants must possess genuine Chinese proficiency equivalent to HSK Level 5 (with a minimum score of 180) or higher. Higher scores are strongly preferred. An HSK Level 4 score (above 180) or an HSK Level 5 score (below 180) can only be used for application purposes and is only valid during the application stage. If a conditional offer is received, a newly obtained HSK Level 5 certificate (with a score above 180) must be submitted to the university before the enrollment & registration. Failure to do so will result in the inability to register and commence undergraduate studies. ① The test date on the certificate must be on or after September 1, 2024. ② Applicants whose higher secondary school curriculum and teaching-related activities were conducted entirely in Chinese may be exempted from submitting an HSK certificate. However, a certificate issued and officially stamped/signed by the school confirming that all courses and teaching activities were conducted entirely in Chinese must be provided. ③ Applicants who graduated from a full Chinese-medium high school program before September 1, 2024, must submit the required HSK certificate and HSKK score report as specified above. 7. CSCA Score Report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) For Chinese-taught Programs: Mandatory subjects are Professional Chinese (Humanities) or Professional Chinese (STEM), as well as Mathematics. Other required subjects should be checked here .

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of no criminal conviction Issued by the local public security authority or relevant government department in the applicant's location. The issue date should be on or after November 1, 2025. * 2. Statement of financial support To be filled out and signed by the applicant and the financial guarantor. The signing date should be on or after November 1, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Curriculum Vitae (1) Written in the teaching language of the applied DHU program. (2) Include basic personal information, self-assessment, hobbies and interests, skills and strengths, contact details, and educational background (with timelines precise to the month). (3) List participation in relevant activities or competitions, internships or practical experiences, honors or awards received, and certificates of competency, etc. Relevant certificates and supporting documents can be merged into one PDF file and uploaded under "Other Supplementary Documents" session. 4. Mandatory for application of art design related programs 1. Applicants for the Chinese-taught program majored in Fashion & Apparel Design, Product Design, Environmental Design, Visual Communication Design, Digital Media Art, or Art & Technology, you are required to submit the original latest art works: at least two hand-painted pencil sketch, two hand-painted color painting, and three design rendering relating to the applied program. 2. For applications to the two English-taught programs, a video-formatted personal art portfolio must be submitted. The video should feature explanations in English, covering the applicant's design concepts, demonstrating their understanding of professional knowledge, mastery of skills, and creativity, with a duration of approximately 3 minutes. 3. If notified by Donghua University via email to participate in an art examination or related interview (latest by June), applicants should respond and participate as scheduled. The results will serve as an important reference for the university's decision. * 5. Chinese Language Credential * 6. Passport (and visa) page A clear copy of your valid passport with your name, photo, date of birth, place of birth, date of issue and date of expiry. The passport should have at least 6-month validity. All visa pages are required if you have been to or if you are currently in China. * 7. ID photo Recent bareheaded (within six months), full-face, white-color background, two-inch certificate photo, instead of landscape photos or photos of daily life; in JPG format, less than 100K. * 8. Personal statement (1) Written in the teaching language of the applied DHU program, approximately 1000 words. (2) Describe family background and educational experience, reasons for choosing the major and motivation for application, significant experiences and gains related to the applied major, academic and career prospects and plans, etc., to showcase personal thoughts and characteristics, abilities, and strengths. (3) Must include the applicant's full name, the applied major, personal email address, and the date of writing at the end of the statement. * 9. High school academic transcripts Copies of the original certificate with the high school stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. Students who are currently in the final year can submit a pending certificate along with transcripts of all grades you completed. You are required to submit the official certificate and final transcripts once you receive them. * 10. High school graduation certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or Copies of the original certificate with the high school stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the original is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized. Students who are currently in the final year can submit a pending certificate along with transcripts of all grades you completed. It contains every respect of the subjects and has the best equipment. Details>> An introduction to the design 2 Color picture (2) 2 Computer design software 2.5 Basic photography 2 Design sketch (1) 2 Basic modeling (1) 2 Three-dimensional composition 2.5 sculpture 2.5 Engineering and drafting 2 Computer design software application (1) 2 Initial environmental design 3 Building interior design (1) 2.5 Chinese and foreign history of architecture and interior design 2 Landscape design (1) 2 Display design Multimedia technology 2 Layout design 2 The traditional Chinese painting 2 Manual printing and dyeing 2.5 Craft art history in the west 2 Ring art computer animation research 2 Building interior design (3) 3 Landscape design (2) 3 Environmental facilities design 2 Building structures and equipment 2 Garden design 2.5 Urban planning and design 2 Lighting design Internship and Career Development Internship : the practical stages include drawing practice, professional investigation, design practice, graduation design, etc. Students are trained to analyze and solve problems so that they can keep up with the development of society and market. Career Development : Graduates mainly work with large design institutes, construction and decoration companies, property firm, art business and exhibition agency, engaged in designing, education, research and management. Some graduates choose to start their own business. Note: Students who have an insurance should deliver an attachment or a photocopy; students who don\'t have an insurance should buy one at school, the fee is 300 RMB/ smester.

Applicants under 18 years of age should provide a guaranty from a guardian. Applicants who were previously Chinese citizens and have subsequently acquired foreign nationality shall meet the requirements in the relevant regulations of China's Ministry of Education. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: Computer Science and Technology is one of the characteristic majors of Jiangsu province. Provides a strong technical background for students planning to begin careers upon graduation and for those interested in graduate study in computer science. Emphasis is placed on developing both the software programming and hardware design necessary to begin and enhance an individual's career. Graduates of this program are well prepared for immediate employment in either the computer industry or many other businesses that increasingly rely on computer science. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed below. 2.1 Key Courses 2.2 Curriculum Schedule for the CST ofJiangsu University Note: It may change every year, so it is only for reference. Type A Courses Type B Courses Type C Courses Type D Courses Type E Courses 2.3 The Allocation of Credits and course 3. Internship Practice and Graduation Editor Notes: The graduate employment rates has been among the best. The school has several computer laboratories with high class servers where students are practicing during their studies. Also through associations at the university students can connect with companies which can help them conduct an internship. Graduates engage in the computer software and hardware applications, development, research and teaching, etc. in enterprises, government departments, research departments and institutions of higher learning, also can apply for further studies in computer science graduate. 4. Brief Introduction to Jiangsu University(JSU) Editor Notes: JSU ranks 39 among >3000 higher educational institutions in China. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities. Learn More>> 5. About Overseas Education College (OEC) Editor Notes: OEC is responsible for foreign students' admission, academic affairs, routine administration and organizing Chinese international education. OEC has established a scholarship system and is now providing students with scholarships of different types. OEC pays attention to cultural inheritance and therefore organizes foreign students to take part in various activities in and outside university. OEC has always been trying to help foreign students understand Chinese culture and feel the happiness of study in China. 6. Colourful Life Editor Notes: OEC occasionally holds different activities or events which help foreign and Chinese students communicate and build up an internationalized atmosphere on campus. “Chinese Bridge" Competition Dragon Boat Race

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens and meet the requirements stipulated in the JWH [2020] No.12 Document issued by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. Applicants shall be physically and mentally healthy and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China and the regulations of Wuhan University. 2. Applicants shall be between 18 and 25 years of age as of Sep. 1, 2025. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit a guarantee letter from their guardians in China when applying. 3. Language Ability Applicants for English-taught programs shall hold a TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essential 8+ or IELTS 6.0+ certificate. Applicants whose mother tongue is English or who have previous degrees taught through the medium of English can be exempted from TOEFL, TOEFL Essential and IELTS if approved by Wuhan University. 4. Identity Verification of Ethnic Chinese If one or both of the applicant's parents are Chinese, or the applicant has emigrated from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality, according to the No.12 Announcement of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), they shall be naturalized for four years or more (before Apr. 30, 2025) and have more than two years of residence in foreign countries during this period (actual residence in a foreign country of more than nine months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). Applicants born in a foreign country are required to meet the above criteria and provide a personal birth certificate and the parents' nationality certificates.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: This program is designed for training high-level comprehensive software talents with international standard and rich practicing experience. Based on the requirements of informative development of the national economy. Graduates will be well qualified in software system design, implementation & testing and software project management, etc. Featured in organizing and standardizing software developing processe with engineering principles and methods. Mainly study software developing methods & environments, software tools & integration techniques, software automation & testing techniques, software quality control, and software reuse techniques, etc. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Students will study a various kind of courses including primary courses and core major courses, etc. Primary Courses: Discrete Mathematics, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Principles of Operation Systems, etc. Core Major Courses: Software engineering, Database systems, Compiler and Interpreter, Algorithm analysis & design, Computer Network, User Interface Design, System-level programming, etc. Featured courses: Team motivation & communication, Technology & Policy, Cognitive science, British & American Culture, Agile software development, Database design, Oracle application development, Data Mining & Analysis, Business Intelligence, Search Engine Technology, and Mid-ware Technology, etc. Summer Schedule Period of Time Study Arrangement Organization Credit Summer following semester 4 Technological study Project training Certificate examination Two technological directions: Microsoft and IBM, initiated by both ISS and software company 2 Summer following semester 6 Project practice Internship in software company 2 *The above information is for reference only. 3. Graduation​ Requirements Editor Notes: After meeting graduation requirements, international students will be awarded Bachelor Degree. Basic theoretical knowledge of computer software; Fluent user of modern software engineering techniques & methods as well as mainstream software developing tools, environments and platforms; Good command of English; Capable of engineering project design, developing & management; Innovative team worker; Meeting four basic requirements: strong sense of responsibility & mission; with cultural background, scientific concept and wide & profound professional bases; spirit & capability of creation, innovation and entrepreneurship; with global perspective. 4. Brief Introduction to Wuhan University Editor Notes: It is also one of the "211 Project" and "985 Project"universities as well as one of the earliest comprehensive national universities in modern China. The history of Wuhan University can be traced back to Ziqiang Institute, which was founded in 1893 by Zhang Zhidong, the then governor of Hubei Province and Hunan Province in the late Qing Dynasty. In the process of development and evolution, the institute changed its name several times before it was finally named Wuhan National University in 1928. It is one of the earliest comprehensive national universities in modern China. Learn More about Wuhan University>> 5. About School of International Education(SIE) Editor Notes: SIE is one of the first members to have passed the certification of studying abroad in China. Be responsible for international students' enrollment and cultivation, education and research on teaching Chinese as a foreign language, studying abroad education and the above-related daily administration. SIE also takes in charge of Center of Teaching Resources Research and Development for International Promotion of Chinese. SIE is the attestation center of TCSOL & TCFL, the studying abroad training base of Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange. One of the centers of HSK examination, BCT examination and the qualification examination for the teachers teaching Chinese to foreigners in China. Takes in charge of Center of Teaching Resources Research and Development for International Promotion of Chinese. 6. Colourful Life Editor Notes: WHU offers the opportunity for students to explore, to try something new, and experience colorful campus lives. There are about 300 student clubs and a wide range of student activities running year-round. International Cultural Festival New Students at Welcoming Ceremony​

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary private passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met (Link). 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2023, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, the Chinese-citizen parent must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 2. General Requirements 2.1 In principle, between 18 and 25 years of age. Applicants must graduate from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, be friendly toward China, and have no record of violations of law or criminal offenses. 2.3 Applicants must provide qualifying Language Proficiency Certificate, a China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report: Mathematics, Chemistry. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.0 overall or above (academic module) with a minimum of 5.0 in each component. TOEFL-iBT: 75 or above with a minimum of 15 in Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing. Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE): 170 or above Duolingo: 100 or above. Submission of IB, A-level or other international standardized test score reports, or a full high-school English-medium instruction certificate for applicants with full English-taught high school education, can exempt the applicant from providing an English proficiency certificate. Other requirements:: Applicants must have scored 70% or above in Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Zoology & Botany) during high school. 4. Offered at the International Schoolof Medicine(located in Yiwu City).
