fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The aim of this major is to cultivate high-level talents. This program provides talents to serve for the region's foreign economic relations, foreign trade, foreign investment, and the strategy of "going out". The major combines international economics and trade theories, policies with business practices closely. Students are required broader knowledge theoretically and politically along with better English skill and operational international trade ability. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2. It takes 4-6 years to complete this program generally. International students can start their major directly after they come to China. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes with Chinese peers for Chinese-medium courses. 3. Internship Editor Notes: Internship in companies are provided in this program. Students can have up to 12-weeks internship in companies under the guidance of professors. 4. Language Requirement Editor Notes: International students are required to pass HSK 4 before graduation. English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 4 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Main Research Fields Editor Notes: There are 3 kinds of research fields in this program. 1.International economics trade theory and policy (1) International service trade (2) New theories of international economics and trade (3) Trade and environment (4) Multinational companies and international trade 2.Forestry products trade (1)International trade practice of forestry products (2) Forestry products trade theories 3.International trade practice 6. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 7. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid ordinary foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. 2. Sufficient financial resources; no criminal record. 3. Applicants who meet the following conditions are eligible to apply as international students: (1) Applicants who emigrated from mainland China, Hongkong, Taiwan or Macao, and have obtained a foreign nationality. (2) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at the time of birth, and whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality (nationalities) and reside abroad. --- International applicants in the above situation must fulfill both two conditions following: ① Applicants must have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), which means having acquired a foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. ② Applicants must have lived outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for at least two years during the period from May 1, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (according to the entry and exit record, if the applicant has stayed outside mainland China/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan for nine months or longer period during one year, it is equivalent to one year). 4. Age Requirements: Self-funded applicants: be at least 16 years old and under the age of 35. 5. Educational Background: have obtained a graduation certificate of higher secondary school, or its international equivalent, qualified for university entrance. 6. Language Proficiency: For Chinese-taught programs: a minimum HSK Level 4 Certificate (score ≥180) & provide HSKK score. Important Note: To enroll in an undergraduate program at Donghua University, applicants must possess genuine Chinese proficiency equivalent to HSK Level 5 (with a minimum score of 180) or higher. Higher scores are strongly preferred. An HSK Level 4 score (above 180) or an HSK Level 5 score (below 180) can only be used for application purposes and is only valid during the application stage. If a conditional offer is received, a newly obtained HSK Level 5 certificate (with a score above 180) must be submitted to the university before the enrollment & registration. Failure to do so will result in the inability to register and commence undergraduate studies. ① The test date on the certificate must be on or after September 1, 2024. ② Applicants whose higher secondary school curriculum and teaching-related activities were conducted entirely in Chinese may be exempted from submitting an HSK certificate. However, a certificate issued and officially stamped/signed by the school confirming that all courses and teaching activities were conducted entirely in Chinese must be provided. ③ Applicants who graduated from a full Chinese-medium high school program before September 1, 2024, must submit the required HSK certificate and HSKK score report as specified above. 7. CSCA Score Report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) For Chinese-taught Programs: Mandatory subjects are Professional Chinese (Humanities) or Professional Chinese (STEM), as well as Mathematics. Other required subjects should be checked here .

fields.description: Program Description CIP offers four-year rigorous and practical education through lectures, expert seminars, and team-based student projects in eight semesters. Students can finish the program in minimum 3 years with good study planning. The maximum study length is 6 years. Students with good Chinese language skills before the start of the program are qualified to apply for the exemption of Chinese language courses up to 28 credits. Qualified students will have opportunities to study as an exchange student in our partner universities in another country for a semester (except for the first year and last semester in the program). Students with valid HSK level 4 certificate and GPA above 3 are qualified to apply for minor in Chinese language in the first year of study. Program Requirements Students are required to meet following requirements to graduate: Complete about 155 credits, including required courses, elective courses, thesis, community service, graduate internship and other practicum in 3-6 years. Pass all the required courses and the GPA for all the required courses is above 1.7 Submit graduation thesis and pass the thesis defense Attend minimum15 seminars and 15 immersion week activities Have minimum 90 hours of community service Have minimum 1 month of graduation internship in an organization in the last academic year, and the evaluation is above average Other practicum requirements Receive HSK level 4 certificate within 2 years before graduation (HSK is the official Chinese language proficiency test) No undue payment to the university No violation of Chinese law and regulation and no disciplinary action on file Chinese Related Courses Chinese Language Courses Comprehensive Chinese I, II, III,& IV Intermediate Oral Chinese HSK Preparation Course Learning Chinese through Chinese Songs and more Courses to Introduce China General Outline of China Chinese Calligraphy & Painting Chinese Tradition Philosophy and Its influence on Contemporary China Understand China through Chinese Literature Comparison among China, Korea and Japan Courses related to Chinese Business Chinese Business Culture & Etiquette Chinese Economy and Society Doing Business with China and Europe And more General Knowledge Skill related Courses Road to College Success Fundamental Math Math for Commerce I & II Advanced Application of MS Office (Office 2013) Physical Education Courses (Yoga, Ballroom Dancing, Rock Climbing, Rocky, Floor Ball, and etc.) And more Academic English Courses Academic Language Preparatory Course Academic Writing Presentation Skills Business & Technical Writing And more Basic Business Subjects Introduction to Business Introduction to economics Microeconomics Macroeconomics Management Essential Marketing Essential Cross-Cultural Communication Statistics Essentials Business Ethics and Social Responsibilities Principle of Accounting I Business Law Research Methodology Entrepreneurship and Innovation Practicum Seminars (International forum) Community System Service Marketing and Management E-Business Quality Management International Business Human Resource Management Strategic Management Managerial Accounting Operations Management Elective fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: After 4-years' study, students can do a broad range of research activitie. Aerospace Engineering is a four-year program. Undergraduates will have specialized courses from this unique specialty after they have completed the General Education Courses, Basic Technical Courses and Specialized Courses. Students shall develop balanced qualities among morals, intelligence and physical education and obtain basic qualification for being senior engineers in our college. The graduates will be capable doing a broad range of research activities, such as flight vehicle conceptual design, structure design, structure dynamics analysis, flight mechanics and dynamics, aerodynamic engineering calculation of flight vehicle, spacecraft dynamics and control, system simulation and computer application, automatic control engineering, and doing research and development works in other related field. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses list below are only for reference as it may change every year. General design of missile, structural mechanics of aircraft, structural design, general design of space vehicle, aerodynamics engineering calculation of aircraft, flight trajectory of missile, dynamic characteristics analysis of missile, flight mechanics of spacecraft, foundation of satellite positioning 3. Introduction of School of Astronautics Editor Notes: School of Astronautics is one of the earliest to focus on the astronautical technology in China. School of Astronautics was founded in 1958, based on Department of Aerospace Engineering and is one of the earliest to focus on the astronautical technology in China. In December 1988, Department of Aerospace Engineering was developed into School of Aerospace Engineering, and in July 2003 it was officially renamed as School of Astronautics. After 50 years' development, the School of Astronautics has formed a high-leveled team led by academicians and well-known experts. By May 2013, there are 124 full-time staff, including: 31 professors, 35 associate professors, 28 doctoral supervisors, 6 administrative staff and 10 experimental technicians. 104 teachers hold a doctor's degree, accounting for 84% of the total number. There are 2 members of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. Currently, school of astronautics is composed of 5 departments, 1 research institution, 2 National Key Laboratory, 2 Provincial Key Laboratory and Engineering Research Center . There are 3 Post-doctoral Research Center: Aeronautical and Astronautical Science and Technology, Control Theory and Control Engineering, Armament Science and Technology. It provides 4 bachelor degree programs: Flight Vehicle Designand Engineering; Detection, Guidance and Control; Flight Vehicle Propulsion Engineering and aerospace engineering. Currently, there are 1500 students studying in the school, 800 of which are undergraduates. Following the spirit of NPU, which is “firm basic knowledge, industries and serious work, plain and guileless style, creative and brave innovation”, School of Astronautics has made remarkable achievement in training students and had high social reputation. It has cultivated more than 6000 senior talents specialized in aeronautics and astronautics, 2 of which are China's Top Ten Outstanding Youth. Aiming at applying basic research into practice and meeting needs of national strategy, School of Astronautics undertook many research tasks and a number of important research results have been achieved, including development of more than 20 types of space vehicles, carrier rocket and satellites. The school was cited by Manned Space Engineering Office for it's remarkable contributions to China’s first manned flight test. School of Astronautics has become an influential institute in training excellent students and doing scientific research. 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: NPU has gained international recognition for its work in the fields of aeronautics, astronautics, and marine technology. Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU) is classed as a key university in China's 985 and 211 Projects, and is affiliated to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It is also a member of the “Excellent Union 9 (E9)” in China. Originally founded as the State Northwest Polytechnic Institute in 1938, NPU has developed into an open and research-oriented University by bringing its founding spirit of inquiry and innovation into a wide-ranging curriculum that now includes the Humanities, Law, Management and Foreign Languages. And by incorporating three of China's leading engineering schools， NPU has gained international recognition for its work in the fields of aeronautics, astronautics, and marine technology. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are a variety kind of activities international students can choose to take part in. A Wonderful Basketball Match Root-Seeking Journey

fields.description: Program Description 1. Major Introduction Editor Notes: After studying this program, students have an chance to join in the double master degree program of NPU and foreign college. The specialty is key Specialty of national defense and characteristic specialty of Shaanxi Province. Students of the specialty can take part in the double master degree program of NPU and foreign college through personnel selection. The specialty, with widely specialized subjects and strong adaptability, focuses on strong electricity, assisted with weak electricity. It has become a teaching and scientific research base for the specialist in the field of Electrical Engineering and Automation both in civil and military realms, with the features of aeronautics, astronautics and nautical. The specialty of Electrical Engineering and Automation was founded in Harbin Institute of Military Engineering in 1953, and the entire establishment merged with NPU in 1970. In 2003, the Department of Electrical Engineering was established based on this specialty, which was the first level discipline authorized to grant doctorate degree. Currently, the department subordinates three second-class disciplines, including Power Electronics and Power Drives, Electric Machines and Electric Apparatus and Power System and Its Automation. 2. Core Courses Editor Notes: As too many courses are in this speciality, so there are only listed 4 core courses for reference. Electrical Machine Power Electronics Power System Electrical Drive and Control System 3. School of Mechanical Engineering Editor Notes: Automation, Electrical Engineering and Robot Engineering are three key specialities of the school. School of Automation's origins can be traced back to the 1950s. In 1959, the “ninth department” was founded in Northwestern Polytechnical University, which contains majors of aircraft instrument sensor, aviation gyroscope design, optical Instrument and guidance, air micro-motor design, autopilot and etc. In 1953, the Air Force Engineering, Harbin Military Engineering Institute was established, containing the aircraft autopilot, aircraft electrical equipment, professional aviation fire and sights. And in 1970, it was moved to the “ninth department” of Northwestern Polytechnical University. The School of Automation was established in 2003 (the “ninth school”). 4. Northwestern Polytechnical University(NPU ) Introduction Editor Notes: NPU has gained international recognition for its work in the fields of aeronautics, astronautics, and marine technology. Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU) is classed as a key university in China's 985 and 211 Projects, and is affiliated to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It is also a member of the "Excellent Union 9 (E9)" in China. Originally founded as the State Northwest Polytechnic Institute in 1938, NPU has developed into an open and research-oriented University by bringing its founding spirit of inquiry and innovation into a wide-ranging curriculum that now includes the Humanities, Law, Management and Foreign Languages. And by incorporating three of China's leading engineering schools, NPU has gained international recognition for its work in the fields of aeronautics, astronautics, and marine technology. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are a variety kind of activities international students can choose to take part in. A Wonderful Basketball Match Root-Seeking Journey

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements: Applicants should, in principle, be between 18 and 25 years of age (calculated as of September 1, 2008), in good physical and mental health(free from infectious diseases and from any physical or mental conditions that would affect normal study) , with a high school diploma, or have an equivalent qualification of a Chinese high school diploma and above stages (As of September 1, 2026, the applicant must have obtained a high school diploma).They must demonstrate excellent academic performance and conduct, comply with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, hold a valid foreign passport, and be non-Chinese citizens who are friendly toward China and have no criminal record. 2. Nationality Determination: According to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and the regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (Jiaowaihan [2020] No. 12), individuals whose parents are both Chinese citizens or one of whom is a Chinese citizen and who have settled abroad, and who acquired foreign nationality at birth, are not considered Chinese nationals. As foreign student applicants, such individuals must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification before April 30, 2022, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). 3. Special Residency Cases:In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, residents of Mainland China, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region, and Taiwan who have immigrated and acquired foreign nationality must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification beforeApril 30, 2022,and have a certificate of having canceled Chinese nationality, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). Notes: Whether an applicant who holds foreign nationality also holds the nationality of the People’s Republic of China shall be determined based on the nationality determination issued by the Exit and Entry Administration of the Chinese public security authorities. If the applicant is found to hold Chinese nationality during the application process, admission process, or after enrollment, their application eligibility, admission eligibility, or enrollment status shall be revoked, or corresponding measures shall be taken. 4. [Language Proficiency]HSK Level 5 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section; HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above, with a minimum score of 60 (all results must be within the validity period). Notes: For programs offered by the School of Broadcasting and Anchoring, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For programs offered by the School of International Studies, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Network and New Media (Operation of Intelligent Media Convergence) applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Chinese Language and Literature, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 4 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. Malaysian high school graduates from Chinese independent schools can submit their UEC exam results. Applicants with passing grades in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK certificates. Other Malaysian applicants must meet the HSK language proficiency requirements outlined above. For applicants whose native language is not English, relevant English proficiency certificates or test results may be submitted as supplementary materials. If oral test results are already included on the HSK score report, submission of a separate HSKK score report is not required. 5. [China Scholastic Competency Assessment for Undergraduate Study in China (CSCA)] Applicants are required to submit their CSCA test results or a screenshot of test registration by April 30, 2026 (application deadline). The required test subjects are as follows: 6. Videos: Self-introduction, recitation and talent showcase.

Nationality Determination: According to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and the regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (Jiaowaihan [2020] No. 12), individuals whose parents are both Chinese citizens or one of whom is a Chinese citizen and who have settled abroad, and who acquired foreign nationality at birth, are not considered Chinese nationals. As foreign student applicants, such individuals must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification before April 30, 2022, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). 3. Special Residency Cases:In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, residents of Mainland China, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region, and Taiwan who have immigrated and acquired foreign nationality must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification beforeApril 30, 2022,and have a certificate of having canceled Chinese nationality, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). Notes: Whether an applicant who holds foreign nationality also holds the nationality of the People’s Republic of China shall be determined based on the nationality determination issued by the Exit and Entry Administration of the Chinese public security authorities. If the applicant is found to hold Chinese nationality during the application process, admission process, or after enrollment, their application eligibility, admission eligibility, or enrollment status shall be revoked, or corresponding measures shall be taken. 4. [Language Proficiency]HSK Level 5 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section; HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above, with a minimum score of 60 (all results must be within the validity period). Notes: For programs offered by the School of Broadcasting and Anchoring, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For programs offered by the School of International Studies, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Network and New Media (Operation of Intelligent Media Convergence) applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Chinese Language and Literature, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 4 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. Malaysian high school graduates from Chinese independent schools can submit their UEC exam results. Applicants with passing grades in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK certificates. Other Malaysian applicants must meet the HSK language proficiency requirements outlined above. For applicants whose native language is not English, relevant English proficiency certificates or test results may be submitted as supplementary materials. If oral test results are already included on the HSK score report, submission of a separate HSKK score report is not required. 5. [China Scholastic Competency Assessment for Undergraduate Study in China (CSCA)] Applicants are required to submit their CSCA test results or a screenshot of test registration by April 30, 2026 (application deadline). The required test subjects are as follows:

CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Objectives Editor Notes: After learning this major, graduates will gain knowledge from at least 3 disciplines. The program will culminate in a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree. Graduates will gain knowledge from nursing, humanities, and other sciences and disciplines; apply concepts and knowledge of leadership, teaching, quality improvement and patient safety in nursing; provide nursing interventions based on research findings and evidence; use critical thinking to provide holistic care across lifespan in a variety of healthcare centres. 2. Education Standard Editor Notes: International students will graduate successfully upon meeting the following requirements. Upon the completion of the program, the graduate is to meet the requirements as follows: 1. Knowledge: the graduate should have a basic understanding of nursing related natural science, humanities and social science, master the knowledge about nursing theory, human anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology; the effect of biology, psychology, social factors in the development of disease; the nursing procedure for patients with common disease and critical illness; the psychological characteristics of various patients and corresponding interventions; the health promotion for people across lifespan; a basic understanding of Traditional Chinese Medicine. 2. Quality: The graduate should demonstrate high-level professionalism, show great respect toward life, culture, belief, religion and custom; highlight innovation, critical thinking and self-directed learning; value the team-work, work collaboratively with co-workers from other disciplines; have the idea of the cost-effectiveness. 3. Skill and Ability: The graduate should have the basic skills and abilities in communicating with patients across lifespan and professionals from other disciplines; apply nursing procedure and techniques to provide high-quality holistic care to 12 different patients; apply nursing research skills to provide evidence-based nursing; provide prevention and health care in the community level; have certain communication ability with Chinese language. 3 .Core Courses Editor Notes: Students can gain lots of knowledge from core courses. The introduction to nursing (nursing theory, history), Human anatomy, Physiology, Fundamentals of Nursing-Ⅰ &Ⅱ ,Pharmacology, Pathology, Health assessment and promotion, Medical Nursing-Ⅰ &Ⅱ , Surgical Nursing Ⅰ &Ⅱ , Emergency Nursing, Maternal and infant care, Nursing care of children, Mental health nursing, Clinical Practice. 4. Learning and Teaching Strategy Editor Notes: High-fidelity patient simulation and case study will help students to learn this major deeply. The programme consists of two semesters and 16 weeks in duration per annum. Block periods of study will be followed by block periods of practice. Each 16 contact hours convert to 1 credit point (The ratio between contact hours and self-directed learning hours are 1:2-3). High-fidelity patient simulation will be systematically used to enable students to develop confidence in their practice skills within a safe and controlled environment. Case study will be integrated to offer students the opportunity to rehearse and enhance psychomotor skills. 5. Clinical Practice and Internship Editor Notes: 36 hours/week's clinical practice will enable students to apply the theoretical learning and consult with clinical tutors. It includes Clinical Practice in semester Ⅲ, Ⅳ,Ⅴ, Ⅵ, Internship. International students will work 36 hours per week in clinical practice, which enables them to apply the theoretical learning and consult with clinical tutors. Practice Placements The school collaborates with three key hospitals for the programme, and these hospitals have qualified clinical mentors for international students. These placement areas are selected and monitored with caution to ensure that they are conducive to the achievement of the learning outcomes. Evidence based nursing practice is a core aspect of the curriculum. Awareness of this will be endorsed through the careful collaboration between academic staff and clinical mentors in guiding and helping students. Academic support for students/mentors in placements Clinical Practice Facilitators will be assigned for international students in every placement throughout the programme. They will meet regularly with their students individually and in groups in the practice placement. Assessment of practice. The clinical mentor will evaluate students' theoretical and clinical performance. All students must pass both components to pass the unit. 6. The Requirements for Graduation Editor Notes: After meeting graduation requirements, students will be awarded Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). 1．Length of Schooling：The length of schooling is flexible, generally it lasts four years，or up to six years. 2．Degree Conferred: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN). 3．The Minimum Graduation Credits：120. 4．Pass HSK 4 (new format)：minimum score 180. 7. The curriculum and distribution of credits Editor Notes: The list of curriculum is only for reference. 1. Curriculum: Most courses are composed of theoretical and practical teaching. Core courses are compulsory, and students may choose some elective courses from other discipline, which is not compulsory. 2. A list of the credit allocation（See Table 1） Table 1： List of the Credit Allocation Table2: Curriculum and Course Arrangement Note: 1. *Compulsory Courses. The total credits of compulsory and elective courses are 160. 2. Students who have passed HSK3(new format) will be exempt from Elementary Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening and Speaking; Students who have passed HSK4(new format) will be exempt from Elementary Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening and Speaking, Intermediate Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening and Speaking. Those students can get the credits of corresponding courses after confirmation. 3. Theoretical teaching: 1 credit equals 16 teaching hours(45min/teaching hour); Clinical Practice & Internship: 1 credit equals 1 weeks practice. Clinical Practice-Ⅰfocuses on Fundamentals of Nursing and Health Assessment; Clinical Practice-Ⅱ Fundamentals of Nursing, community health Nursing,; Clinical Practice-Ⅲ Medical & Surgical Nursing, Nursing care of children, Mental Health Nursing; Clinical Practice-ⅣMedical & Surgical Nursing, Maternal and infant care , Emergency Nursing 8. Introduction of Hangzhou Normal University Editor Notes: The top university & the Alma Mater of Ma Yun. Founded as a teacher training school in 1908, Hangzhou Normal University has a history of over 100 years, which has bestowed the institution with a glorious tradition of producing first-rate teachers and educators at different levels for the whole Chinese nation. fields.description: Program Description 1. Major Training Objectives Editor Note: Students are mainly engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications after graduation. This program aims to cultivate high-quality personnel with practical and innovative abilities who shall have a good command of basic theory and professional knowledge of telecommunications, and technologies related to telecommunications systems and networks. The graduates shall be able to engage in project design, research and development, network operation, equipment manufacturing, and technical management in the field of info-communications. 2. Specialty Core Courses Editor Note: The core courses listed are only samples, not all the courses. Series courses of Circuits, Computer Networks, Signal & Linear Systems, Digital Signal Processing, Stochastic Signal Analysis, Electromagnetic Fields and Waves, Principles of Communications, and Information Theory and Coding. 3. Program Composition and Distribution of Course Hours and Credits Editor Note: The total credits for graduation are 155 points. For a Bachelor's degree in engineering, a student must achieve 18 credits in general education courses, 29.5 credits in discipline fundamental courses, 50 credits in specialty required courses, 26.5 credits in specialty elective courses, and 31 credits for the practical, amounting to a total of 155 credits. A minimum of 12 credits is required of the students for one semester except for the short summer semester. 4. Guiding Arrangements Editor Note: The courses type, course name and credits are describe detailly in the follow table, students can know more about the program well. General Education Course Table Discipline Fundamental Course Table Specialty Core Course Table Specialty Elective Course Table Internship and Practical Training Table（Non-independent course experiments are not included） 5. Main Practical Teaching and Internship Editor Note: Students of this program are required to complete practical teaching and internship before graduation. Electronic Processing Practice; Internship; Graduation Practice; Graduation Project; Specialty Course Experiments, Course Design, etc. 6. School Introduction Editor Note: SDUST has the excellent academic performance, deep foundation of culture and a modern open environment. Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More>> About College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering There are 90 staff in the College of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, including 17 professors, 6 doctoral supervisors, 41 associate professors, 58 teachers holding doctoral diploma. It sets up the Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Applied Chemistry, Department of Environmental Science & Engineering, Department of Biological Engineering, Department of Energy and Chemical Engineering and Basic Research Center etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Note: By experiencing Chinese life and culture, international students enjoy themselves a lot. Learn Tai-chi Learn in Practice Make "jiaozi"

fields.description: Program Description Prpgram Discription This course is ideal for anyone wishing to advance their knowledge, skills, ability and career prospects in business. It enables you to convert your business-related foundation degree, HND or degree credits into an honours degree in business management. Degree Duration: 4 Years (3 without foundation) Core Modules Include: Strategic Planning, Organisational Behaviour, Marketing in a Global Context, Leadership in Contemporary Organisations and Implementing Strategy and Change. Who is it For? BA (Hons) Business Management is a broad subject incorporating business, economics, finance and marketing amongst other relevant disciplines. A Business Management degree is suitable if you wish to explore several career paths as it develops a student’s knowledge relevant to a diverse range of sectors. What’s included in the course? During the three years you will study a broad range of subjects, marketing in a global context, managing innovation and creativity, Global Governance in International Business, International Strategy, Developing People and Organisations, Managing for Success and Sustainable and Responsible business in the 21st century. What are the benefits of the course? This degree is awarded by Sheffield Hallam University, one of the U.K.’s most popular universities with over 30,000 students. Undergraduate degrees from Sheffield Hallam are well respected, with 70 percent of business graduates finding employment in a professional or managerial position within 6 months of graduation. What are my options after graduating? Some students proceed to Master studies while others gain employment in all types of sectors and organisations. After graduation, students are extremely well-positioned in the job market given that they hold a highly-regarded and internationally recognised degree from a respected U.K. university, but they also have international experience and language skills that enable them to stand out amongst peers. After graduation, you will have the experience and skills to analyse a commercial opportunity, manage a project, solve problems, be able to operate in different cultures, communicate with other people and ultimately lead them. Core Modules Include: Meeting,Conference and Exhibition Management,Stadium and Arena Management,Creativity and Innovation in Context and Global Events and Festivals.

fields.description: Program Description Introduction of Mechanical Design Manufacturing and Automation This major trains senior engineering and technical personnel in the field of machinery and equipment Automation control, so that it has the professional design and manufacturing, technology development, applied research, operational management and business marketing aspects of critical knowledge and basic skills. In this major, mechanical technology and micro-electronics technology, information technology is combined with CNC technology. Computer control technology, testing and conversion technology, hydraulic and pneumatic automation control technology on machinery and equipment, based on the typical mechanical equipment and production line as a backdrop to describe the overall design method for mechanical manufacturing automation. And then it can enhance Automation control design capabilities. In this major it will learn basic theory of mechanical design and manufacturing, micro-electronics technology, computer technology, information technology, mechatronics, hydraulic and pneumatic transmission technology, machine tool numerical control technology and so on. Students will have basic training for modern engineers, and have the ability of automation and control of mechanical products design, manufacturing, production organization and management, and have the basic skills of strong ability of learning, research and innovation. Graduates in this major are suitable for machinery and automation and other related businesses, research institutions engaged in design and manufacturing, research and development, production management, marketing, and so on. Mechanical design and manufacture and automation specialty trains mechanical design, manufacturing and automation of basic knowledge and application ability. Engaged in machinery manufacturing in the field of designing, manufacturing, design and development, applied research, operational management and business marketing senior engineering and technical personnel.

Native English speakers are exempted from providing relevant certificates. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After learning this program, students can deal with related complicated engineering problems individually. Students are trained to obtain the ability to solve complex environmental engineering problems, especially in the field of mining and metallurgy industry, such as sewage treatment, air pollution control, solid waste recycling and other aspects of engineering problems. ​ 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Please be noted that the listed courses may change according to adjustment every year. Chinese, Overview of China, Microbiology for Environmental Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Water Pollution Control Engineering, Air Pollution Control Engineering, Solid Waste Treatment And Disposal, Environmental Planning and Management, Environmental Monitoring. 3. Introduction of University of Science and Technology Beijing Editor Notes: As a university of "firsts", USTB continually strives to be a leading innovator in both China and the global community. The University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB) was founded in 1952 following the amalgamation of the best departments in related fields of five eminent universities as a result of a nationwide reorganization of the higher education system. USTB values greatly and will forever cherish its long tradition of being "Rigorous in Learning and Research and Venerating Practice". Over 100,000 graduates are contributing to society all over the world; most of them have become professionals and joined our national elites in the field of politics, economics, science and education. As metallurgy and materials science are the two disciplines for which it is most renowned, USTB is also known as "the cradle of iron and steel engineers". Learn More>> 4. About International Student Center Editor Notes: International Student Center are responsible for all international students' affairs. USTB International Student Center, which takes charge of making overall plan in development of international student education, management and coordination in students affairs, has four divisions: integrated office, office of recruitment and programs, office of students affairs, and foreign language teaching center. In July 2013, USTB has been approved by the Ministry of Education to be one of the first "Demonstration Base of Studying in China". Every year, the International Student Center will provide a rich variety of colorful internship and extra-curriculum activities for international students. They have the chance to pay a visit to industrial and commercial enterprises, to the scenery spots such as Forbidden City and the Great Wall; they can also participate in singing, dancing, painting, calligraphy competitions, "Star of Chinese" competition, Chinese debate competitions, as well as sport competitions and New Year parties. 5. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Calligraphy ​​ Making Bread ​​​Laoshe Tea House ​​​

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: This program aims at preparing students for pharmacy services, education and research in pharmacy-related fields, and drug research and development. Students in this program study the basic knowledge and practical skills in pharmacy and clinical pharmacy. The program provides students with basic training in clinical pharmacy research methods and practical skills, and enables students command the basic knowledge and skills in clinical pharmacy, drug evaluation (new drug evaluation and drug re-evaluation), pharmaceutical information and consulting services, design and practice of clinical drug treatment. The program is designed to prepare students for pharmacy services, education and research in pharmacy-related fields, and drug research and development. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed in the table. Course Offering 3. Experimental Training Center Editor Notes: The National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center of Pharmacy of the school has greatly promoted the experimental teaching level of pharmacy/traditional Chinese Medicine nationwide. Practical ability is the core competence for pharmacy students. School of Pharmacy encourages students to participate in extracurricular innovative research projects, taking advantage of the National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center of Pharmacy, the National Experimental Teaching Center for Pharmacy Stimulation, the National Innovative Talent Training Zone, the Innovative Program for College Students, National Teaching Team, and the Experimental Bilingual Teaching Program. Increasing investment has been given to the experimental centers, which has been playing an exemplary role nationwide of the system of management and experimental teaching reform. Strengthen the foundation of experimental teaching to build fist-class education platform. School of Pharmacy has an area of 6000 square meters for experiments and teaching, equipped with advanced large-scale instruments and equipments such as LC/MS and multimedia facilities, with fixed assets valued about 80 million RMB. 4. About China Pharmaceutical University (CPU) Editor Notes: Its pharmacy program ranks No. 1 in China. China Pharmaceutical University (CPU), situated in the historical and cultural city of Nanjing, is one of the "211 project" key universities affiliated to the Ministry of Education of China. It has been known for its long history and its leadership role in China's pharmaceutical academic field. The University was founded in 1936 as China's first independent four-year National College of Pharmacy and the first public institution for higher pharmaceutical education in China. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: More colourful activities are waiting for you to explore. Sports Meeting Graduation Ceremony

fields.description: Program Description Program Overview Training objective This program is aimed at training the cross-century talents that could adapt to the development trend of economic globalization and China's "going out" development goals. It requires students to master solid basic theory about economics with global view and advanced concept in such open economy. And the students should have good command of English, understand the leading commerce pattern, be capable of adapting to the ceaseless changes of both international and domestic economic development, and master the basic ability to participate in international competition and engage in the management of the international market. Program Description This program requires students to systemically master the basic theory and rich knowledge of world economics and international trade, to know modern management methods and skills, and have strong problem analyzing and solving abilities. Main courses: Political Economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, World Economics, International Trade, International Business, International Investment Theory and Practice, International Trade Practice, etc. International students are exempt from the Political Theory, Physical Education, Military Theory, Ideological and Moral Education and Foreign Language. Main practical training: Students are trained to participate in the practical work in governmental executive departments or commercial enterprises and write internship report. Internship A scattered practice methodology is adopted for internship. And it is normally arranged at the end of the first semester in the senior year. Considering the discipline knowledge and unique major characteristics, inpidual students can seek internship opportunities in their home countries or in Chinese enterprises and institutions according to their own situation. Through practical training, the internship will prepare students with basic skills to work on practical cases and management. Moreover, the students could test their theoretical knowledge in practice, possess relative working experience and improve their comprehensive abilities through practice. Examination The student’s performance in each course is consisted of three parts: the class attendance and performance (20%), the midterm examination (20%), and the final exam (40%). Degree The students, who pass the performance review, graduation practice and graduation thesis, and get approval by the University Academic Degree Evaluation Committee, will be granted with the Graduation Certificate in International Economy and Trade, and Bachelor Degree in Economics by Northwest University.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 .Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary foreign passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan)and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent resident in foreign country should be obtained prior to the birth of the applicant. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Note : If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the exit-entry administrations of the Chinese public security organs after application, admission or enrollment, their application eligibility, admission offer, enrollment qualification, or student status shall be revoked. 2 . General Requirements 2.1 Under the age of 25. Applicants must have graduated from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements IELTS Academic: total 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component. We do not accept IELTS One Skill Retake to meet our English language requirements. TOEFL-iBT (including Home Edition): total 92 with at least 23 in each component. We do not accept TOEFL MyBest Score to meet our English language requirements. 4. Requirements on China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) According to the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs are required to provide valid CSCA report. The China Scholarship Council will organize the first test on December 21, 2025, with registration opening in November. Specific times and arrangements will be released through the official website. Starting from 2026, the test service will be provided regularly, with five tests per year in January, March, April, June, and December. *Biology and chemistry must have been taken as compulsory subjects in high school. 5. Offered on Haining International Campus

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: Students can not only have a depth knowledge in Integrative Biomedical Sciences, but also have developed a breadth of skills and experience in interpersonal skills, critical judgement and computer literacy. Integrative Biomedical Sciences is a multidisciplinary degree programme that provides opportunities to investigate the biomedical sciences in the 21st century. The core structure of the programme provides the knowledge, skills and personal and professional development appropriate to meet the needs of a future career as a leader in biomedical science. The programme provides opportunities to develop skills and knowledge in the biomedical, physcio-chemical and clinical sciences. In addition, in later years focused optional courses provide opportunities to explore the biomedical disciplines of physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience, immunology, reproductive biology, medical microbiology and developmental biology. Integrative Biomedical Sciences is founded on developing skills in academic research and scientific enquiry thereby encouraging awareness and understanding of the research that is needed to continue to advance clinical practice. Alongside a depth of knowledge in Integrative Biomedical Sciences, graduates will have developed a breadth of skills and experience, including interpersonal skills, critical judgement and computer literacy. 2. Programme Outcomes Editor Notes: The aim of this programme is to produce future leaders in the world of biomedical sciences. Over fours years, you will develop the knowledge and skills that will allow you to: Research the importance of research to the development of medicine and good health Understand how advances in knowledge result from scientific investigation Evaluate and discuss contemporary issues in the field of biomedical sciences Understand and apply research methodologies to the field of biomedical sciences Be able to independently research and analyse contemporary questions in the field of biomedical sciences 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: Students can reference to the courses outline information of four years' study from the following description. Year One: Biomedical Sciences in Context Year Two: Understanding Biomedical Sciences Year Three: Developing Knowledge Through Experiment Year Four: Research in Practice 4. Careers Editor Notes: Most graduates will engage in aboratory research, disease diagnosis, and scientific publishing. Graduates enter employment that requires an understanding of biomedical processes and the ability to research using scientific literature and other data sources. These careers include laboratory research, disease diagnosis, and scientific publishing. 5. Dual Degree Editor Notes: Students admitted to this international degree program are enrolled in both Zhejiang University and the University of Edinburgh. Students who successfully complete the program and meet the requirements of both universities will receive two bachelor's degrees in their respective major fields and a graduation certificate of ZJU: • Bachelor of Science (Honours) from the University of Edinburgh • Bachelor of Science from Zhejiang University • Graduation Certificate from Zhejiang University 6. About ZJU-UoE Institute(ZJE) Editor Notes: The Zhejiang University-University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE) is a collaboration in the field of Biomedical Sciences between Zhejiang University of China and The University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom. The Zhejiang University-University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE Institute) is a collaboration in the field of Biomedical Sciences between Zhejiang University of China and The University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom. The two universities established an international research institute at the International Campus of Zhejiang University in Haining, Zhejiang, that builds on the existing strengths of both, and aims to foster collaborations in teaching and research. The Institute provides undergraduate education programmes that produce students with academic excellence, leadership skills, innovative capacity and global vision. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Graduates can work as practical personnel in enterprise, institution and administrative management of relevant department. This program cultivates students with good science accomplishment, helps master basic theory, knowledge and skills of computer hardware and software, and also equips students with a strong design and application ability on computer system analysis. Graduates can work as practical personnel with innovative spirit on research and development of computer application technology in enterprise, institution and administrative management of relevant department. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2, namely in the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes in Chinese. It takes 4 years to complete this program generally; however it can be extended to 6 years at most. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes in Chinese. This model can achieve kill-two-birds with one stone effect. On the one hand, students can start their major directly after they come to China. On the other hand, students have more time to learn Chinese before they actually need to study in Chinese. 3. The Goal of This Program Editor Notes: Students can not only master professional skills and well informed about knowledge of computer science and technology, but also Chinese language, culture in this program. This program is set to train qualified computer professionals with basic theory and knowledge of computer science and technology and also good research ability, application ability and innovative ability . Graduates are well equipped with professional skills and well informed about knowledge of computer science and technology, as well as Chinese language, culture. 4. Language Requirement Editor Notes: International students are required to pass HSK 3 before graduation. English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 3 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: Different kinds of activities are waiting international students to explore off campus. International Students Attend Tea Culture Activity ​​ The First ZAFU IC Model United Nations Meeting ​​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS or TOEFL results are generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -The document need to be in English or Chinese, document in other languages should be translated into Chinese or English. * 2. Study Plan -Suggested content includes: self-introduction; reasons for choosing China, this university, and this major; study plan in China; career goals; and conclusion. Highlight your motivation, interests, academic foundation, and fit with the chosen university and major. -Must be written in Chinese or English. -Suggested length: 1000 words or above. -Include your name and handwritten or electronic signature (no typed signatures), and submit a scanned copy of the signed document. -Ensure the university and program names are correct and specific to the application; do not use the same study plan for multiple universities. * 3. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 6. Guarantor Form -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Your guarantor must fill it, print, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The guarantor is usually one of your parents; you cannot be your own guarantor. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Guarantor's Passport A scanned copy of the local ID card or passport of your guarantor during your studies in China. 8. Notarized Guardian's Letter of Commitment -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in the same city as the university, and complete the notarization process as guided in our tutorial video . -Upload a scanned copy of the notarized Guardian’s Letter of Commitment. This document must be certified in your home country and notarized in China. -Please note that a Notarization of Declaration (声明公证) issued in China is eventually required. -A scanned copy is acceptable at the initial stage. If the university later requires the original document or additional materials, we will inform you. -For some universities, guardian services are available. You can learn more here . * 9. Bank Statement -Deposit certificate: It must be issued by a regular bank with the official seal of the bank and is valid within the last three months. -Amount required: The total deposit must reach RMB 60,000. -Account information: It is best to use your own account, if using a parent's account, you need to provide additional proof of relationship. The certificate should clearly show the account holder's name, account number, bank information and deposit balance and other key information. -Translation requirements: lf the deposit certificate is not in Chinese or English, an officially recognized translation must be provided. -Please note that failure to submit the required bank statement on time may affect the progress of your application or the outcome of your admission, We encourage applicants to prepare in advance and ensure the authenticity and validity of all financial documents. 10. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. 11. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. fields.description: Program Description Business School of Nantong University was established in October 2004. It was formerly known as Department of Economy and Trade of Nantong Institute of Technology which was established in 1994. Business school has 5 departments: International Economy and Trade, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resource Management and Logistics Management consisting of 7 undergraduate majors which are International Economy and Trade, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Marketing, Electronic Business and Logistics Management, involving Economics and Management. It has five research institutes: “Logistics Engineering Institute”, “Rural Development Institute”, “Service Economy Research Institute”, “Science and Technology Policy and Management Research Institute", “Financial Services and Performance Evaluation Research Institute” and two key University level disciplines at: “Business Management” and “Applied Economics. Business School has 103 teaching and administrative staff. 83 full-time teachers consist of 33 teachers with doctoral degree (including PhD); 10 professors, 33 associate professors. There are more than 20 teachers went to Japan, Britain, Germany, America, France, Australia and other countries to study and get academic training, which has formed a team of teachers with a rational structure, relatively strong strength, vibrant and good team cooperation spirit. In addition, the school has nearly 2000 full-time students and 800 students for further-education. The university has a strong ability of scientific research. In recent years, it has undertaken more than 100 research projects including “National Social Science Fund Project”, “National Natural Science Fund Project of the Ministry of Education”, “Humanities and Social Science Research Fund Project”, “Jiangsu Province Philosophy Social Science Fund Projects” and other higher level research projects. The university has won more than 40 awards such as the Jiangsu Province Philosophy Social Science Outstanding Achievement Award, Nantong City Philosophy and Social Sciences Outstanding Achievement Award, Nantong city Science and Technology Progress Award and other awards. In recent five years, we have published more than 500 academic papers at home and abroad. The school has advanced teaching auxiliary facilities, forming the characteristics of talent cultivation which is "solid foundation, board entrance, application and innovation". Modern Business experimental centers such as “Financial Engineering Laboratory”, “Electronic Commerce Laboratory”, “Kingdee K/3ERP Laboratory” and “Business Decision Simulation Laboratory Sandbox Laboratory” have been established under the cooperation with Kingdee International Software Group Co. Ltd and Langchao Group Co. Ltd. And Nantong University has built more than 30 teaching practice and employment base with "Jiangsu Wenfeng Group" and "Jiangsu Big-boss Beer Group" which has provided favorable conditions for the cultivation of students practical ability and employment. After more than 10 years of efforts, we have cultivated a large number of application oriented, innovative talents of economy and management for local society. Nantong University has extensive cooperation in personnel training and academic exchange with the schools in United States, Germany, Britain, and Australia etc... Our universities have set up "3+1" accounting international curriculum experimental classes with America Winthrop University, training international business talents together. Besides, we have frequent exchange visiting arrangement with students in the United States, Germany, Britain, South Korea and other countries every year. And exchange teacher with American, Britain, Australia and other countries to give lectures in university which has broadened academic horizons, improved the ability of international cooperation and exchanges. Faced with the new opportunities and challenges, we will strive to focus on cultivating high-quality economic and management talents with innovative spirit and practical ability. We will take “Virtue study, Integrity of business” as our mission, adhering to the university motto "bridging the East and West, striving to improve". Take the road of scientific development, characteristic development, open development and connotation development and strive to build business school into a economy and management personnel training base with Chinese characteristics and global vision to meet the needs of local economic and social development.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Note: This major was the earliest industrial design discipline of the country and the only brand specialty in Jiangsu Province. In the 50 years of development, it has formed the teaching and research features engineering, and had a significant influence worldwide. Being one of the interdisciplinary subject, industrial design stresses on the integration of multiple discipline. It focuses on the user analysis of industrial products, human-computer interaction, product epitaxial and services, technology implementation, as well as engineering structure knowledge and applications. It emphasizes on product pre-define and innovation and practice of user research methods, as well as the technology realization and manufacturing process in the latter part of the industrial product development. It gives full play to the advantages and features of the industrial design interdisciplinary, makes comprehensive use of design, psychology, marketing, management, sociology, computer science, machinery, materials and technology and other disciplines of knowledge. It aims to develop specialized design and technical personnel with innovative thinking and logical analysis who can work for enterprises, universities and research and development institutes engaged in networking and other information technology industry doing user research, interaction design, engineering design, new product development, teaching and research. 2. Objective and Contents Editor Notes: This program aims at cultivating specialized design and technical personnel. The overall goal for this program is to 1) prepare students with holistic problem solving skills through project-based learning that covers the whole spectrum of design from identifying opportunities to realizing opportunities, 2) set a design education model that breaks down discipline boundaries between the sub-disciplines of design and potentially cross over with engineering, business, and etc, 3) to bridge the gap between typical fragmented design education and holistic approach for addressing problems in real life situations, and 4) address the wicked nature of design problems. 3. Fundamental Courses Editor Notes: Fundamental courses may change according to the adjustment every year. User Research and Product Definition; Product Design Principles and Methods; Product Realization and Technical Basis; Interactice Design Principles and methodology; Smart Product Development; Innovative Product Development; Service Design 4. Introduction of School of Design Editor Notes: It is the only university awardee in the country that has won the Industrial Design Gold Award from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It is the main birthplace of modern design education in China, and the pioneer and modeling college of design education reform in China. It is the one of the only two institutions in the country that is continuously supported by the key construction project of the first, second and third phases of the national 211 Project. The school has repeatedly won outstanding achievements in various important design competitions at home and abroad. Our alumni are highly recognized by the industry and society of being with broad vision, comprehensive knowledge and innovative capability. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Jiangnan University is placed 53 nationwide and is in the 740th position globally by the US News rankings. Jiangnan University , dating back to 1902, locates at Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, which is the core of Yangtze River Delta. Jiangnan University functions directly under Ministry of Education, and sees quality as her life line. Now there are 17 schools, covering fields of economics, education, laws, literature, science, medicine, engineering, agriculture, business etc., among which food science, fermentation, textile, industrial design play the leading role in nationwide, and have great influence in the world. Some newly developed disciplines such as International Economy and Trade, Business Administration have enrolled many international students. Learn More>> 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various on and off campus activities are provided in Jiangnan University. Cultural Trip to Wuxi Museum, Understanding Traditional Chinese Painting ​ Reading CPC History, Learning China ​ ​​

fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.
