fields.description: Program Description Speak Mandarin only 24/7 in old China capital Live and eat with a Chinese homxestay family. Visit the UNESCO World heritage places. 1 on-1 classes only (no foreign class mates) Activities with locals-from football to Chinese chess and hiking clubs (Mandarin-speak only) -Flexibility- weekend or whole week program available ​-Includes return transfers between Beijing and Chengde Cheng de (not Chengdu!) was the Qing Emperors’ summer residence and the place where standard Mandarin Chinese was codified in 1952. The city is located about two hour north-east of Beijing. Here people speak most “standard” Mandarin in all of china, but not a work in English. . The city is a UNESCO World Heritage site, is located in the mountains with plenty of fresh air and has no expat community. Here you will speak Mandarin only all day and be completely immersed into a Chinese language and culture environment. Students study the first half of the program in Beijing and the second in Chengde. This is for students who are looking for the quickest language progress possible. It also offers the great experience of living in a big metropolitan city as well as a smaller more traditional town like Chengde. The total immersion environment in Chengde is especially helpful in helping students’ language skills to progress very quickly. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Graduation from high school or equivalent educational background. Prospective graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school and obtain their high school diploma before enrollment. 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, in compliance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education, including the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC “, etc. 3. Good physical and mental health, with no criminal record. 4. English language requirements For non-native speakers of English, either TOEFL (iBT, code: 6210) or IELTS score is required. 4.1 TOEFL (iBT, including the Home Edition and Paper Edition): 90 or above; TOEFL Essentials: 10 or above. 4.2 IELTS: 6 or above. Exceptions: You may be exempted from providing any of these exams if your SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing score is 650 or above, if both your ACT Reading and English scores are 27 or above, or if you have recently completed at least 4 years of rigorous academic study in any of the following countries: Anguilla, Antigua, Barbuda, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Canada (except Quebec), Cayman Islands, Dominica, England, Federated, Northern Ireland, Scotland, Seychelles, Shetland Islands, St. Kitts-Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United States (other than Puerto Rico), US Virgin Islands, Wales, and Singapore. (Those in American Schools and British Schools abroad may also be exempted if at least 4 years of rigorous academic study have recently been completed and if test scores meet the above standards.) 5. Test Scores 5.1 China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), Score with Mathematics is required. Applicants who have not yet taken the CSCA may submit other Test score materials initially (such as SAT /AP/ACT /A-Level/IB (code: N010601)/UEC/UNT/SJTU entrance test/others). Those who pass the university's selection process will receive a pre-admission notice and must supplement their CSCA scores by June 30, 2026. Upon passing the final selection, a formal admission notice will be issued. a. SAT (code: 6563) or ACT (code: 6983) test scores. Scores with writing test scores are preferred. 2025 First-year admitted class test scores of Middle 50th percentile ranges: SAT total score: 1350-1450 SAT Math: 730-790 ACT total score: 30-33 ACT Math: 28-35 b. A-level scores, you need to apply with Math A or above. c. International Baccalaureate (IB), you need to apply with Math HL 5 or above or SL 7 in Math or above. Predicted A-level or IB scores are NOT accepted. d. Students with valid college entrance exam scores, please contact the International Undergraduate Recruitment Office at gc-admissions@sjtu.edu.cn (e.g., Malaysia UEC exam scores, Kazakhstan UNT scores. France National Exam scores, etc.) e. If you don’t have any exam scores mentioned above, you have an option to take the SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam in spring 2026 with other international students. SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam *Applicants for Engineering Cluster program in English must complete application Exam Registration: Applicants should log in to the Study@SJTU online application system to choose the undergraduate English-taught Program, fill in the application form, submit the electronic version of application materials and complete exam. Application Time: February 6, 2026~ March 10, 2026(Beijing Time, GMT+8) Exam Method: Online Exam Time: Scheduled for March 21–22, 2026. Detailed schedule will be notified via email later. fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction This program is taught in BESU-Solbridge. International Finance is the branch of economics that studies the dynamics of exchange rates, foreign investment, and how these affect international trade. It also studies international projects, international investments and capital flows, and trade deficits. It includes the study of futures, options and currency swaps. All courses instruction and discussions of contemporary business issues are done in English, drawing on the vast knowledge and experience of our international faculty. You will acquire business knowledge and intercultural skills, which are highly sought after in a range of international institutions. Teaching Objective The aim is to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. Main Courses To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. China Financial Systems Financial Markets and Institutions International Investment Analysis M&A and Investment Banking Commercial Banking Private Equity and Venture Capital Financial Reporting and Analysis Internship and Career Development Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation.The school has so far signed an agreement about internship bases, with S.F-Express, chamber of commerce - China's ambassador to Thailand (including the Bank of China and , Haire company - Thailand branch ), Industrial and Commercial Bank of China- Indonesia branch. Graduate careers within the general domain of English and finance include administrative, managerial, accounting and consultancy positions within international organisations. You may also be able to pursue a career as a professional translator or interpreter. Additionally, the course provides a foundation for further graduate level study in the subjects of English language and finance. Degree Awarded After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .

fields.description: Program Description Prpgram Discription This course is ideal for anyone wishing to advance their knowledge, skills, ability and career prospects in business. It enables you to convert your business-related foundation degree, HND or degree credits into an honours degree in business management. Degree Duration: 4 Years (3 without foundation) Core Modules Include: Strategic Planning, Organisational Behaviour, Marketing in a Global Context, Leadership in Contemporary Organisations and Implementing Strategy and Change. Who is it For? BA (Hons) Business Management is a broad subject incorporating business, economics, finance and marketing amongst other relevant disciplines. A Business Management degree is suitable if you wish to explore several career paths as it develops a student’s knowledge relevant to a diverse range of sectors. What’s included in the course? During the three years you will study a broad range of subjects, marketing in a global context, managing innovation and creativity, Global Governance in International Business, International Strategy, Developing People and Organisations, Managing for Success and Sustainable and Responsible business in the 21st century. What are the benefits of the course? This degree is awarded by Sheffield Hallam University, one of the U.K.’s most popular universities with over 30,000 students. Undergraduate degrees from Sheffield Hallam are well respected, with 70 percent of business graduates finding employment in a professional or managerial position within 6 months of graduation. What are my options after graduating? Some students proceed to Master studies while others gain employment in all types of sectors and organisations. After graduation, students are extremely well-positioned in the job market given that they hold a highly-regarded and internationally recognised degree from a respected U.K. university, but they also have international experience and language skills that enable them to stand out amongst peers. After graduation, you will have the experience and skills to analyse a commercial opportunity, manage a project, solve problems, be able to operate in different cultures, communicate with other people and ultimately lead them. Core Modules Include: Meeting,Conference and Exhibition Management,Stadium and Arena Management,Creativity and Innovation in Context and Global Events and Festivals.

fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction There are two time periods for language program application, respectively spring semester and autumn semester. Students who want to pursue degree program can apply to transfer from language program to the bachelor degree program of Chinese Language and Literature after taking relevant exams. fields.description: Program Description Program Descriptions: Aim: As a key specializationof national level, TransportManagement of SMU features an emphasis on students’ practical skillsand innovation capabilities, which allows them to work on public management, organization and management of multi-modal transport, international shipping management, and others. Upon completing the program, students should be familiar with the basic knowledge of international shipping and policies, public management, international transportation laws and regulations, shipping management theories and methods, international transportation business and practices. Students should also demonstrate innovative and entrepreneurship abilities that allow them perform proper roles in international shipping companies, government agencies, and scientific research institutes and maintain sustainable personal development in the constantly changing maritime field, . Requirements In addition to systematical mastering of management principles, economics, maritime cargo transportation management, cargo safety management and international trade, the students will comprehensively study shipping public ethics, shipping public policy, international shipping management, liner / charter transportation theory and practice, container terminal business and management,multi-modal transport organization and management, international shipping trade, shipping derivatives and risk management.. Successful graduates are expected to attain the abilities senior international shipping management talents should possess to solve practical management problems . Essential Courses to be taken by students: 1. Maritime Cargo Transportation Management 2. Maritime Geography 3. Shipping Public Ethics 4. Principles and Practice of Liner Transportation 5. Shipping Public Management 6. Shipping Trade 7. International Finance 8. Supply Chain Management 9. Principles and Practice of Chartering Transportation 10. Shipping Economics 11. International Shipping Management 12. Shipping Public Policy 13. Statistics and Forecast 14. Maritime Insurance Law

School Introduction Editor Notes: CUPB is in a leading position in the petroleum and petrochemical disciplines in China. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements To be eligible, an applicant must: (1) Be non-Chinese nationality, hold a foreign passport and meet the relevant requirements of the Regulation No.〔2020〕12 by Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. (2) Stay in good health both mentally and physically, and meet the physical examination standards for the study visa or residence permit in China required by the Chinese government. (3) Abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the University rules and regulations; be diligent and well-performed in academics and good conduct; no violation of the University rules and disciplines, no public security punishment, no criminal record. (4) Photocopy of new HSK level 5 certificate with score of 180 points or above level for those who applying for Chinese-taught programs. (5) Under the age of 30 for the undergraduate programs. (6) Abide by requirements of other relevant laws and regulations. (7) Test results of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). Required Subjects download here .

fields.description: Program Description Note: This program can prodive scholarship, if you want to get more information, please cantact CUCAS counsellor. Program Selections Students can select from "1+4" preparatory university program. Admitted students will attend Tianjin International Chinese College for one year.Upon completing the coursework and passing HSK level 5, students will have guaranteed transfer to Tijian Polytechnic University. For "1+4”program, students can choose any other majors except for Chinese language major, and they can directly enter their sophomore year with three more years to obtain TJPU'S diploma. Academic Majors Tianjin International Chinese College: Chinese Language Tianjin Polytechnic University: Choose from all undergraduate departments. Graduation and Degree Upon successfully completing the "1+4" preparatory university program,students will be granted a graduation certificate from Tianjin International College, and a Bachelor degree from Tianjin Polytechnic University. Bridge Program Students will study Chinese language at Tianjin International Chinese College and transfer to Tianjin Polytechnic University upon successfully meeting the transfer requirments. Students will obtain undergraduate degree at Tianjin Polytechnic University. Program Tuition

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. Residents of the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan who have emigrated to other countries and are applying to Qingdao University as international students must present valid passport or citizenship documents dating from before April 30, 2022, along with proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality. Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, friendly to China and must abide by the laws and decrees of China. Applicants for master's degree programs must have attained a bachelor's degree, and those who graduated from non-Chinese universities must hold a bachelor's degree from a university accredited by the Ministry of Education of China. (Grade skipping or joining in the middle of the course is not permitted.) Applicants with English as native language are exempted from English language certificate. Applicants from non-English speaking countries must provide IELTS (6.0 or above), new TOEFL (75 points or above) or other comparable certification of English proficiency. Applicants who have obtained their highest degree with English as the medium of instruction are exempted from providing language proficiency certification, but proof indicating the language medium is required.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Financial Guarantee Statement with front page of the sponsor’s passport or proof of identification. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -Some universities may require a certificate covering only the past 3 months, in which case the certificate is valid for 3 months only. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 3. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Resume and a copy of the Commitment for Application -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Personal Statement -A written personal statement that introduces your educational background, personal experiences, motivation for studying abroad, and how your past has shaped your decision to study in China. -You should highlight your values, personality, strengths, and personal growth, and explain how these qualities make you a good fit for international study. -The statement should express your passion for learning, openness to different cultures, and your long-term personal and professional goals. -Must be written in English or Chinese. -Minimum length: 1500 words. -Make sure the content is original and written in your own words. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Pre-admission Application Please contact professor or department to finish this appliaciton form. Applicants who finished this application could get the preferential admission. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Certificate of English proficiency * 8. Information page of the valid passport (passport type must be ordinary). The passport’s date of expiry should be after December 2026. * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Undergraduate school transcript Written both in Chinese and English * 11. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in both English and Chinese and be certified by notarization. Fresh graduates are required to provide proof of graduation or proof of attendance. They must be required to submit academic credentials to be eligible for admission. * 12. Two letters of recommendation Two letters of recommendation (written only in Chinese or English) from professors or associate professors shall be submitted. These letters shall describe the applicant’s objectives of learning in China, comprehensive abilities, and evaluation of future growth, as well as the cooperation between the supervisors or the exchange between universities both in China and abroad. 13. Work certificate for applicants who have job. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality Should be a non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in the school in good health and with a sound mind. If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. In that case, they do not have Chinese nationality and must have a record of actually living abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years. (Nine (9) months living abroad are equivalent to one year, subject to entry and exit visas).Chinese emigrants who apply to come to China for undergraduate study as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years. Within the 4 years, they must have a record of living abroad for more than 2 years (9 months abroad in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit visas). 2. Education Background Must be at the high school level or above, with a high school diploma. 3. Language Requirements English-taught Programs: Must be an English native speaker or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, should provide a valid English proficiency certificate such as IELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥75, or TOEFL Essentials≥8 (DI Code: 806). 4. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

Those applicants who recently changed for a foreign nationality, please pay special attention: According to Foreign Language Education Official Regulation No. 83 (2009), since 2010, any overseas applicant shall hold a foreign country valid passport or certificate of his/her citizenship for 4 years or more; or he/she shall have been living overseas for 2 years or more (before be admitted on April 30th of the relevant academic year). Note: Nine months of actual overseas living may be calculated as one year according to the singing for entry and exit. b. Any applicant shall have an equal degree of a bachelor in China, fresh or a former one. Anyone who has a master degree or doctoral degree majoring in the specialty associated with the film art will be preferred. c. The applicant shall be moral and abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China without any criminal records; he or she shall be healthy according to the requirements, national or at the university level. Note: If you don't have HSK level certificate you need to study two-year pre-university program to learn Chinese.

fields.description: Program Description Introduction Ever since its advent, the BRICS, namely Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, has followed the principles of open and transparent, being united and interdependently helpful, deepening cooperation, and pursuing mutual development, upheld its spirits of “Openness, Inclusiveness, Cooperativeness and Win-win”, and been committed to build the more intimate, comprehensive and consolidated partnerships. Besides traditional economic and trade cooperation, the cooperation among the BRICS also involves cultural exchange. Audiovisual plays a fundamental role in cultural exchanges, and each one of the BRICS owns a lot of excellent film professionals. With the aim of widening the international horizon of their young film talents, promote international film education, and innovate professional talent training, Beijing Film Academy formulates The Beijing Film Academy Film Talents Promotion Program for the BRICS. The program will be at the service of the overall national policy while facilitating film education interchange among the members of the BRICS. Other than China, each of other countries of the BRICS, Russia, India, and South Africa, may send one international student to Beijing Film Academy for a master degree of film major. There will be there international students in total, from Russia, India, and South Africa respectively, in 2019 to come and study for the master degree. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Year one entry We welcome applications from high-quality candidates in all subjects with appropriate high school or equivalent qualifications. Students will normally be expected to have a high standing in their high school performance with a minimum B average in all subjects as well as relevant subjects. Year two entry Students who have completed A-levels or International Baccalaureate (or equivalent) will be considered for entry into Year Two, different programmes have different subject-relevant requirements. A-level: BBB IB Diploma: 30 points AP Exams or ACT Tests – High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 Notes: 1. BEng Architecture, BA Filmmaking, BA TV Production & BA Digital Media Arts: admissions for Year Two direct entry and Year Three transfer require a digital copy portfolio review and interview with members of Design School or the Academy of Film and Creative Technology, which can be conducted in person or via internet. 2. BA International Business with a Language: normally international students study Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students study Spanish or Japanese as the language option. For year 2 entry international students, students who are Chinese zero beginners will take an extra 5 credits Chinese language course. For year 2 entry Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students, students should be able to demonstrate an equivalent level of Spanish (DELE/SIELE A1) or Japanese (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test N5). 3. BA Translation and Interpreting: for international and HK/Macao/Taiwan students whose native language is not Chinese, an HSK level 6 or the pass of the aptitude test arranged by the Department of Translation and Interpreting is required. 4. Programmes in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Design, Mechatronics and Technology Science and so on require both Mathematics and Physics. 5. Programmes in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and so on require Mathematics. 6. Programme in Architecture: for Year One entry, Math is required. However, for Year Two direct entry, having a background in Math is desirable but not essential. You can also find more information on entry requirements on our Country/Region list. English language requirements For international applicants, if you are a non-native English speaker, or if you have not previously studied in English, you must have satisfactory English language skills to study at XJTLU. Various English qualifications are accepted: Year one entry IELTS: 5.0 (min 4.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 62 (iBT) Year two entry IELTS 6.5 (min 5.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 90 (iBT) (min 21 in any skill) National/Region Qualifications Africa Ethiopia Ethiopian Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination (ESSLCE) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Ghana B in five relevant subjects on the Senior Secondary School Certificate (SSSC) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 Kenya Grade B or 65% overall in the final year on the Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE), and grade B in relevant subjects. English proficiency: KCSE English C Lesotho High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Mauritius GCE A-levels taken in Mauritius with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Morocco 14/20 overall in the final year on the Attestation du Baccalaureat, and 14 in relevant subjects. Namibia High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Nigeria B in five relevant subjects on the NECO Senior School Certificate Examination (SSCE) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 South Africa South African National Senior Certificate (SANSC) with 66665 excluding Life Orientation will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: SANSC English grade 5 Tanzania Certificate of Secondary Education (CSE) with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education (ACSE), Cambridge Overseas Higher School Certificate (COHSC), East African Advanced Certificate of Education (EAACE) with an average B will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: CSE English grade C Zambian School Certificate or General Certificate of Education with an overall grade of 4 from across at least 5 subjects, and grade 4 for relevant subjects. English proficiency: Secondary School Certificate English grade 6 Zimbabwe The ZIMSEC A-Level Certificate/Cambridge Higher School Certificate (HSC) with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: General Certificate of Education English C Asia Bangladesh Higher School Certificate (HSC) with an overall of GPA 3.5 out of 5.0, and 60% in relevant subjects. Cambodia Diploma of Upper Secondary Education with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Iran High school diploma (theoretical stream) with an overall score of 14 out of 20, and 14 in relevant subjects, including three year scores and final examination scores. India Standard XII will be considered for Year 2 direct entry: 75% or above when awarded by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) or the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); 80% or above when awarded by an accepted State Board. English proficiency: Standard XII CBSE/CISCE English 75%. Indonesia Indonesian SMA with an average of 70-80% in relevant subjects in three-year high school academic reports and final school exam respectively, plus an official National Diploma (Ijazah). Japan Kotogakko Sotsugyo Shomeisho (Upper Secondary School Leaving Certificate) with an average of 4/5 including relevant subjects, plus National Center Test for University Admissions. Kazakhstan Oрта білім туралы аттестат (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Unified National Testing (UNT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Kyrgyzstan Аттестат о среднем общем образовании (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. National Scholarship Test (NST) may be requested in non-standard applications. Malaysia UEC: a minimum of five subjects with at least grade B6, and at least grade B4 in Math/Physics for our Engineering/Science programmes will be considered for Year 1 entry. The following certificates are accepted for Year 2 direct entry: UEC: a minimum of five subjects with A2 in one subject and B3 in four subjects, excluding Bahasa Malay and Book Keeping and Commerce, plus High school Graduation certificate. STPM: Grade B in three of the five subjects. English proficiency: UEC English B4 (Y1 entry only) or SPM 1119 (UCLES board) English C Myanmar Three-year high school graduation with an average score and relevant subjects in 60%, plus Basic Education High School Examination/Matriculation Examination with a minimum score of 400 and no subjects lower than 60%. Mongolia Certificate of Complete Secondary Education with an average of B (or 80%), plus University Entrance Examination (UEE) with at least three Bs in relevant subjects. Nepal School Leaving Certificate (Grade XI &XII) from the National Examinations Board (NEB), with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 Pakistan Higher Secondary School Certificate (also known as Intermediate Certificate) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Philippines Senior High School Diploma (Academic Track) with an average of 80%, and 80% in relevant subjects. Saudi Arabia General Secondary Education Certificate with an overall mark 75% or above. Singapore Singapore Cambridge A-levels with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Singapore Cambridge O Level English C South Korea High School Certificate of Graduation with rank 5 or score 70%, and rank 5 or score 70% in relevant subjects. College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Thailand M6 School Leaving Certificate with an average of Grade 3 and with specific subject requirements. Uzbekistan Umumiy o’rta ta’lim to’g’risida attestat / shahodatnoma (Certificate of General Secondary Education) with an average of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Vietnam Bang Tot Nghiep Pho Thong Trung Hoc (Senior Secondary School Graduation Diploma) with an overall average of 7 (out of 10) with specific requirement in relevant subjects, plus National Senior Secondary School Graduation Examinations with specific requirements. Australasia Australia Successful completion of year 12 with High School qualification and a satisfactory admission index/entrance rank ATAR (Australian Tertiary Admission Rank) with 86% is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Australian High School qualification examples: Australian Capital Territory Senior Secondary Certificate, New South Wales Higher School Certificate New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) Level 3 is accepted for Year Two entry. Applicants should achieve: – 46 or more credits ranging from Merit to Excellent (excluding Learning Recognition credits), and – including three subjects at Level 3 or above, made up of 12 credits each at Excellent, and – Literacy – 10 credits at Level 2 or above, made up of 5 credits in reading and 5 credits in writing. Numeracy – 10 credits at Level 1 or above. Applicants should provide detailed description of their academic qualification. Europe France French Baccalaureat with 12 overall out of 20 with 12 in specified subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: French Baccalaureat English 13 Germany Zeugnis der Allgemeine Hochschulreife / Abitur with a minimum of 2.5 overall with a minimum of 10 in two Leistungskurse (advanced) subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Abitur English 12 Italy Diploma di Esame di Stato with a minimum of 80% overall is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Netherlands Voorbereidend Wetenschappelijk Onderwijs (VWO) with a minimum of 7 overall out of 10 is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Russia Attestat o Srednem Obshchem Obrazovanii (Certificate of Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Certificate of Unified State Examination may be requested in non-standard applications. United Kingdom (UK) AS-Levels will be considered for Year 1 entry. GCE A-Levels with BBB or IB with 30 points is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. North America Canada High School Diploma will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. Such as: British Columbia: British Columbia Senior Secondary School Diploma with grades BBBBB in grade 12 subjects; Ontario: Secondary School Diploma OSSD with an average of 70%, including six Grade 12 U, U/C, M courses (study in-person on campus for 2-3 years). OSSD awarded outside of Canada must be from an Awarding school listed on the Canadian Government website as a school authorised to award Ontario Secondary School Diploma credits. Other provinces: Secondary/High/Senior School Diploma with 70% average and 70%, 70%, 70%, 70%, 70% in grade 12 subjects. United States of America (USA) High School Graduation Diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above will be considered for Year 1 entry. Students who take AP Exams or ACT Tests will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 South America Brazil Certificado de Ensino Medio with grades of six, and six in relevant subjects. The Caribbean CAPE Diploma including three two-Unit level subjects (excluding core subjects) at grade II with specific requirement in relevant subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry.

fields.description: Program Description OVERVIEW The BEng Electrical Engineering programme will equip you with a fundamental understanding of electrical engineering theory and the ability to solve engineering problems relating to power generation, transmission, distribution, control, protection and consumption. The programme blends the fundamentals of electrical engineering and electronics in Year Two, with more specialist knowledge in the following two years. WHY SHOULD I STUDY ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING AT XJTLU? Labs specifically designed for the electrical engineering degree Exceptionally low student to workstation ratio (1:3) that gives you the opportunity to perform individual experiments using cutting-edge technology Field trips to power stations in Suzhou and surrounding cities Partnerships with companies such as Littlefuse and REenergy Electric (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. Earn two degrees: an XJTLU degree from the Chinese Ministry of Education and a globally recognised degree from the University of Liverpool, a member of the Russell Group of leading UK universities KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS By the time you graduate from BEng Electrical Engineering, you will: have acquired a thorough understanding of the fundamentals of electrical and electronic engineering possess knowledge and skills in mathematics, software engineering, design and management possess transferable analytical, problem solving, communications, teamwork and project management skills MODULE Year One UK degrees are three years long whereas in China they are four, therefore we do accept students with certain qualifications directly into Year Two, which is the start of the main academic programme. Most students, however, enter into Year One, which provides you with a range of interesting modules, language classes and core skills for your degree. Year Two Electronic circuits Electrical circuits I C Programming and Software Engineering I/ engineering drawing Engineering Mathematics I Electromagnetism and electromechanics Digital electronics I Integrated electronics and design Experimental, computer skills and sustainability English Language and Study Skills III for Industrial Technology Year Three Electronic circuits and systems Electromagnetics Continuous and discrete time signals and systems Electrical circuits II CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits Digital electronics II Engineering Mathematics II Microprocessor systems Industrial awareness and group project Power electronics and electromechanics Energy conversion and power systems Analogue and Digital Communications I Instrumentation and control systems Year Four Compulsory modules: Digital control and automatic control Optimisation Drives, power generation, transmission and relaying Protective relaying Final year project Elective modules: Analogue and Digital Communications II Antennas Digital system design with HDL Electronics for communications Electronics for instrumentation Information theory and coding Integrated circuits – concepts and design Signal processing and digital filtering Data communications Embedded computer systems Introduction to optoelectronics and photonics Photonics and optical communication systems Wireless systems Image processing Micro and nano-manufacturing technology Smart Grid Technology Signal processing and digital filtering CAREERS BEng Electrical Engineering graduates can find employment as electric engineers, control and instrumentation engineers, electronic engineers or process engineers. The programme's quantitative and transferable skills also equip you for a wide variety of roles in other sectors related to electronic science and technology and telecommunications engineering. The programme also provides a sound basis for further studies at masters and PhD levels in electrical engineering or renewable energy technology. Join a free Chinese language course We now offer a free summer Chinese language course for all undergraduate and postgraduate students starting their degree before program start.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Year one entry We welcome applications from high-quality candidates in all subjects with appropriate high school or equivalent qualifications. Students will normally be expected to have a high standing in their high school performance with a minimum B average in all subjects as well as relevant subjects. Year two entry Students who have completed A-levels or International Baccalaureate (or equivalent) will be considered for entry into Year Two, different programmes have different subject-relevant requirements. A-level: BBB IB Diploma: 30 points AP Exams or ACT Tests – High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 Notes: 1. BEng Architecture, BA Filmmaking, BA TV Production & BA Digital Media Arts: admissions for Year Two direct entry and Year Three transfer require a digital copy portfolio review and interview with members of Design School or the Academy of Film and Creative Technology, which can be conducted in person or via internet. 2. BA International Business with a Language: normally international students study Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students study Spanish or Japanese as the language option. For year 2 entry international students, students who are Chinese zero beginners will take an extra 5 credits Chinese language course. For year 2 entry Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students, students should be able to demonstrate an equivalent level of Spanish (DELE/SIELE A1) or Japanese (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test N5). 3. BA Translation and Interpreting: for international and HK/Macao/Taiwan students whose native language is not Chinese, an HSK level 6 or the pass of the aptitude test arranged by the Department of Translation and Interpreting is required. 4. Programmes in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Design, Mechatronics and Technology Science and so on require both Mathematics and Physics. 5. Programmes in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and so on require Mathematics. 6. Programme in Architecture: for Year One entry, Math is required. However, for Year Two direct entry, having a background in Math is desirable but not essential. You can also find more information on entry requirements on our Country/Region list. English language requirements For international applicants, if you are a non-native English speaker, or if you have not previously studied in English, you must have satisfactory English language skills to study at XJTLU. Various English qualifications are accepted: Year one entry IELTS: 5.0 (min 4.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 62 (iBT) Year two entry IELTS 6.5 (min 5.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 90 (iBT) (min 21 in any skill) National/Region Qualifications Africa Ethiopia Ethiopian Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination (ESSLCE) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Ghana B in five relevant subjects on the Senior Secondary School Certificate (SSSC) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 Kenya Grade B or 65% overall in the final year on the Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE), and grade B in relevant subjects. English proficiency: KCSE English C Lesotho High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Mauritius GCE A-levels taken in Mauritius with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Morocco 14/20 overall in the final year on the Attestation du Baccalaureat, and 14 in relevant subjects. Namibia High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Nigeria B in five relevant subjects on the NECO Senior School Certificate Examination (SSCE) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 South Africa South African National Senior Certificate (SANSC) with 66665 excluding Life Orientation will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: SANSC English grade 5 Tanzania Certificate of Secondary Education (CSE) with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education (ACSE), Cambridge Overseas Higher School Certificate (COHSC), East African Advanced Certificate of Education (EAACE) with an average B will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: CSE English grade C Zambian School Certificate or General Certificate of Education with an overall grade of 4 from across at least 5 subjects, and grade 4 for relevant subjects. English proficiency: Secondary School Certificate English grade 6 Zimbabwe The ZIMSEC A-Level Certificate/Cambridge Higher School Certificate (HSC) with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: General Certificate of Education English C Asia Bangladesh Higher School Certificate (HSC) with an overall of GPA 3.5 out of 5.0, and 60% in relevant subjects. Cambodia Diploma of Upper Secondary Education with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Iran High school diploma (theoretical stream) with an overall score of 14 out of 20, and 14 in relevant subjects, including three year scores and final examination scores. India Standard XII will be considered for Year 2 direct entry: 75% or above when awarded by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) or the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); 80% or above when awarded by an accepted State Board. English proficiency: Standard XII CBSE/CISCE English 75%. Indonesia Indonesian SMA with an average of 70-80% in relevant subjects in three-year high school academic reports and final school exam respectively, plus an official National Diploma (Ijazah). Japan Kotogakko Sotsugyo Shomeisho (Upper Secondary School Leaving Certificate) with an average of 4/5 including relevant subjects, plus National Center Test for University Admissions. Unified National Testing (UNT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Kyrgyzstan Аттестат о среднем общем образовании (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. National Scholarship Test (NST) may be requested in non-standard applications. Malaysia UEC: a minimum of five subjects with at least grade B6, and at least grade B4 in Math/Physics for our Engineering/Science programmes will be considered for Year 1 entry. The following certificates are accepted for Year 2 direct entry: UEC: a minimum of five subjects with A2 in one subject and B3 in four subjects, excluding Bahasa Malay and Book Keeping and Commerce, plus High school Graduation certificate. STPM: Grade B in three of the five subjects. English proficiency: UEC English B4 (Y1 entry only) or SPM 1119 (UCLES board) English C Myanmar Three-year high school graduation with an average score and relevant subjects in 60%, plus Basic Education High School Examination/Matriculation Examination with a minimum score of 400 and no subjects lower than 60%. Certificate of Unified State Examination may be requested in non-standard applications. United Kingdom (UK) AS-Levels will be considered for Year 1 entry. Other provinces: Secondary/High/Senior School Diploma with 70% average and 70%, 70%, 70%, 70%, 70% in grade 12 subjects. Students who take AP Exams or ACT Tests will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. fields.description: Program Description OVERVIEW The BEng Electronic Science and Technology programme offers you a thorough foundation in micro-electronic engineering, electronic engineering and photonic engineering. You will learn to operate at the cutting-edge of emerging technologies. WHY SHOULD I STUDY ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY AT XJTLU? Use state-of-the-art equipment and tools for developing integrated circuit (IC) design, IC fabrication and application in electronic systems Have access to an equipped clean-room to apply knowledge learnt from books and lectures Study an IC design module, based on appropriate software, which is unique among Chinese universities Earn two degrees: an XJTLU degree from the Chinese Ministry of Education and a globally recognised degree from the University of Liverpool, a member of the Russell Group of leading UK universities. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS By the time you graduate from the BEng Electronic Science and Technology programme, you will: have extensive experience in modelling and analytical methods be able to use IT tools and computer-aided design systems for modelling, analysis, simulation and design be able to design a system, component or process based on initial requirements and constraints be able to design and fabricate integrated circuit chips or photonic devices. MODULES Year One UK degrees are three years long whereas in China they are four, therefore we do accept students with certain qualifications directly into Year Two, which is the start of the main academic programme. Most students, however, enter into Year One, which provides you with a range of interesting modules, language classes and core skills for your degree. Year Two Electronic circuits Electrical circuits I C programming and software engineering I C++ programming and software engineering II Engineering mathematics I Electromagnetism and Electromechanics Digital electronics I Integrated electronics and design Experimental, Computer Skills and Sustainability. Year Three Continuous and discrete time signals and systems I Electronic circuits and systems Electromagnetics Advanced Electrical Circuits and Electromagnetics CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits Digital electronics II Engineering mathematics II Microprocessor systems Industrial awareness and group project Analogue and digital communications I Instrumentation and control system RF Engineering and Applied Electromagnetics Energy conversion and power systems. Year Four Analogue and digital communications II Electronics for communications Digital design with HDL Integrated Circuits – Concepts and Design Electronics for instrumentation Final year project. Embedded computer systems Micro and Nanomanufacturing Technology. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be aged between 18 and 30 years old, non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders, healthy and well-behaved, with an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma, without any criminal records. Applicants should abide by the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and related rules of university, honor the Chinese social morality and customs, and will not participate in any activities which are inappropriate to the capacity as a student. 2. For non-native English speakers who apply for English-taught programs, they should provide a score report of English Language Test (TOEFL 80+/IELTS 5.5+). The certificate must be in valid period. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test reports, they will be required to participate in an English test organized by IEC. 3. According to the Document No. 12〔2020〕of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China (see Appendix 1), If the applicant's parents or one of the parents are Chinese or the applicant has emigrated from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality for, they must be naturalized for 4 years or more and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during the past 4 years (Actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). ---- Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship and become foreign citizens should provide: (1) Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship; (2) Documents certifying the acquirement of foreign citizenship; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. ---- Applicants who have acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen should provide: (1) Documents certifying acquiring foreign citizenship at the time of birth; (2) Documents certifying parent's (with Chinese citizenship) permanent residence in foreign country before the birth of the applicant; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study Plan * 2. Ordinary Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. -Your passport must have a validity of more than one year. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is valid for only 3 months. For instance, if you submit your -application in April, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than January. -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -You need to translated it into CHINESE if it is not in Chinese; Then you need to get it notarized by local notary office and then get it certified by local Chinese embassy; If your country has joined the HAGUE convention then just do the Chinese translation and Apostille; Then you may need to mail original copy of non-criminal record and translation & certified(or Apostille) documents to the university in China. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. You can download a template or sample from here . 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description Introduction Chinese Language Studies Program is open to international students who love Chinese Language and Chinese culture. Students learn Chinese at the PKU School of Chinese as a Second Language as full-time general visiting students. Instruction is divided into elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels. Students are arranged into suitable classes according to the results of the Chinese placement test at the beginning of the semester. Class size is approximately fifteen students per class. Normally class hours are from Monday to Friday, four academic hours per day, twenty hours per week. Besides Chinese language studies in the classroom, Peking University also offers program students a series of activities to experience Chinese culture and get a deeper understanding of China. Upon completion of the program students will receive a program certificate and an official transcript. The program is normally one semester long, but students could applyfor extending their study period to at most four semesters in accumulation. When to Apply Fall Semester Admission: Online application starts on March 1st every year. Spring Semester Admission: Online application starts on November 1st every year. Note:Applications are on a “rolling” (first come, first served) basis – until full capacity. Only when the office receives the hardcopies of all the required documents will the application be processed. Admission Admission will be determined according to your educational background and the academic achievement. Upon acceptance, the University will send you the ‘Admission Notification’ as well as the ‘Visa Application for Study in China (Form JW202)’ at the end of the semester. Registration Period Fall Semester: In early September (specified in the Admission Notification); Spring Semester: In February (specified in the Admission Notification). PKU Academic Year Fall Semester: normally from September to January; Spring Semester: normally from February to June. Tuition Fee (per person) 18,000RMB/semester (one cost-free weekend tour included during the study period). Teaching Materials Fee 150-300RMB/semester Medical Insurance The Ministry of Education of China requires that all international students be medically insured throughout their entire planned period of study. Peking University international studentsare required to purchase the Comprehensive Insurance Plan of Foreign Students on the day of registration. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality Should be a non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in the school in good health and with a sound mind. If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. In that case, they do not have Chinese nationality and must have a record of actually living abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years. (Nine (9) months living abroad are equivalent to one year, subject to entry and exit visas).Chinese emigrants who apply to come to China for undergraduate study as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years. Within the 4 years, they must have a record of living abroad for more than 2 years (9 months abroad in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit visas). 2. Education Background Must be at the high school level or above, with a high school diploma. 3. Language Requirements English-taught Programs: Must be an English native speaker or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, should provide a valid English proficiency certificate such as IELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥75, or TOEFL Essentials≥8 (DI Code: 806). 4. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

fields.description: Program Description This program is ideal for anyone wishing to advance their knowledge, skills, ability and career prospects in business. Business Management is a broad subject incorporating the business, economics, finance, and marketing among other relevant disciplines. Traning Target During the three years, you will study a broad range of subjects, explore several career paths as it develops your knowledge in a diverse range of sectors in the 21st century. Curriculum Economics Mathematics for Business English for Academic Purposes (EAP) Business Studies Business Economics Business Skills Organisational Behaviour Business Statistics Management Themes Marketing Strategic Planning: Shaping the Future Financial Fluency for Management Decision Making Academic and Professional Development Integrated Marketing Communications Managing an International Business Responsible and Ethical Business Practice Implementing Strategy and Change International Business Consultancy Project Financial Performance Management Managing the Digital Enterprise Marketing in a Global Context Leadership in Contemporary Organisations Career Plan Some students proceed to Master studies while others gain employment in all types of sectors and organizations. After graduation, students are extremely well-positioned in the job market given that they hold a highly-regarded and internationally recognized degree from a respected U.K. university, but they also have international experience and language skills that enable them to stand out amongst peers. After graduation, you will have the experience and skills to analyze a commercial opportunity, manage a project, solve problems, be able to operate in different cultures, communicate with other people and ultimately lead them. Internship&Job Sino-British College, USST offers lots of internships opportunities for students. Their career services department will deliver the newest information about the internship both on-campus and off-campus. Just contact them directly for application after school begins. Extracurricular Activities In Sino-British College, USST, you can engage in whatever activities you want. There are various student societies range from business practice societies and arts & culture societies to learning society and technology innovation society.

fields.description: Program Description I. Objectives The international economics and trade is designed to provide students with the specific knowledge and analytical skills they need to take advantage of the opportunities created by the economic globalization and the growing interdependence of the economies of nations. The program draws from a rich economics and management education combined with abundant knowledge in all the functional areas of international trade. After graduated, the students can work in foreign trade companies in their own country, transnational corporations, banks and governments. II. Requirements Students are required to obtain abilities to survey independently, analyze problems comprehensively, and make decisions on international businesses by theory learning and skill training in international economy and trades. Graduates should obtain knowledge and ability of the following aspects: To have a general knowledge of Chinese culture and business customs and practices; To have good ideological and political quality and moral ability; Master systematic theories and methods in international business; Be familiar with domestic and foreign business laws, regulations and customs; Maintain capabilities of communication, social skills, and team working; master the basic methods of information retrieval and query; Master qualitative and quantitative analysis methods to some extent in international business; to manage and execute international business deals; Possess abilities to solve international business issues, conduct business analyses and decisions; Have the ability to analyze and operate international trade business with big data and cross-border E-commerce. III. Core courses International Finance, International Trade, International Economics, International Business Simulation, International Trade Practices, International Business Writing, International Settlement, International Business Law, International Business Negotiations, etc. IV. Components of the 4-year Curriculum Category Credits 1. General Education Courses 22 2. Discipline Education Courses 30.5 3. Specialized Courses 88 Total 140.5 V. Table of Teaching Plan for Major of International Economics and Trade

fields.description: Program Description Introduction of TEFL program What is TEFL? TEFL stands for Teaching English as a Foreign Language. TEFL courses will equip you with the skills and confidence that you need to teach English as a foreign Language. Who is Eligible? Anybody is able to take our 120 hour online TEFL course. This program provides learners with elevated experiences and the tools required to engage and inspire future learners in English classrooms around the world. Internationally recognized, the program is certification authenticated in collaboration with a licensed from USA IAO . The online TEFL training is designed to assist teachers with the first step towards an exciting International teaching position. Where Can TEFL be Appl ied for ? TEFL is predominately taught in countries where English isn’t the native language. Opportunities commonly exist in schools and language institutes, but you will also find opportunities for private tutoring, corporate businesses, volunteering and online learning. Curriculum Unit 1: Language Acquisition Unit 2: Skills Unit 3: Teaching Grammar and Vocabulary Unit 4: Classroom Management Unit 5: Assessing Student Levels Unit 6: Modern Methods Unit 7: Demo Lesson It has been written by a Aussie Born TEFL expert and is designed for those first time teachers to equip you with what you need to get the knowledge and confidence to teach for the first time. It is one of the most up to date TEFL courses out there. Study Duration 120 hours training you have 180 days to complete. Completely online, so you can do it around other commitments. Once you have registered you can start learning immediately. Real life tutor support, our tutors are available throughout the week. Receive your certificate automatically after completion.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders. 2 Under the age of 25, applicants must have graduated from high school (those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide the graduation certificate no later than registration). 3 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect the normal study. 4 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent resident in foreign country should be obtained prior to the birth of the applicant. Applicants must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022, and must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Note: If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese Citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required. 5 Language Proficiency Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have HSK certificate. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate. No Chinese proficiency is required for the applicants to English-taught programs. If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). 6 Requirements on China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) Please refer to the program catalog.

The curriculum provides a broad education in the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence. The SUES core is made up of a general education courses and spescific Artificial Intelligence requirements of the accreditation guidelines such as Machine Learning, Group Intelligence, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing, Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality. The educational objectives are to provide each graduate with: 1) Engineering Competence that graduates are competent and engaged professionals in their field; 2) Continuous Learning Skills that graduates continue developing professionally; 3) Professional Skills that graduates demonstrate teamwork and leadership skills, and are contributors in their profession; 4) Societal Awareness that graduates recognize the societal, ethical, and global impacts of their work.
