fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Year one entry We welcome applications from high-quality candidates in all subjects with appropriate high school or equivalent qualifications. Students will normally be expected to have a high standing in their high school performance with a minimum B average in all subjects as well as relevant subjects. Year two entry Students who have completed A-levels or International Baccalaureate (or equivalent) will be considered for entry into Year Two, different programmes have different subject-relevant requirements. A-level: BBB IB Diploma: 30 points AP Exams or ACT Tests – High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 Notes: 1. BEng Architecture, BA Filmmaking, BA TV Production & BA Digital Media Arts: admissions for Year Two direct entry and Year Three transfer require a digital copy portfolio review and interview with members of Design School or the Academy of Film and Creative Technology, which can be conducted in person or via internet. 2. BA International Business with a Language: normally international students study Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students study Spanish or Japanese as the language option. For year 2 entry international students, students who are Chinese zero beginners will take an extra 5 credits Chinese language course. For year 2 entry Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan students, students should be able to demonstrate an equivalent level of Spanish (DELE/SIELE A1) or Japanese (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test N5). 3. BA Translation and Interpreting: for international and HK/Macao/Taiwan students whose native language is not Chinese, an HSK level 6 or the pass of the aptitude test arranged by the Department of Translation and Interpreting is required. 4. Programmes in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Design, Mechatronics and Technology Science and so on require both Mathematics and Physics. 5. Programmes in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Environmental Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and so on require Mathematics. 6. Programme in Architecture: for Year One entry, Math is required. However, for Year Two direct entry, having a background in Math is desirable but not essential. You can also find more information on entry requirements on our Country/Region list. English language requirements For international applicants, if you are a non-native English speaker, or if you have not previously studied in English, you must have satisfactory English language skills to study at XJTLU. Various English qualifications are accepted: Year one entry IELTS: 5.0 (min 4.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 62 (iBT) Year two entry IELTS 6.5 (min 5.5 in all sections) TOEFL: 90 (iBT) (min 21 in any skill) National/Region Qualifications Africa Ethiopia Ethiopian Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination (ESSLCE) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Ghana B in five relevant subjects on the Senior Secondary School Certificate (SSSC) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 Kenya Grade B or 65% overall in the final year on the Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE), and grade B in relevant subjects. English proficiency: KCSE English C Lesotho High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Mauritius GCE A-levels taken in Mauritius with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Morocco 14/20 overall in the final year on the Attestation du Baccalaureat, and 14 in relevant subjects. Namibia High school qualification with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Nigeria B in five relevant subjects on the NECO Senior School Certificate Examination (SSCE) or the WASSCE. English proficiency: WASSCE English C6 South Africa South African National Senior Certificate (SANSC) with 66665 excluding Life Orientation will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: SANSC English grade 5 Tanzania Certificate of Secondary Education (CSE) with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education (ACSE), Cambridge Overseas Higher School Certificate (COHSC), East African Advanced Certificate of Education (EAACE) with an average B will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: CSE English grade C Zambian School Certificate or General Certificate of Education with an overall grade of 4 from across at least 5 subjects, and grade 4 for relevant subjects. English proficiency: Secondary School Certificate English grade 6 Zimbabwe The ZIMSEC A-Level Certificate/Cambridge Higher School Certificate (HSC) with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: General Certificate of Education English C Asia Bangladesh Higher School Certificate (HSC) with an overall of GPA 3.5 out of 5.0, and 60% in relevant subjects. Cambodia Diploma of Upper Secondary Education with an average of B, and B in relevant subjects. Iran High school diploma (theoretical stream) with an overall score of 14 out of 20, and 14 in relevant subjects, including three year scores and final examination scores. India Standard XII will be considered for Year 2 direct entry: 75% or above when awarded by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) or the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); 80% or above when awarded by an accepted State Board. English proficiency: Standard XII CBSE/CISCE English 75%. Indonesia Indonesian SMA with an average of 70-80% in relevant subjects in three-year high school academic reports and final school exam respectively, plus an official National Diploma (Ijazah). Japan Kotogakko Sotsugyo Shomeisho (Upper Secondary School Leaving Certificate) with an average of 4/5 including relevant subjects, plus National Center Test for University Admissions. Kazakhstan Oрта білім туралы аттестат (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Unified National Testing (UNT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Kyrgyzstan Аттестат о среднем общем образовании (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. National Scholarship Test (NST) may be requested in non-standard applications. Malaysia UEC: a minimum of five subjects with at least grade B6, and at least grade B4 in Math/Physics for our Engineering/Science programmes will be considered for Year 1 entry. The following certificates are accepted for Year 2 direct entry: UEC: a minimum of five subjects with A2 in one subject and B3 in four subjects, excluding Bahasa Malay and Book Keeping and Commerce, plus High school Graduation certificate. STPM: Grade B in three of the five subjects. English proficiency: UEC English B4 (Y1 entry only) or SPM 1119 (UCLES board) English C Myanmar Three-year high school graduation with an average score and relevant subjects in 60%, plus Basic Education High School Examination/Matriculation Examination with a minimum score of 400 and no subjects lower than 60%. Mongolia Certificate of Complete Secondary Education with an average of B (or 80%), plus University Entrance Examination (UEE) with at least three Bs in relevant subjects. Nepal School Leaving Certificate (Grade XI &XII) from the National Examinations Board (NEB), with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 Pakistan Higher Secondary School Certificate (also known as Intermediate Certificate) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Philippines Senior High School Diploma (Academic Track) with an average of 80%, and 80% in relevant subjects. Saudi Arabia General Secondary Education Certificate with an overall mark 75% or above. Singapore Singapore Cambridge A-levels with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Singapore Cambridge O Level English C South Korea High School Certificate of Graduation with rank 5 or score 70%, and rank 5 or score 70% in relevant subjects. College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Thailand M6 School Leaving Certificate with an average of Grade 3 and with specific subject requirements. Uzbekistan Umumiy o’rta ta’lim to’g’risida attestat / shahodatnoma (Certificate of General Secondary Education) with an average of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Vietnam Bang Tot Nghiep Pho Thong Trung Hoc (Senior Secondary School Graduation Diploma) with an overall average of 7 (out of 10) with specific requirement in relevant subjects, plus National Senior Secondary School Graduation Examinations with specific requirements. Australasia Australia Successful completion of year 12 with High School qualification and a satisfactory admission index/entrance rank ATAR (Australian Tertiary Admission Rank) with 86% is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Australian High School qualification examples: Australian Capital Territory Senior Secondary Certificate, New South Wales Higher School Certificate New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) Level 3 is accepted for Year Two entry. Applicants should achieve: – 46 or more credits ranging from Merit to Excellent (excluding Learning Recognition credits), and – including three subjects at Level 3 or above, made up of 12 credits each at Excellent, and – Literacy – 10 credits at Level 2 or above, made up of 5 credits in reading and 5 credits in writing. Numeracy – 10 credits at Level 1 or above. Applicants should provide detailed description of their academic qualification. Europe France French Baccalaureat with 12 overall out of 20 with 12 in specified subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: French Baccalaureat English 13 Germany Zeugnis der Allgemeine Hochschulreife / Abitur with a minimum of 2.5 overall with a minimum of 10 in two Leistungskurse (advanced) subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Abitur English 12 Italy Diploma di Esame di Stato with a minimum of 80% overall is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Netherlands Voorbereidend Wetenschappelijk Onderwijs (VWO) with a minimum of 7 overall out of 10 is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Russia Attestat o Srednem Obshchem Obrazovanii (Certificate of Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Certificate of Unified State Examination may be requested in non-standard applications. United Kingdom (UK) AS-Levels will be considered for Year 1 entry. GCE A-Levels with BBB or IB with 30 points is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. North America Canada High School Diploma will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. Such as: British Columbia: British Columbia Senior Secondary School Diploma with grades BBBBB in grade 12 subjects; Ontario: Secondary School Diploma OSSD with an average of 70%, including six Grade 12 U, U/C, M courses (study in-person on campus for 2-3 years). OSSD awarded outside of Canada must be from an Awarding school listed on the Canadian Government website as a school authorised to award Ontario Secondary School Diploma credits. Other provinces: Secondary/High/Senior School Diploma with 70% average and 70%, 70%, 70%, 70%, 70% in grade 12 subjects. United States of America (USA) High School Graduation Diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above will be considered for Year 1 entry. Students who take AP Exams or ACT Tests will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 South America Brazil Certificado de Ensino Medio with grades of six, and six in relevant subjects. The Caribbean CAPE Diploma including three two-Unit level subjects (excluding core subjects) at grade II with specific requirement in relevant subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry.

fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Offer a wide range of courses such as listening, speaking, reading, news reading, comprehensive Chinese, business Chinese, video Chinese and Chinese culture. Enhance students' Chinese language proficiency in an all around way. Students can take live online classes, and teachers provide targeted one-on-one tutoring to students after classes via the teaching app. The mode is small class size teaching, and a class can be set up as long as there are three students or a bit more. The learning time can be arranged flexibly according to students' specific conditions, and the class lasts 8 weeks. This way, every student can have the chance to start learning the language as soon as possible, making it the best choice for those who want to learn Chinese but cannot come to China. Students Life we organize a variety of cultural activities every semester. You can learn how to play Tai Chi, cook Chinese food, visit the Great Wall in the spring, enjoy the scene of leaves falling in the fall, go to acrobatics shows, exhibitions, and eat delicious food. We also have Chinese culture festivals, calligraphy contests, and photography contests organized by students.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Features Editor Notes: This program can guarantees consistency and quality in our teaching methods and be accredited by EAQUALS. Study at the center of Shanghai: Study at West Yan' An Road Campus, Donghua University, enjoying decent public transportation and well-equipped facilities. Focus on language applications: We adopt the self-compiled textbook 'Chinese in Real Life', which is more suitable for international students' life in China. We also consider the application of Chinese language in daily life and the preparation for HSK tests. Integration of language learning and cultural understanding: We offer the introduction to Chinese culture as well as cultural lectures and practical activities to deepen students' understanding of Mandarin Chinese. Rich online learning materials: We offer various Chinese learning materials, including keywords, language points, recorded videos, dialogue videos, audios, course summaries, and etc. All Learning materials, as well as the assignments, will be uploaded to the learning management platform; and students both in online and offline courses can review the courses at any time. Various Course Levels: We can provide different course levels to meet different Chinese proficiencies from beginners to HSK6 learners. Assistant Support: We assign Chinese teachers or DHU Chinese students to each class as assistants to provide additional support for international students. Quality Accreditation: We are the only language program in China accredited by EAQUALS, which guarantees consistency and quality in our teaching methods. 2. Program Details Editor Notes: There are 8 levels including beginner, elementary, intermediate, and advanced courses. Class time: 9:00 AM - 12:15 PM Beijing Time, Monday to Friday (Except for holidays and special circumstances) Small class: Less than 25 people per class Levels: Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, and Advanced with a maximum of 8 levels. Students have to take a placement test to evaluate their Chinese proficiency, and they will be divided into different levels based on the test result. 3. Sample Timetable Editor Notes: The arrangement listed in the table may change according to adjustment. 4. Class arrangement Editor Notes: Students will be divided into different levels according to entrance placement test. Students have to take a placement test to evaluate their Chinese proficiency, and they will be divided into different levels based on the test result. In the 1st week, students are allowed to change the course level within a specific timeframe. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Donghua University offers the best Chinese language program and business program in Shanghai. Located in Shanghai, Donghua University is composed of the Yan’an Road Campus at the downtown area and the Songjiang Campus at the historical cradle of the city. The history of Donghua University can be traced back to the establishment of Nantong College in 1912 by Zhang Jian, a famous industrialist in Qing dynasty. In 1951, East China Institute of Textile Science & Technology was founded; in 1985, the name was changed to China Textile University; in 1999, it was changed again to Donghua University , Learn More>> 6. International Cooperation Editor Notes: Donghua University has always paid great attention to international exchange and cooperation. The School has cooperated with more than 100 institutions for higher education as well as well-known enterprises around the world. The joint programs such as Donghua-Carleton IMBA, Sino-German Education for Bachelor Degree of Light Chemical Engineering, and Sino-Japan Education for Bachelor Degree of Fashion Design & Engineering have always beening developed. Major international conferences as International Fashion Forum of Shanghai International Fashion Culture Festival and the 83rd World Conference of Textile Institute have been hosted by DHU successfully. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Every year, DHU will hold various kinds of activities on campus and off campus for international students. International Students Participate in Fraud Prevention Immersive Experience​ ​ The 9th International Cultural Festival​

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 .Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary foreign passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan)and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent resident in foreign country should be obtained prior to the birth of the applicant. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Note : If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the exit-entry administrations of the Chinese public security organs after application, admission or enrollment, their application eligibility, admission offer, enrollment qualification, or student status shall be revoked. 2 . General Requirements 2.1 Under the age of 25. Applicants must have graduated from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.5 or above; TOEFL: 80 or above; Duolingo: 120 or above Other requirements : Solid mathematics knowledge is recommended. 4. Requirements on China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) According to the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs are required to provide valid CSCA report. The China Scholarship Council will organize the first test on December 21, 2025, with registration opening in November. Specific times and arrangements will be released through the official website. Starting from 2026, the test service will be provided regularly, with five tests per year in January, March, April, June, and December. Required Subjects for CSCA: Mathematics 5. fields.description: Program Description Program Period July 6 - July 24 Course Arrangement Class Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (GMT+8), Monday to Friday (Weekends and free afternoons are for self-arranged activities.) Tentative Schedule *Remarks: Above schedule is subject to change. Final schedule will be given during the enrollment. Chinese Classes: Say goodbye to the worries of daily communication! Our core course is designed for practical use, helping you confidently handle a wide range of real-life situations—from ordering meals and shopping to making new friends. Multiple levels are offered, starting from beginner. Each class opens with a minimum of 8 students. Through a simple, user-friendly online placement test, we’ll help you find the class that best matches your ability, ensuring you progress efficiently alongside peers of similar levels. Cultural Lectures/Activities: Culture goes beyond textbooks! We’ve prepared a variety of engaging interactive lectures and workshops that let you experience firsthand the charm of Chinese culture. Discover the wisdom behind Chinese characters, appreciate the beauty of the language, try writing Chinese calligraphy with a brush, or paint a traditional round fan, paper umbrella, or opera mask—perfect as a gift for friends. You can also learn a set of health exercises rooted in traditional Chinese medicine and wellness philosophy, so you can share the practice with your loved ones back home. Through fun, hands-on activities, you’ll personally feel how traditional culture nourishes both body and mind, enriching everyday life. Language Practice: Learning Chinese is meant to be used in the real world! Under the guidance of instructors, you’ll step out of the classroom and into Shanghai’s authentic neighborhoods, shopping districts, and cultural landmarks to complete exciting “mission challenges.” Find unique local products in a supermarket, or strike up a brief conversation with a stranger in a café—every time you speak, you’ll be taking a real step forward in your language journey.

English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS or TOEFL results are generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -The document need to be in English or Chinese, document in other languages should be translated into Chinese or English. * 2. Study Plan -Suggested content includes: self-introduction; reasons for choosing China, this university, and this major; study plan in China; career goals; and conclusion. Highlight your motivation, interests, academic foundation, and fit with the chosen university and major. -Must be written in Chinese or English. -Suggested length: 1000 words or above. -Include your name and handwritten or electronic signature (no typed signatures), and submit a scanned copy of the signed document. -Ensure the university and program names are correct and specific to the application; do not use the same study plan for multiple universities. * 3. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 6. Guarantor Form -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Your guarantor must fill it, print, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The guarantor is usually one of your parents; you cannot be your own guarantor. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Guarantor's Passport A scanned copy of the local ID card or passport of your guarantor during your studies in China. 8. Notarized Guardian's Letter of Commitment -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in the same city as the university, and complete the notarization process as guided in our tutorial video . -Upload a scanned copy of the notarized Guardian’s Letter of Commitment. This document must be certified in your home country and notarized in China. -Please note that a Notarization of Declaration (声明公证) issued in China is eventually required. -A scanned copy is acceptable at the initial stage. If the university later requires the original document or additional materials, we will inform you. -For some universities, guardian services are available. You can learn more here . * 9. Bank Statement -Deposit certificate: It must be issued by a regular bank with the official seal of the bank and is valid within the last three months. -Amount required: The total deposit must reach RMB 60,000. -Account information: It is best to use your own account, if using a parent's account, you need to provide additional proof of relationship. The certificate should clearly show the account holder's name, account number, bank information and deposit balance and other key information. -Translation requirements: lf the deposit certificate is not in Chinese or English, an officially recognized translation must be provided. -Please note that failure to submit the required bank statement on time may affect the progress of your application or the outcome of your admission, We encourage applicants to prepare in advance and ensure the authenticity and validity of all financial documents. 10. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. 11. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality and Identity • Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport, of good character and sound health • Those who are originally citizens of China must comply with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education (Letter No.12 [2020]) 2. Educational Requirements • Possess an educational background equivalent to Chinese high school graduation. 3. Academic Transcript • Must provide official high school transcripts, graduation certificate (or pre-graduation certificate) • Provide scores from national/international standardized tests (e.g., SAT, A-Level, IB) 4. Language Requirements • Non-native Chinese speakers must provide a valid HSK Level 4 certificate (score ≥180) or above 5. Age Requirement • Must be at least 18 years old by September 1, 2026 • Applicants under 18 must submit notarized guardian documents as required

Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Personal Statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan. * 10. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate） Bank deposits should be more thanRMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 11. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 12. Other materials I) Product Design Required materials: at least 6 representative works The content must include: 1. Structural sketch 2. Creative colors 3. Effect drawings of product design works (Scope: Furniture, crafts, home appliances, jewelry design, etc. Include structural design drawings for better results) (II) Visual Communication Design Required materials: at least 10 representative works The content must include (but is not limited to): 1. Sketch 2. Colour 3. Advertisement project 4. Brand image design 5. Digital media design Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Fine Arts and Design will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test performance does not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate) Bank deposits should be more than RMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 10. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 11. Personal statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan * 12. Music Videos (I) Music Performance 1. Written materials • Personal Resume (CV) • A 2-3 page English self-introduction essay, which should include: ①Understanding of "What Does It Mean to Become a Musician" ② Career goals and implementation plans for the next five years ③ Understanding of Chengdu, China culture and social values, and its impact on the realization of personal goals • Two recommendation letters • Previous performance repertoire list 2. Music video material (1) Content Requirements ① Violin direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice (select from the following): - F. Kreutzer, 42 Etudes for Violin(Egelhoff edition): 17, - P. Rode, 24 Caprices for Solo Violin: 2, 4, 6, or 9, - J. Dont, Etudes Op.35: 2, 3, or 6 c. One self-selected showpiece piece (with accompaniment if available) ② Cello direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice to select from: - D. Popper, Highschool of Cello Playing, Op. 73 - A.C. Piatti, 12 Caprices for Solo Cello, Op. 25 c. One prelude and one other movement from Bach Suite No. 1, 2 or 3 d. One movement of a standard concerto ③ Piano direction (requiring memorization) a. One Virtuoso Etude (i.e.:Moszkowski or F. Chopin Etudes) b. First movement (Sonata-Allegro) of any Sonata from the Classical period c. One polyphonic work by J. S. Bach to select from: - Sinfonias / Three-part Inventions - Prelude and Fugue from Well-Tempered Klavier Book I and II - Two contrasting Baroque dances / movements from any of the French Suites, English Suites or Partitas d. Any major work (one movement of complete-set work) from the Romantic period or 20th Century that best reflects your performing skills ④ Vocal direction Submit two art songs or arias in different languages, from the following four languages: a. English b. Italian c. German or French d. Chinese or native language (2) Video technology specifications ① The music videos must be complete scores with a full-length shot. The sound and image of the video should be recorded simultaneously. The videos must not be edited by the means such as conversion， cutting， clipping, and embellishing. ② A light-coloured background should be used during the recording; the record shall start from the candidate's front face (like the ID photo) and then pull to the full-body view. The video picture should be stable with a clear view of the applicant. ③ The applicant shall be the only person in the video. Accompaniment personnel, suggestive text, pattern, logo, background, or other personal information (the Name, place of origin and school of the candidate, etc.) are not allowed to appear in the video. ④ The number of videos is limited to 1 (two works are in the same video), the format is specified to WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV, make sure the sound and image are transparent. The file size is less than 300MB. ⑤ Any violation of any above provisions shall be deemed a breach and may result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. ⑥Please send the video to the specified E-mail: ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn. Please name the e-mail by the order: Name+Program(bachelor or master)+Major+Passport Number (3) Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. (II) Dance Performance 1. Basic conditions •Height requirement: No less than 150cm for women and 170cm for men •Professional foundation: Possess dance fundamentals and can perform flexibility exercises including vertical splits, horizontal splits, and standing backbends. • Health status: physical and mental health, no physical problems that hinder dance performance 2. Video requirements • Content: Submit two solo dance video clips, each lasting at least 5 minutes (excluding street dance and ballroom dance). • Recording requirements: ① Venue: Dance rehearsal hall or stage theater ② Clothing: Training or performance attire ③Recording: Panoramic view, stable footage, synchronized music recording, no post-editing or beautification • Format and size: WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV. The file size should not exceed 300 MB. • Submission method: Send to email ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn, email subject: name - undergraduate - dance performance - passport number 3. Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Music and Dance will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test performance does not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description Qualification awarded: Chinese Learning Certificate Duration of study: one semester Teaching language: Chinese Teaching Objectives: After they conclude one semester's study and acquire the required credit points, students are supposed to have a vocabulary above 5000 words and finish learning the grammar and vocabulary of the intermediate phase. General Curriculum A. Mandarin course : 1. Mandatory courses: Intensive Reading, Spoken Chinese, Pronunciation, and Listening Comprehension & Video Course. 2. Elective courses: Students can electives from a variety of topics such as Chinese Folklore, Rhetoric, Writing, Newspaper Reading, and others. All courses aim to improve the student’s the ability to use Mandarin in real-life circumstances. B. Chinese Cultural Activities 1. Tai Chi (Taijiquan) , Chinese painting, Chinese calligraphy, visits to traditional Beijing residential area ( hutong ), etc. 2. Weekend trips to Terrocotta Warrior in Shaanxi Province, Chengde in Hebei Province, Mount Tai and Qufu in Shandong Province, and other historical and cultural sites. Note: Students who would like to withdraw from the program should submit their request before the registration at the beginning of the semester. Upon approval, the tuition fee can be refunded according to the school regulation. 10% of the tuition fee will not be refunded to cover the administrative fees (RMB only). For requests to withdraw after registration, the tuition fee for the current semester will not be refunded.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants should generally be 18–30 years old, meet the requirements of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, and be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid ordinary foreign passport. (1) According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, individuals who were born abroad and acquired foreign nationality at birth, with one or both parents being Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, do not hold Chinese nationality. Since 2021, such applicants applying as international students for undergraduate studies must, in addition to meeting other admission requirements, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four (4) years, and must have resided abroad for at least two (2) years within the most recent four years (up to April 30 of the year of enrollment). Residence abroad of 9 months within a year may be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps. (2) Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan who have emigrated and acquired foreign nationality and apply as international students must also meet the requirements stated in (1). For details, please refer to the Ministry of Education document Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Higher Education Institutions (Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12) 2.Applicants must have completed high school or possess an equivalent academic qualification, with academic performance (including Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) meeting admission requirements. Applicants with excellent results in the university’s foundation program will be given priority. 3.Applicants must be in good physical health and meet the specific admission requirements of the applied major: No severe myopia, color blindness, or color weakness; Normal hearing, sense of smell, and speech ability; Applicants with infectious diseases (such as hepatitis B, HIV, syphilis, tuberculosis), serious chronic illnesses, or other conditions that may affect completion of studies may apply only after full recovery; Applicants with mental or psychological disorders are not recommended to apply. Applicants found unfit for study during the entrance medical examination will have their admission cancelled. Health requirements are implemented in accordance with the Guiding Opinions on Physical Examination for Enrollment in Ordinary Higher Education Institutions (Teaching [2003] No. 3) and relevant supplementary regulations: 4.Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of China and the rules of Wenzhou Medical University. *Note: The Dental Surgery (BDS) program does not accept left-handed applicants. 5.CSCA (Undergraduate Academic Proficiency Test for Studying in China) transcript, with test subjects including English Mathematics and English Chemistry 6.Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or other recognized tests: IELTS ≥ 6.0 with no band below 5.0; TOEFL ≥ 70 with no section below 15; Duolingo ≥ 105), or Proof of full high-school education conducted in English.

CSCA certificate For Liberal Arts programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering the Mathematics subject) is required. For Science/Engineering programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering Mathematics and Physics) is required. For Medical programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry) is required.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 2. Non-Criminal Record Certificate Applicants should provide a Non-Criminal Record Certificate issued by the local public security authority, which should be no more than six months before the date of application. * 3. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Applicants need to provide documents demonstrating their funding sources (or financial guarantee by the guardian). Proof of financial capability can be one of the following documents, including family bank deposit certificate and parents/guardian's income certificate, with a recommended amount of no less than 5,000 US dollars. All uploaded certificates and documents must be original or notarized copies in Chinese or English. Applicants applying for full scholarships are exempt from such documents. * 5. Personal Statement A personal statement should include such content as self-introduction, reasons for application, understanding of the major, and study plan. * 6. Scanned Signature * 7. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. High school academic transcripts (sealed by the school). Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 10. A photocopy of the first page of the passport (at least six months before expiration from the date of application). Applicants currently living in Chinese mainland need to provide a photocopy of valid visa page or residence permit. * 11. High school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate (sealed by the school). Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and all be certified by notarization. Applicants applying with a pre-graduation certificate must denote the graduation date. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program includes three parts, which are Chinese culture and natural science courses, other 6 courses, and internship. The basic courses in 5-level are prone to strengthening the students’ abilities of listening, speaking, reading, writing. As students' Chinese levels are different, translation will be offered accordingly. There are some relevant culture courses like calligraphy, Chinese painting, Taiji Boxing (the Chinese shadow boxing), Chinese gardens, etc. This program includes 6 levels and every level is for one semester. Students who pass final exam will study the high grade of Chinese Course in the next semester. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This progam can be divided into 6 levels. 2.1 Level A 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the beginners of Chinese language, which focuses on training the students to use the simple Chinese in daily communication. When finishing this course, students are required to master 50 basic Chinese grammatical points, 900 words, basic simple sentence patters and some basic conversation modes and language functions, having the ability of making simple conversation on the most common topics in daily life. 2) Courses Listening,Conversation,Reading & writing 2.2 Level B 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the students who have mastered more than 800 Chinese vocabularies. After about four months study, the students basically shall be able to understand familiar and short sentences in daily social life, and can introduce themselves or other people simply, can communicate with others on familiar topics. the course especially pays attention to the training of the students’ knowledge and ability of HSK. 2) Main Courses Listening and speaking Reading & writing Extensive reading ​2.3 Level C 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop the students' ability of oral communication, and students’ reading and writing ability with the proficient use of new words, to comprehensively improve the communicative competence of listening, speaking, reading and writing for Intermediate level learners. The students are required to master about 800 multiplex words and about 120 ways of expression. 2) Main Courses Reading & writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.4 Level D 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop students' ability in Chinese through relatively separate and mutually complementary listening and speaking exercises, and acquire 200 Chinese idioms and traditional sayings. Students are also encouraged to contribute with texts and problems from their ongoing course or project work. 2) Main Courses Reading and Writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.5 Level E 1）Teaching Objectives Emphasis on outlining the overall features of the Chinese culture and describing dynamically its heritage. The students are required to take an active part in analysis, comparison, exchange and discussion in class to enrich their relevant knowledge. The materials are mainly selected from Chinese and foreign movies and programs on TV according to students’ interests and language proficiency. 2) Main Courses Advanced Chinese Reading &Writing Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Advanced AVO Chinese Timetable Sample 2.6 Class Size The minimum size of each class is 15 and the average is about 20. 2.7 Completion certificate Completion certificate will be awarded to students who passed the final exam. ​3. School Introduction Editor Notes: Shanghai University is well-known for its vigorous international exchanges and cooperation. ​ Shanghai University is one of the key universities in the "Project 211". The current president of the university is Professor CHIEN Weichang, a famous educator, scientist, social activist and member of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The Party Secretary of Shanghai University is Professor YU Xinhui and the Executive Vice President is Professor ZHOU Zhewei , Learn More>> 4. College of International Exchange Editor Notes: The School has built up academic links and cooperated with lots of foreign universities. The School provides short- or long-term courses of Chinese language, culture, and economics. There are also lots of optional courses and special lectures. The School will offer services of visas, accommodation and emergency aids for international students. 5. What Students Say Editor Notes: The School has lots of international students. ​ Name: Ou Chen From:​ Kenya Program: International Trade Subject: Why does he choose SHU? "The large population, long history and rapid development in the economy make China wonderland for me. Meanwhile Shanghai, as the economic center of China means more opportunity for learning and self-development. After checking the website, I found that I could not only find majors I liked here, but also many fun loving companions. These are the reasons I chose Shanghai University." ​ Name: Victoria From: Russia Program: Chinese Language and Literature Subject: How to get into the campus "Getting used to life here is easy. You can try to find your compatriots, but if you can't, don't worry, go to the ISU (International Students Union) in the dormitory hall, and you will get help. But, I think the best way to get yourself inside is to find a Chinese peer. After that I believe you will soon have a group of Chinese friends. Of course, if you still have any problem, go to the CIE office for help." Name: Yang Ling From: Thailand Program: Sociology Subject: One sentence to freshman "Welcome to Shanghai University! Here we have beautiful environment as well as many athletic facilities. In turn, you should work really hard, and you will find studying here is a real strain. After all, I believe studying abroad in Shanghai University will be your most cherished experience and you will also have deep love for this city." 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus.

Following students should meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC: (1) Students who emigrate from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality; (2) Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 3. Please refer to the program catalog for details, download here . 5. Applicants under the age of 18 must provide a guardian's certificate. If applicant's parents are not within the territory of China, they need to appoint a foreigner or a Chinese resident within China as their guardian.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Students will be suitable for all kinds of enterprises engaged in marketing, marketing management, senior international corporate marketing and global marketing. To cultivate students with high moral, good knowledge and innovative spirit. Based on Marketing and Management Studies. Graduates should manage at least one foreign language, computer skills, Merchandise sales, market research and forecasting, business negotiation, marketing planning, E-commerce applications, marketing and management skills. More than 90% of the staff has Ph.D. degrees in the related fields and 50% had the experiences of study or research abroad as Ph.D. candidates or researchers. More than twenty reputable professors from outside Shanghai University work part-time to collaborate with both the teaching and researching staff. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Courses are based on Marketing and Management. Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Principles of Management, Principles of Marketing, Financial Accounting, China Economic Introduction, Consumer Behavior, Distribution Strategy, Sales and Customer Relationship Management, Integrated Marketing Communication, Global Marketing. 3. Graduation​ Editor Notes: After graduation, students are employed in different range of industries. The graduates of SHU BBA are recruited into challenging roles, in a broad range of industries. Some of them choose to stay in China and some return to their own countries and work for the companies which have trading business with China. Generally speaking, they can be engaged in the areas like consulting, finance, accounting and marketing. 4. Brief Introduction to Shanghai University Editor Notes: NUAA is now a comprehensive university especially featured with Aerospace Engineering. Shanghai University is one of the key universities in the "Project 211". The current president of the university is Professor CHIEN Weichang, a famous educator, scientist, social activist and member of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The Party Secretary of Shanghai University is Professor YU Xinhui and the Executive Vice President is Professor ZHOU Zhewei. Shanghai University has a highly qualified and experienced team of faculty. There are currently more than 2,500 full-time faculty members with 11 members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering. Among all faculty members, 428 are full professors (16.97%) and 765 are associate professors (30.33%). Learn More about Shanghai University >> 5. About CIE Editor Notes: CIE plays an important role in the cooperation and communication between Shanghai University and the international communities. Dedicated to the teaching and research of Chinese language and culture as well as the coordination for the affiliated Confucius Institutes abroad. Offers a variety of optional courses and special lectures. Be responsible for the enrollment and administration of all international students, providing services for visas, accommodation and emergency aids, etc.

(4) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Oficial transcripts from the highest degree-granting institution (original) Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate) Bank deposits should be more than RMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 10. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 11. Personal statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan * 12. Music Videos (I) Music Performance 1. Written materials • Personal Resume (CV) • A 2-3 page English self-introduction essay, which should include: ①Understanding of "What Does It Mean to Become a Musician" ② Career goals and implementation plans for the next five years ③ Understanding of Chengdu, China culture and social values, and its impact on the realization of personal goals • Two recommendation letters • Previous performance repertoire list 2. Music video material (1) Content Requirements ① Violin direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice (select from the following): - F. Kreutzer, 42 Etudes for Violin(Egelhoff edition): 17, - P. Rode, 24 Caprices for Solo Violin: 2, 4, 6, or 9, - J. Dont, Etudes Op.35: 2, 3, or 6 c. One self-selected showpiece piece (with accompaniment if available) ② Cello direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice to select from: - D. Popper, Highschool of Cello Playing, Op. 73 - A.C. Piatti, 12 Caprices for Solo Cello, Op. 25 c. One prelude and one other movement from Bach Suite No. 1, 2 or 3 d. One movement of a standard concerto ③ Piano direction (requiring memorization) a. One Virtuoso Etude (i.e.:Moszkowski or F. Chopin Etudes) b. First movement (Sonata-Allegro) of any Sonata from the Classical period c. One polyphonic work by J. S. Bach to select from: - Sinfonias / Three-part Inventions - Prelude and Fugue from Well-Tempered Klavier Book I and II - Two contrasting Baroque dances / movements from any of the French Suites, English Suites or Partitas d. Any major work (one movement of complete-set work) from the Romantic period or 20th Century that best reflects your performing skills ④ Vocal direction Submit two art songs or arias in different languages, from the following four languages: a. English b. Italian c. German or French d. Chinese or native language (2) Video technology specifications ① The music videos must be complete scores with a full-length shot. The sound and image of the video should be recorded simultaneously. The videos must not be edited by the means such as conversion， cutting， clipping, and embellishing. ② A light-coloured background should be used during the recording; the record shall start from the candidate's front face (like the ID photo) and then pull to the full-body view. The video picture should be stable with a clear view of the applicant. ③ The applicant shall be the only person in the video. Accompaniment personnel, suggestive text, pattern, logo, background, or other personal information (the Name, place of origin and school of the candidate, etc.) are not allowed to appear in the video. ④ The number of videos is limited to 1 (two works are in the same video), the format is specified to WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV, make sure the sound and image are transparent. The file size is less than 300MB. ⑤ Any violation of any above provisions shall be deemed a breach and may result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. ⑥Please send the video to the specified E-mail: ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn. Please name the e-mail by the order: Name+Program(bachelor or master)+Major+Passport Number (3) Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. (II) Dance Performance 1. Basic conditions •Height requirement: No less than 150cm for women and 170cm for men •Professional foundation: Possess dance fundamentals and can perform flexibility exercises including vertical splits, horizontal splits, and standing backbends. • Health status: physical and mental health, no physical problems that hinder dance performance 2. Video requirements • Content: Submit two solo dance video clips, each lasting at least 5 minutes (excluding street dance and ballroom dance). • Recording requirements: ① Venue: Dance rehearsal hall or stage theater ② Clothing: Training or performance attire ③Recording: Panoramic view, stable footage, synchronized music recording, no post-editing or beautification • Format and size: WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV. The file size should not exceed 300 MB. • Submission method: Send to email ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn, email subject: name - undergraduate - dance performance - passport number 3. Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Music and Dance will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test performance does not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. fields.description: Program Description Program overview The school of Tourism and Hotel Management also offers a full-time program at the master level. The school aims to cultivate cultural and tourism leaders with cultural heritage, management characteristics, innovation consciousness and international pattern. Graduates of this program can work as an administrator in tourism companies. This program focuses on shaping students' skills in problem-solving and logical thinking. Students in this program can take advantage of our close relationship with major international companies to conduct study and research. Students will also have the opportunity to gain an internship in world-renowned hotels and resort companies in Dalian. This major includes three research orientations: tourism economic management, social and cultural tourism and tourism planning and development.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants should generally be 18–30 years old, meet the requirements of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, and be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid ordinary foreign passport. (1) According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, individuals who were born abroad and acquired foreign nationality at birth, with one or both parents being Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, do not hold Chinese nationality. Since 2021, such applicants applying as international students for undergraduate studies must, in addition to meeting other admission requirements, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four (4) years, and must have resided abroad for at least two (2) years within the most recent four years (up to April 30 of the year of enrollment). Residence abroad of 9 months within a year may be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps. (2) Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan who have emigrated and acquired foreign nationality and apply as international students must also meet the requirements stated in (1). For details, please refer to the Ministry of Education document Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Higher Education Institutions (Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12) 2.Applicants must have completed high school or possess an equivalent academic qualification, with academic performance (including Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) meeting admission requirements. Applicants with excellent results in the university’s foundation program will be given priority. 3.Applicants must be in good physical health and meet the specific admission requirements of the applied major: No severe myopia, color blindness, or color weakness; Normal hearing, sense of smell, and speech ability; Applicants with infectious diseases (such as hepatitis B, HIV, syphilis, tuberculosis), serious chronic illnesses, or other conditions that may affect completion of studies may apply only after full recovery; Applicants with mental or psychological disorders are not recommended to apply. Applicants found unfit for study during the entrance medical examination will have their admission cancelled. Health requirements are implemented in accordance with the Guiding Opinions on Physical Examination for Enrollment in Ordinary Higher Education Institutions (Teaching [2003] No. 3) and relevant supplementary regulations: 4.Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of China and the rules of Wenzhou Medical University. *Note: The Dental Surgery (BDS) program does not accept left-handed applicants. 5.CSCA (Undergraduate Academic Proficiency Test for Studying in China) transcript, with test subjects including English Mathematics and English Chemistry 6.Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or other recognized tests: IELTS ≥ 6.0 with no band below 5.0; TOEFL ≥ 70 with no section below 15; Duolingo ≥ 105), or Proof of full high-school education conducted in English.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements (1) Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid passport, with good moral conduct, in good health, in friendly relation with China and observe Chinese laws, regulations and university's rules and regulations. Applicants who have already resided in China should apply 40 days before the expiration of residence permit. (2) If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant shall have foreign nationality at birth and shall hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, applicants must provide a record of at least 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country during the last 4 years (April 30, 2018 to April 30, 2022). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signatures. For residences of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above. (3) Applicants should reach the admission requirements, such as grades, academic level and language proficiency. (4) Language proficiency requirements: English-spoken Programs: IELTS 5 (at least) or TOEFL 60 (at least) (5) Applicants for Bachelor: Academic credentials equivalent to Chinese senior high school.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements To be eligible, an applicant must: (1) Be non-Chinese nationality, hold a foreign passport and meet the relevant requirements of the Regulation No.〔2020〕12 by Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. (2) Stay in good health both mentally and physically, and meet the physical examination standards for the study visa or residence permit in China required by the Chinese government. (3) Abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the University rules and regulations; be diligent and well-performed in academics and good conduct; no violation of the University rules and disciplines, no public security punishment, no criminal record. (4) Photocopy of new HSK level 5 certificate with score of 180 points or above level for those who applying for Chinese-taught programs. (5) Under the age of 30 for the undergraduate programs. (6) Abide by requirements of other relevant laws and regulations. (7) Test results of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). Required Subjects download here .
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-Criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is valid for only 3 months. For instance, if you submit your -application in April, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than January. -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -You need to translated it into CHINESE if it is not in Chinese; Then you need to get it notarized by local notary office and then get it certified by local Chinese embassy; If your country has joined the HAGUE convention then just do the Chinese translation and Apostille; Then you may need to mail original copy of non-criminal record and translation & certified(or Apostille) documents to the university in China. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. * 2. Letter of recommendation Should be written in Chinese or English, provided by professors or associate professors. /teachers from your senior high school. * 3. Medical examination report valid within 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Certificate of HSK * 5. Photocopy of passport main page and Chinese visa page (*if any) * 6. A 1-inch digital bareheaded colorized photo * 7. High school academic transcript Notarized Chinese or English versiton must be provided instead of other foreign languages. * 8. High school graduate certificate Notarized Chinese or English versiton must be provided instead of other foreign languages. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Applicants applying for English-taught undergraduate programs do not need to take the professional Chinese test; applicants applying for a bachelor's degree in Chinese language can be exempted from the professional Chinese test if they can provide a valid HSK Level 4 score report. In the basic subjects, regardless of the applied major, mathematics is a compulsory subject; in addition, applicants for science, engineering, agriculture, and medicine-related majors are generally required to choose at least one of the above two subjects -- physics or chemistry. The test for mathematics, physics and chemistry are provided in both Chinese and English, and applicants can choose the language of the test according to the teaching language requirements. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

X-ray report -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. fields.description: Program Description I. Training Objectives The program develops students’ international vision [Goal 1] and Internet thinking [Goal 2], to have a solid command of international business theory, competencies of English-Chinese bilingual application, eCommerce practice and applications [Goal 3], and ability of innovation and entrepreneurship [Goal 4], to adapt to the trend of economic globalization and cross-border eCommerce development and the needs of regional economic development [Goal 5], and to be able to engage in not only foreign economic and trade management in government departments but also in international trade, international investment or cross-border eCommerce related work in enterprises, as well as to be international applied talents with high-quality in the field of digital economy [Goal 6]. II. Graduation Requirements By learning the basic theories and knowledge of Management, Economics, International Trade, Cross-border eCommerce and etc., and receiving systematic Internet thinking and international business training, students will have the preliminary ability to engage in international trade, international finance, international logistics, cross-border eCommerce and other businesses. Graduates should acquire the following knowledge, abilities and qualities through academic study: 1. Specialized Knowledge. Students should master the elementary theories of Economic Management, and have solid elementary knowledge of International Trade, International Finance, International Logistics and Cross-border eCommerce; students should grasp the frontier of international business theory and practice development; students should be familiar with international economic and trade systems and practices; students should master Chinese, English and computer application knowledge; students should have the basic knowledge and accomplishment in humanities, social sciences and natural sciences. 2. Practice and Application Ability. Students should be equipped with market sensitivity while possessing the capability of practice and application in international trade, international finance, cross-border eCommerce and international enterprise management. 3. Internationalization and Modernization. Students should develop diversified global communication skills, computer application and business data analysis ability, and be capable of intercultural communication and modernization work. 4. Problem Analysis. Students should understand the relevant theories of different branches of international business, pay attention to the development of the discipline, and can use innovative methods to acquire knowledge, analyze and solve business problems, and draw effective conclusions. 5. Humanities Quality: Students should have the qualities of international vision, entrepreneurial spirit, social responsibility, humanistic care, and citizen awareness. III. “Training Objectives-Graduation Requirements” and “Graduation Requirements-Curriculum System” Correspondence Matrix 1. “Training Objectives-Graduation Requirements” Note: Mark the appropriate column with “●”. 2. “Graduation Requirements-Curriculum System” Correspondence Matrix (Identified by relevance, the degree of relevance between the course and a certain graduation requirement is qualitatively estimated according to the strength of the course’s satisfaction of the corresponding graduation requirement, H: Indicates high correlation; M: Indicates medium correlation; L: Indicates low correlation.) IV. Fundamental Subject Platform Courses and Professional Core Courses 1. Fundamental Subjects Platform Courses Principles of Economics, Introductory of Digital Economy, Theory of International Trade, Management 2. Professional Core Courses The practice of International Trade, International Marketing, E-Marketing, Application of Statistical Analysis, Network Retail, Web Design, Case Study of E-commerce, Academic Writing and Presentation, Corporate Finance, International Trade Laws, Consumer Behavior, Human Resources Management, International Business Negotiation, Strategy Management, Supply Chain and Logistics Management, Photography, Animation and Design, Cross-border eCommerce Operation, Innovation Management and Business Model Design V. Professional Admission and Graduation Standard This program is for international undergraduates only, not open for a major switch or minor degrees. VI. Length of Schooling and Degree The basic length of study of this major is four years. The maximum is not more than six years. The Bachelor of Management degree will be conferred after completing all credits and scoring at least 180 points (including 180 points) on the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK). VII. Minimum Graduation Credits and Class Hours The minimum graduation credits are 160 credits and students must complete 2,560 class hours. VIII. Course Structure, Curriculum and Distribution of Credits 1. Course Structure The course structure consists of ideological education courses and professional courses: Ideological education courses include: Orientation, Chinese language, Overview of China, China Road and China Model, as well as Social Project. Professional Courses include Fundamental subject platform courses and core professional courses. Table 1: Course Structure 2. Curriculum and Distribution of Credits Table 2: Ideological Education Curriculum and Credit Distribution 2. 1． Ideological Education Required Courses: 40 Credits Table 3: Professional Courses Curriculum and Credit Distribution 1． Fundamental Subjects Platform Courses: 20 Credits 2． Professional Core Courses: 70 Credits Table 4: Internship and Practice Setup and Credit Distribution 1. Internship and Practice: 30 Credits Note: 1. All courses in this program are delivered in English. 2. Admission course, graduation courses, minoring in courses, leave a checkmark (√).
