fields.description: Program Description Objectives of Study: This program is based on core skills of Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology for Software Engineering that meets the requirements of Shanghai Dianji University instructional guidelines. The Software Engineering curriculum provides a broad education in the fundamentals of Software Engineering. The TSDJU core is made up of a general education courses and spescific Software Engineering requirements of the accreditation guidelines such as software requirement analysis and design, application software development, software testing and quality assurance and software project management and maintenace. The educational objectives are to provide each graduate with: 1)Engineering Competence that graduates are competent and engaged professionals in their field; 2)Continuous Learning Skills that graduates continue developing professionally; 3)Professional Skills that graduates demonstrate teamwork and leadership skills, and are contributors in their profession; 4)Societal Awareness that graduates recognize the societal, ethical, and global impacts of their work. Core courses: Advanced Programming Language, Object-Oriented Programming (JAVA), Data Structures(JAVA), Database Principls and Application, Software Engineering, Software Testing and Quality Assurance, Software Project Management, WEB Programming Major practice part: Professional practice, Social skills, Engineering-Basic Training, Subject & major course practice, Comprehensive experimental, Graduate practice and Graduate project (paper) Employment prospects: This major is a wide calibre major, with a research scope covering computer applications, software development, software implementation, software testing, information processing, and many other fields. Job opportunities include software development, software implementation, software testing, software maintenance, and software technical support for modern manufacturing enterprises, information departments in modern service industries, and information technology enterprises.

fields.description: Program Description Ranked as top film school in China, Beijing Film Academy's film production international program is a 4-year English-teaching program, offering all kinds of professional courses including Directing, Cinematography, Post-production, and etc. We're committed to cultivate talents to master the whole workflow of filmmaking. In addition to gain professional knowledges, you will also have opportunity to learn valuable skills from masters in the industry. You will meet interesting people, develop yourself, and create connections which will bring you endless opportunities in the future. With rapid growth of China film industry, we believe it will be a perfect platform for you to start off your career in film industry. We provide industry standard facilities to all students in the department, including professional editing studios, sound studios, color correction studios, screening rooms, as well as a range of cinematic cameras, lighting products etc. -- Everything you may need to make your script into film. Most students and teachers in the department speak English and willing to offer help, so you don't need to worry about the language barrier. We also offer Chinese classes during the study period. So, what are you waiting for? Join us to start your new chapter in film!

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should observe the laws and decrees of China as well as the rules and regulations of the university, while respecting the customs and traditions of the Chinese people. Additionally, they should demonstrate good moral character, have no criminal record, and be in good health, enabling them to study and live independently in China. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, between the ages of 18 to 40 (Date of Birth is after August 31, 1985). Applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2025, must have a guardian in China. 3. With both or one of the parents being Chinese citizens and residing outside China, the applicant who acquired a foreign nationality at birth shall hold a valid foreign nationality certificate for at least 4 years before applying. In addition, the applicant’s record of at least 2 years of actual residence abroad during the last 4 years must be provided (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year subject to the date on the entry and exit stamp. For residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please also follow the requirements above. 4. Applicants should have a certificate equivalent to a Chinese high school graduation certificate or above. 5. Applicant’s Chinese proficiency must meet the requirements of the majors applied for. For those applying for the “Chinese as a Second Language” major and “Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages” major, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required; for other majors, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 5 is required. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Be a non-Chinese citizen in good health; 2. Be a high school graduate or its equivalent, no younger than 18 years. 3. Should comply with the regulations (JW〔2020〕No. 12) issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. HSK 5(>180 score) or above is required. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-Criminal Record Report The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. * 2. Two letters of recommendation The letter is provided by your teacher in high school, written in Chinese or English with teacher’s contact information. * 3. A Personal Statement The content includes your academic background, application reasons, study plan and career objectives, etc., written in Chinese no fewer than 800 words. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form(photocopy), please written in English The physical examinations must cover all of the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form, filled in Chinese or English. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Individual works The applicant for the arts or design program shall provide his/her own works (such as videos and paintings) via the online application system. * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. Photo page of your valid passport If the validity of the applicant’s current passport does not meet the requirement, which means the expiry date of the passport should be after March 1, 2027, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application. Passport information cannot be changed before registration of enrollment. * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Official Academic transcripts Complete academic records from first to last semester shall be provided. The languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 10. High School Diploma Prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status by their current school. The languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

The applicant must possess education background equivalent to or above Chinese high school education. c. The applicant's Chinese proficiency must reach the new HSK Level 4 with a score of 180 or more (not required for those who have completed secondary or higher education program based on using Chinese as teaching medium). d. International student applicants with former permanent residency in P.R. China (Mainland), China-Hong Kong, China-Macau or China-Taiwan having emigrated abroad, must provide evidence for possession of current valid foreign passport or nationality documentation for more than 4 years (inclusive), and evidence or proof of actual residency abroad for more than 2 years within the previous 4 years period calculated by the 30th of April prior to the end of the academic year (actual residency is calculated by total of residency abroad for more than 9 months per year, subject to valid entry and exit date stamps on travel document).

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Comprehensive Requirements In principle, applicants for undergraduate programs should be under 25 years old. The applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, who is physically and mentally healthy and has good conduct. With a valid foreign passport, they should have completed the study of the previous stage (those who have not graduated while applying must provide the pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before the registration). 2.Nationality Requirements Foreign students should meet the nationality requirements stipulated in the document No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education.Since 2021, any applicant who applies to study in undergraduate or college diploma programs in China's higher education institutions as an international student shall, in addition to meeting other eligibility criteria of the institutions, have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years (inclusive) and have a record of actual residence abroad for two years or more in the past four years (by April 30 of the admission year). Nine consecutive months of residence abroad in a year may be considered as one year, and the calculation is based on entry and exit stamps. 3.Language Requirements English-taught Degree Programs: Applicants (except for English native speakers) must provide proof of English language proficiency such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO Proof or proof of previous study conducted in English. fields.description: Program Description I. University Introduction Ningxia Medical University (NXMU) was founded in 1958. It is a higher medical university with a certain influence and popularity among similar colleges in China, which was authorized to enroll international students by Ministry of Education (MOE LIST), and also authorized by China Scholarship Council to cultivate the Chinese government scholarship students. Until now, over 400 international students from 51 countries study here. II. Program Overview The program is oriented by job competence in line with the basic requirements of training objectives in international clinical medicine, and medical needs of the countries of origin, as well as international requirements of source countries or serving in a third country after graduation. Aiming to cultivate specialized talents with solid basic medical knowledge, standardized clinical skills, good professional quality, preliminary ability of international exchange and cooperation, recognition and adaptation to cultural diversity, and the ability to use Chinese language to provide medical, teaching and scientific research work in the medical and health service sector. III. Program Duration 5 years ( The 1st-4th year are theoretical studies, the 5th year is internship)

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be aged between 18 and 30 years old, non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders, healthy and well-behaved, with an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma, without any criminal records. Applicants should abide by the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and related rules of university, honor the Chinese social morality and customs, and will not participate in any activities which are inappropriate to the capacity as a student. 2. Chinese Proficiency Requirements (1) Applicants for science and engineering program taught in Chinese must have HSK 4 certificate (with 180 points or above). HSK 5 certificate (with 180 points or above) is required for applicants for liberal arts, economic and management program. The certificate must be in valid period. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate by providing the academic documents. (2) Applicants who haven't reached the required language level, can apply Chinese language program in the International Exchange College (hereinafter as "IEC"). After achieving HSK certificate, they can apply for the degree study. 3. According to the Document No. 12〔2020〕of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China (see Appendix 1), If the applicant's parents or one of the parents are Chinese or the applicant has emigrated from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality for, they must be naturalized for 4 years or more and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during the past 4 years (Actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). ---- Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship and become foreign citizens should provide: (1) Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship; (2) Documents certifying the acquirement of foreign citizenship; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. ---- Applicants who have acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen should provide: (1) Documents certifying acquiring foreign citizenship at the time of birth; (2) Documents certifying parent's (with Chinese citizenship) permanent residence in foreign country before the birth of the applicant; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Between the age of 18-25 with a High School Certificate or Diploma. The above applicants must be Non-Chinese citizens in good health with Non-criminal records. These foreigners guarantee to observe Chinese disciplines and laws and obey the university rules and regulations. Do respect Chinese culture and customs during your study at HDU. The applicants' Chinese proficiency is not required for an English-taught program. Still, either New TOEFL (above 80), IELTS (above 5.5), or the related Certificate, will be accepted after providing is confirmed or met the application requirement.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. --Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or EF SET. -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Bank Statement Financial support statement issued by the local bank from the applicants’ host country. 9. Guardian's Letters for Students Under 18 -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in Hangzhou -Need Chinese guardian living in Hangzhou to sign two guardian documents (download from attachments) one is consent letter signed by parents, another is commitment letter from guardian and provide scan copies of them. -Aso the university will call the guardian to verify. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. International Student Health Report Download from attachment, fill in information, print it, sign it and send us scan copy of it. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. Documents for Students Who Ever Study in China If you ever study in China you also need to provide the following 5 documents issued by your previous school: 1: A statement of Daily performance 2: Original official transcript 3: Attendance rate certificate 4: Enrollment certificate 5: Completion certificate Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports; If the applicant is a Chinese citizen who has immigrated to a foreign country, the application will be strictly reviewed in accordance with the "Higher Education Quality Standards for International Students Studying in China (Trial Implementation)"; 2. In good health, between 18 and 25 years old; for applicants pursuing a master's degree, the age limit can be appropriately relaxed; 3. No criminal record, willing to abide by the laws, regulations, and relevant management regulations of the People's Republic of China and our university; 4. Have a high school diploma or above; applicants for postgraduate studies must have a bachelor's degree or above; 5. For applicants of English-taught majors, the high school graduation exam total score should be at least B level (score 60%-70%) or above, with an English subject score of at least 65% of the full score, or an IELTS certificate with a score of 6.5 or above.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included. The valid period is at least 18 months. * 3. Certification of no criminal record * 4. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test),No need for English medium programs * 5. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Academic transcript of highest education Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Letter of guarantee Signed by the applicant, the applicant's financial guarantor and the guarantor in China. * 8. Valid identity document of the applicant's guarantor For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc. * 9. Financial support statement Certificate of annual fixed income issued by parent work unit or qualified institution. The frozen period of certificate of deposit is at least 3 months including tuition fee, living fee and accommodation fee. 10. Physical examination record for foreigner Physical examination record for foreigner * 11. Valid identity document of the guarantor in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Having high school diploma or equivalent; 2. Age: 18 to 55 years old. If under 18, the applicant must have the consent of school and provide relevant documents such as a notary certificate of guardianship; 3. Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign ordinary passports; 4. English language proficiency certificate. *If both or one parent of the applicant is a Chinese citizen and settled in a foreign country, and the applicant (without Chinese nationality) has a foreign nationality at birth, should have held a valid foreign passport or foreign nationality certificate for at least 4 years and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least 2 years within the last 4 years (until April 30 of the enrollment year) (actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). *Residents of China's mainland, Hong Kong region, Macau region and Taiwan region who have immigrated and acquired foreign nationality should also meet the requirements above when applying for undergraduate studies at BLCU as international students.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 2. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 5. Academic record (Transcript of the highest degree) Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Academic diploma (Certificate of the highest degree. Prospective diploma recipients must provide a pregraduation letter issued by their current school) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 7. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 8. Letter of recommendation Written in English or Chinese from two respectable professors. including professors' contact no, email address and handwritten signature * 9. Birth certificate (must contain both parents' information) * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Training Objectives Our full-time master's degree program in Engineering Management (MEM, Logistics Engineering and Management) is oriented towards solving related issues in the logistics and supply chain management support fields such as the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, the efficient and intensive commercial circulation system, and the transformation of digital information technology. It aims to cultivate strong professional skills and professional ethics, and master the basic theories, tools, and methods of logistics engineering and management, Familiar with the current situation and cutting-edge trends in the development of international logistics engineering and management, with the ability to solve complex problems in the field of actual logistics engineering and management, as well as the ability to plan, organize, coordinate, and make decisions, and able to meet the needs of high-level, applied, and composite professional and professional talents in the field of modern logistics and supply chain. 2. Training Method and Length of Study The tutorial responsibility system is implemented, and curriculum learning and professional practice can be conducted in a cross manner. The course learning adopts the credit system, and the required credits should be completed before applying for the defense of the degree thesis. Professional practice time shall not be less than half a year. The length of study for full-time professional master's degree graduates is generally 3 years, with a maximum of 5 years. 3. Professional Core Courses Serial Number Course No Course name credit Credit hours 1 ITIN198_ 20T Engineering Ethics 2 32 2 ITIN199_ 20T Operations Research 2 32 3 ITIN200_ 20T Applied Statistics 2 32 4 ITIN201_ 20T Logistics and Supply Chain Management 2 32 5 ITIN202_ 20T Operation Management 2 32 6 ITIN203_ 20T Systems Engineering 2 32 7 ITIN204_ 20T Logistics System Theory 2 32 8 ITIN205_ 20T Logistics System Modeling and Simulation 2 32 4. Dissertation The degree thesis should be completed independently under the guidance of a mentor, and the actual workload of the thesis is generally not less than 1 year. The selected topic of the paper should come from the actual situation of the enterprise, have a clear engineering background and application value, have certain technical difficulty and progressiveness, and can reflect the author's ability to comprehensively apply scientific theories, methods and technical means to solve practical logistics problems. The number of words in the body of the thesis shall not be less than 20000 words; There are no less than 30 references, mainly from the past 5 years. 5. Degree Award Graduates who have completed the course study and required courses according to the personal training plan within the time limit specified by the length of schooling, passed the examination, and passed the defense of their degree thesis are granted graduation and a graduation certificate is issued. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non Chinese citizens aged 18-30, graduated from high school or equivalent educational one, physically and mentally healthy (without color blindness or color weakness). 2. Those whose parents (one or both) are Chinese citizens and have settled in a foreign country, who have foreign nationality at the time of their birth, and who immigrate from the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan to foreign countries, as applicants for studying in China, must hold valid foreign passports or international certification documents for at least 4 years, and there is a record of actual residence abroad for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30th of the enrollment year). 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: Applicants must have proof of HSK Level 4 (no less than 180 points) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency tests. Those whose medium of instruction during the whole learning period of the highest academic qualification is Chinese can be exempted from the certification of Chinese test results, but must submit the certification of Chinese teaching issued by the graduation college or university. 4. The previous academic performance shall meet one of the following requirements: (1) Excellent performance in senior high school graduation examinations, with the score of mathematics no less than 70 points (out of 100 points), and the score of either physics or chemistry also no less than 70 points (out of 100 points). (2) Having completed the Preparatory program recognized by our university and met the graduation standards. 5. A score not lower than 70 points (on a 100-point scale) in the entrance interview (conducted remotely or on campus). 6. CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.

fields.description: Program Description Tuition: 14500 Yuan/RMB/the fall semester 19350 Yuan/RMB/the spring semester Introduction: Tongji University is one of the first universities to undertake the Pre-University education of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate students in China, and at the same time recruit self funded preparatory students. Located in Siping Road Campus of Tongji University, the Pre-University department for foreign students of Tongji University, Ministry of education, has a teaching building with Chinese traditional architectural characteristics, modern teaching facilities such as multimedia classroom, special classroom, lecture hall, electronic reading room, Chinese culture classroom, and a team of full-time teachers of Chinese, physics, mathematics and chemistry. All the teachers have graduate degree or above, and the teachers are strong enough to fully meet the needs of Pre-University education. At present, the Pre-University Department has nearly 80 countries of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate preparatory students and some self funded students in school. They will systematically study general Chinese, professional Chinese, mathematics, physics, chemistry and other basic courses, and participate in various forms of school activities, such as language and culture activities around teaching, Experience of China activities, etc. As one of the most famous universities in China, Tongji University’s international student Pre-University “bridge course” is connected with China's famous universities. According to the characteristics of international students, the preparatory course “bridge course” helps students quickly master the learning methods of China’s famous universities, adapt to the undergraduate learning life in advance, shorten the adaptation period of studying abroad, and finally smoothly enter the dream university suitable for themselves to study undergraduate major. In the regular Chinese program, winter semester usually starts at the beginning of September and ends at the beginning of January, while summer semester usually from early March to late June. 2. Courses Structure Editor Notes: There are 16 teaching weeks in each semester, with 20+ class hours (Chinese classes plus selective courses) each week. Students will have Chinese classes in the morning from Monday to Friday, and the selective courses in the afternoon. Selective courses usually include China economy lectures and various cultural classes according to students' needs. 3. Textbooks New Practical Chinese Reader , Chinese Tutorial and Developing Chinese (published by Beijing Language and Culture University) are mainly used as textbooks, together with supportive textbooks like General Information of China and Elementary Business Chinese Dialogue as well as the University's own teaching materials. 4. Fees Application Fee: RMB 400 Textbooks and Materials (in RMB): About 150 to 300 per semester 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: It is one of the top 100 universities in the nation's 211 Project, a national initiative to build 100 first-class universities in the 21st century. The University , boasts a strong faculty of scholarly excellence and professional dedication. Added to this is the classic campus setting, situated in Chengdu, a beautiful city of fine culture and long history plus being in the vicinity of Du Fu Thatched Cottage, residence of a prominent poet in Tang Dynasty , Learn More>> 6. The College of International Education Editor Notes: The College of International Education of SWUFE was established in 2004. ​ It is the combination of the former Foreign Students Education Center and the SWUFE Training Center for Personnel Working/Studying Abroad. There are above 20 full and part time professors and teachers, many of whom have experience teaching in foreign countries in Asia, Europe, America and Africa. The highly-qualified faculty is among the top in western China. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Recreational Activities Internship

fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

Applicants shall be physically and mentally healthy and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China and the regulations of Wuhan University. 2. Applicants shall be between 18 and 25 years of age as of Sep. 1, 2025. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit a guarantee letter from their guardians in China when applying. 3. Applicants born in a foreign country are required to meet the above criteria and provide a personal birth certificate and the parents' nationality certificates.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements 1)Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 30 by September 1st, 2026, be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit Guarantee Statement 2)Applicants should be a graduating senior high school student or hold a senior high school diploma with a satisfactory academic record. 2. Requirements about Nationalities 1)Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 2)In accordance with Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, a person whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad, shall not have Chinese citizenship if he/she was born outside China and has acquired foreign citizenship at birth. Starting in 2021, if such a person applies for the undergraduate’s program at XMU as an international student, in addition to meeting the University’s all other application requirements, he/she is required to have held a valid foreign passport or a proof of lawful acquisition of foreign citizenship for at least 4 years and have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2026) (9 months of residence in a foreign country counts as a full year). The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence. This requirement is also applicable to residents of the Chinese Mainland, Taiwan, Hong Kong or Macao who have emigrated to a foreign country and obtained foreign citizenship and are applying for the undergraduate programs at XMU as international students. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 OR the English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from the high school where English is the primary language of instruction. OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement. 4. China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report. Note: The test language should be consistent with the program's medium of instruction

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements General Requirements Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China,have no criminal record, and be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid regular foreign passport;. Applicants must possess a high school diploma or above. Language Proficiency Requirements English-taught Programs Applicants whose native language is English are exempt from providing English language proficiency certificates. Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of English language proficiency with the results of IELTS(6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 points or above,SDU's DI code: C296), MyBest Scores (80 points or above), Essentials test (8 points or above), orother equivalent English language proficiency certificates. Applicants whose native language is not English but have received their highest level of education taught in English are exempt from providing IELTS/TOEFL certificates and other proof of English proficiency, but must submit proof of the language of instruction. Applicants must meet the criteria specified in the Notice by the Ministry of Education of Regulating Admission of International Students to China's Higher Education Institutions(Letter No. 12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education). Note: The exit and entry administration authority of the Chinese public security organ will determine whether the applicant has Chinese nationality in addition to foreign nationality based on the results of the nationality determination. If it is determined that the applicant holds Chinese nationality after application, admission, or enrollment, the application, admission, or study qualification will be annulled. CSCA Test Subjects download here .

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China. Applicants should generally be between the ages of 18 and 25 (calculated from September 1, 2007), in good physical and mental health. They must have a full-time high school diploma or higher education, with excellent academic performance and character. Applicants should be friendly toward China, with no criminal record. 2. According to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, if both parents or one parent is a Chinese citizen who has settled abroad, and the applicant holds foreign nationality at birth, the applicant does not have Chinese nationality. As an international student applicant, they must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate before April 30, 2021, and have a record of residing abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2021, and April 30, 2025 (nine months of actual residence abroad in one year can be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). 3. According to the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, for residents of mainland China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macau Special Administrative Region, and Taiwan who have immigrated and obtained foreign nationality, as international student applicants, they must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate before April 30, 2021, and provide proof of renunciation of Chinese nationality. Additionally, they must have a record of residing abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2021, and April 30, 2025 (nine months of actual residence abroad in one year can be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). Note: Whether the applicant holds both foreign nationality and Chinese nationality will be determined by the nationality recognition conclusion from the exit and entry management department of the Chinese public security authority. If the applicant possesses Chinese nationality during the application, admission process, or after enrollment, the applicant’s qualifications for application, admission, enrollment, or student status will be revoked.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizen in good health, hold personal passport. (4) Students outside China should be able to have online communication facilities, such as laptop, stableinternet connection, etc. to carry out the interview and necessary communication for application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Research Proposal and Study Plan Written in English or Chinese, including Research Objectives, Methodology, Research Achievements thus fare.g. title and abstracts of graduation thesis or published paper, list of projects), Understanding of China,Reasons for choosing SHOU, Study Objectives, Academic Goals, Future Research and Career Plan during the program. SHOU supervisor's e-signature is needed on the research proposal for application submission. Applicants are required to write the research proposal after discussion with the potential superrisor at SHOU. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. 1-inch electronic personal photo. JPG format. * 3. Passport Copy A clearly visible copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their own country of residence. The passport validity period must be after March 1st, 2027. The passport can not be changed after the submission of the application until enrollment. * 4. Non-Criminal Record Notarized Chinese or English translation is required for non-Chinese and English versions. * 5. English proficiency test certificate * 6. Certificate of bachelor degree Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 7. Academic Transcripts of bachelor degree Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Two Recommendation Letters Written in English or Chinese by 2 different scholars who hold the title of associate professor or higher in a related academic field. One recommender should be applicant's previous supervisor. The issue date of the recommendation letter should be later than September 1st, 2024. Recommendation letter should include the title, place of work, contact phone number, email address and written signature. * 9. Statement of Financial Support The statement should be completed by the applicant and his/her sponsor, then be signed, scanned and uploaded online as one of the application documents. Resume Written in English or Chinese, including your personal information, educational background, work or intern experience, achievements so far and other information that might be useful. * 11. Foreigner Physical Examination certificate (Valid in 6 months) Applicants should strictly follow the requirements of the Physical Examination Record For Foreigner and provide a detailed report of blood examination. Incomplete records, those without the signature of the doctor, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Personal Statement An essay statement written in English or Chinese on one page of A4 size paper. Introduce your motivation of application: describe your interest and enthusiasm for your chosen major, and how your previous studies or experiences related to it. Describe what makes you suitable, such as relevant skills, experience, or achievements gained from previous education, work, and other activities. * 14. Applicants need to first contact the supervisor of SHOU and get the supervisor's approval. It is a mandatory subject for all applicants regardless of their chosen major. (3) Test Language Both Mathematics and Chinese offer examination papers in Chinese and English. Following students should meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC: (1) Students who emigrate from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality; (2) Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 3. Applicants of English-taught programs from non-English native speaking countries should have IELTS (6.0 or above) / TOFEL (85 or above) / Cambridge English (B2 or above) certificate. 4. Applicants should have China Scholastic Competency Assessment test result (CSCA) test result. Required test subjects vary by program. Please refer to the program catalog for details, download here . 5. Applicants under the age of 18 must provide a guardian's certificate. If applicant's parents are not within the territory of China, they need to appoint a foreigner or a Chinese resident within China as their guardian.

fields.description: Program Description The Chinese Language Course Summer Program of the School of International Culture, South China Normal University, has been successfully held for twenty years. It is dedicated to providing a diverse platform for overseas students and friends to learn Chinese and experience China. With its long history of running the program, rich experience in organizing classes, high-quality teaching system, and extensive and in-depth cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries, it has attracted more and more international friends. Every year, over 300 participants from more than 30 countries take part in it, and it has trained thousands of enthusiasts of Chinese culture. To meet the learning needs of Chinese culture enthusiasts at home and abroad, the school will hold a four-week Chinese Language Course Summer Program in Guangzhou, China from July 14th to August 8th, 2025. We sincerely welcome overseas students and friends to join this immersive Chinese language learning journey! Study Period July 6-July 31 (4 weeks) Levels offered Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced Course Scheme Schedule：(This is for reference only. Detailed arrangement will be notified upon the commencement of the camp.) Morning classes：9：00-11：20 Afternoon classes：13：30-15：00 Chinese Language Courses: Focus on enhancing students' daily communication skills. Levels offered: ‌Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced‌. Students must take a ‌Chinese proficiency test‌ to determine class placement (Minimum class size: 10 students). Cultural Courses: Help students explore traditional Chinese culture through diverse and engaging formats, such as: Chinese intangible cultural heritage (e.g., Paper-cutting, Rubbing), Chinese calligraphy and painting, Chinese cuisine. Field Trips: The school organizes ‌one group city tour‌ in Guangzhou. Students will experience Guangzhou’s millennia-old cultural heritage under teacher guidance and discover the vibrant charm of Lingnan Culture.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Basic Qualification: (1)Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. (2)High school graduate or above, with eligibility for university application. (3)Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. 2.Nationality Qualification: ★This requirement applies only to applicants who were born to parent(s)with Chinese citizenship at the time of birth. According to the<nationality law="" of="" the="" people's="" republic="" china="">and the relevant provisions issued by the Ministry of Education of China: (1)For applicants who were born in a foreig ncountry and have acquired foreign citizenship at birth. The applicants' parent(Chinese-citizenside)must have had obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants' birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/HongKong/Macao/Taiwan)for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April30, 2026(calculated in cycles from May1 to April30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2)For applicants who have emigrated from China and have acquired foreign citizenship. The applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2022, and completed formalities for renouncing the Chinese citizenship. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan)for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026(calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exits tamps). 3.Original or notarized copy of following English language test result(only for applicants whose native language is not English), students from high school with major courses taught in English may be waivered of the English language test. 4. Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment（CSCA）This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Council on behalf of the Ministry of Education of China. Students must take the assessment in advanceand get the score report. Students may check the time and content of the assessment on the official website(www.csca.cn) in early October 2025. Mandatory Assessment Subject : Maths(conducted in English). Note: For Phase 1 application, we accept the CSCA assessment result from December 2025, while for Phase 2 application, we accept the CSCA assessment result from both December 2025 and January 2026.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The length of the program is 1 semester up to 3 years. There are two semesters in each year. It is about 4 months for each semester. The class hours are 20 for one week (one class hour equals 45 minutes). 2. Course Arrangement Editor Notes: There are basic Chinese language courses and elective course in this program. Comprehensive Chinese language courses (including grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension and oral training). The level of difficulty ranges from beginner level, elementary level, intermediate level and advanced level. Level Textbook Present level of Chinese Learning objectives Language competency Vocabulary Contents of courses Objectives One Easy Learning Chinese basic course book one、two and three None Zero Can recognize Pinyin and write simple Chinese character; can greet with simple words and speak Chinese in classroom settings; can talk about food, hobbies, weather. HSK 2-3 Two Easy Learning Chinese basic course book two、three and four Have Learned Chinese for more than 80 hours, can recognize Pinyin and simple Chinese characters; can make easy conversations. Around 300 Can grasp the knowledge about notification, congratulations, apologize and demand; can make comparative sentences; can cope with simple life and school communication scenarios. HSK 3 Three Easy Learning Chinese basic course book three and four; intermediate course book one Have Learned Chinese for more than 160 hours, can recognize textbook without Pinyin, and can express their own idea. Around 500 On the basis of knowing language, discuss the hot topics related to Chinese culture such as health care, pets, leftover single men and women, environmental protection, the ability to communicate and solve practical problems in Chinese. HSK 3-4 Four Easy Learning Chinese basic course book four, intermediate course book one and two Have learned Chinese for more than 260 hours, can understand daily life expressions and express own ideas or thoughts in paragraphs. Around 1000 Grasp the meaning and usage of idioms, related words, colloquial words and usage in the text, understand the cultural differences of various countries, Chinese regional cultural differences, travel, food, love, fashion and Dressing(clothes matching), family, medical treatment, the concept of friendship and Internet education.。 HSK 4 Five Easy Learning Chinese intermediate course book one, two and three Have learned Chinese for more than 320 hours, Can communicate fluently in Chinese, and read general essays and express your views and ideas systematically. Around 1600 Use the learned vocabulary and language points to express sentences, retell texts, make keynote speeches or debates, etc. learn to read news or articles; learn to express your opinions in writing, learn cultural knowledge and phenomena that appear in the text, such as Qingming Festival, the way of health preservation, table manners, bow headed clan(people)", Long-distance love, Globalization, etc. HSK 4-5 six Easy Learning Chinese intermediate course book two, three and four Learn Chinese for more than 400hours, you will be able to talk about a wide range of topics in Chinese, be able to to read common Chinese newspapers and magazines and also be able to enjoy simple Chinese movies and TV programs. Around 2500 Learn and understand Chinese cultural knowledge and current hot topics related to the content of the textbooks, for example; The Chinese dream, World citizens, China's double 11, Shanghai Disneyland, etc. and express your views through situational dialogues, speeches, debates, etc. HSK 5 Seven TALKING ABOUT CHINESE CULTURE Book I AND II Have learned Chinese for more than 560 hours, can use vocabulary freely, can read basic newspapers and magazines Around 3200 Introduce and analyze Chinese culture, discuss cross-cultural topics with students through debates and speeches, for example: Gift-giving culture, The concept of Marriage, Family, Hierarchy, borrowing money, etc. HSK 5-6 3. The University ,Shanghai International Studies University, abbreviated as SISU, as one of the key universities of the national project "211", is jointly administered by China's Ministry of Education and Shanghai Municipal Government. Founded in 1949, SISU was one of the first key universities engaged in both foreign language teaching and cultural exchanges with foreign countries since the establishment of the PRC , Learn More>> 6. Language Proficiency Requirements: Non-native English speakers must provide proof of English proficiency through an IELTS Academic test (with an overall score no less than 6.0 and no individual band score below 5.0), TOEFL iBT (with an overall score no less than 70 and no individual section score below 15 ), or an equivalent standardized English test. A score not lower than 70 points (on a 100-point scale) in the entrance interview (conducted remotely or on campus). 6. CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.

(1) According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, individuals who were born abroad and acquired foreign nationality at birth, with one or both parents being Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, do not hold Chinese nationality. Since 2021, such applicants applying as international students for undergraduate studies must, in addition to meeting other admission requirements, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four (4) years, and must have resided abroad for at least two (2) years within the most recent four years (up to April 30 of the year of enrollment). Residence abroad of 9 months within a year may be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps. (2) Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan who have emigrated and acquired foreign nationality and apply as international students must also meet the requirements stated in (1). For details, please refer to the Ministry of Education document Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Higher Education Institutions (Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12) 2.Applicants must have completed high school or possess an equivalent academic qualification, with academic performance (including Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) meeting admission requirements. Applicants with excellent results in the university’s foundation program will be given priority. 3.Applicants must be in good physical health and meet the specific admission requirements of the applied major: No severe myopia, color blindness, or color weakness; Normal hearing, sense of smell, and speech ability; Applicants with infectious diseases (such as hepatitis B, HIV, syphilis, tuberculosis), serious chronic illnesses, or other conditions that may affect completion of studies may apply only after full recovery; Applicants with mental or psychological disorders are not recommended to apply. Applicants found unfit for study during the entrance medical examination will have their admission cancelled. Health requirements are implemented in accordance with the Guiding Opinions on Physical Examination for Enrollment in Ordinary Higher Education Institutions (Teaching [2003] No. 3) and relevant supplementary regulations: 4.Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of China and the rules of Wenzhou Medical University. *Note: The Dental Surgery (BDS) program does not accept left-handed applicants. 5.CSCA (Undergraduate Academic Proficiency Test for Studying in China) transcript, with test subjects including English Mathematics and English Chemistry 6.Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or other recognized tests: IELTS ≥ 6.0 with no band below 5.0; TOEFL ≥ 70 with no section below 15; Duolingo ≥ 105), or Proof of full high-school education conducted in English.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction This program is designed for international students aspiring to learn Chinese and enhance practical language proficiency. Courses are divided into three tiers—Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced—with teaching methods and content flexibly adjusted according to students' actual Chinese proficiency. 1.1 Time The program offers full-time study for one semester or one academic year. -Autumn Semester: September 2025 – January 2026 -Spring Semester: March 2026 – July 2026 (Subject to final admission notice) 1.2 Location Huangpu Campus, Guangzhou Maritime University 1.3 Weekly Schedule 20 class hours per week, for 16 weeks per semester. 1.4 Tiered Teaching Tiered classes: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. 1.5 Certification Upon completion of all courses with passing grades, students receive a Completion Certificate. Notes: ① Classes require ≥10 enrollees; undersubscribed classes will be merged or canceled. ② Placement test in Week 1; no class changes permitted after Week 2. 2. Core Curriculum Chinese Listening | Chinese Speaking | Chinese Reading | Comprehensive Chinese | Survey of China | HSK Test Preparation | Maritime Culture Practicum | Chinese New Year Woodblock Prints, etc.

fields.description: Program Description Training objectives: Students acquire knowledge regarding architectural design, urban planning, urban design, interior design, architectural engineering design through systematic learning, accept basic training on architectural design, and have basic competence in project planning, building scheme design and construction drawings. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Bank Statement -An official bank statement, issued and stamped by the bank, showing your financial guarantor’s account balance and ability to support your studies in China. -The account holder must be your financial guarantor, such as a parent. -The balance should cover at least one year’s tuition, accommodation, and living expenses. -Submit a scanned copy or a clear photo (a printed version with bank stamp is preferred). -Please also provide a copy of the financial guarantor’s passport or national ID card. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 8. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be 1-2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Including: 1. Self-introduction: Name, nationality and passport number, educational background, application level and Chinese proficiency(The level of one's Chinese proficiency is not taken into account as an admission criterion.). 2. Understanding of China and the university 3. Why study in China. 4. Willingness to abide by school discipline ?. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants (at least 18 years old; under 25 years old in principle) must be non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health and holding valid foreign passports in accordance with Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. 2. If both or one of the parents are Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, and the individual possesses foreign nationality at birth, they do not possess Chinese nationality. As a foreign student applicant, they shall meet the provisions of the Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating Work Related to the Acceptance of Foreign Students by Domestic Colleges and Universities (JWH [2020] No. 12). 3. Applicants must have a high school degree in minimum with good academic records. 4. Language proficiency requirements: Majors taught in English ①Applicants who are native speakers of English are exempt from English proficiency certificates. ②Applicants who are not native speakers of English must provide a TOEFL certificate (scored 80 or above), or IELTS certificate (scored 6.0 or above), or other certificates demonstrating an equivalent level of English proficiency; ③Applicants who are not native speakers of English but acquired their highest degree through a program taught in English can provide, instead of an IELTS/TOEFL certificate, a certificate demonstrating the program was taught in English. 5. CSCA certificate For Liberal Arts programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering the Mathematics subject) is required. For Science/Engineering programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering Mathematics and Physics) is required. For Medical programs (English-taught), a CSCA score report (covering Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry) is required.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 2. Non-Criminal Record Certificate Applicants should provide a Non-Criminal Record Certificate issued by the local public security authority, which should be no more than six months before the date of application. * 3. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Applicants need to provide documents demonstrating their funding sources (or financial guarantee by the guardian). Proof of financial capability can be one of the following documents, including family bank deposit certificate and parents/guardian's income certificate, with a recommended amount of no less than 5,000 US dollars. All uploaded certificates and documents must be original or notarized copies in Chinese or English. Applicants applying for full scholarships are exempt from such documents. * 5. Personal Statement A personal statement should include such content as self-introduction, reasons for application, understanding of the major, and study plan. * 6. Scanned Signature * 7. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. High school academic transcripts (sealed by the school). Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 10. A photocopy of the first page of the passport (at least six months before expiration from the date of application). Applicants currently living in Chinese mainland need to provide a photocopy of valid visa page or residence permit. * 11. High school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate (sealed by the school). Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and all be certified by notarization. Applicants applying with a pre-graduation certificate must denote the graduation date. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
