fields.description: Program Description Program Overview With a history of over 30 years, the Chinese Language Program of Sichuan University has enrolled thousands of students from over 80 countries across the globe, earning itself a good reputation and fruitful achievements. In addition to the main courses - integrated Chinese language courses (6-12 class hours per week), the Program provides highly targeted and practical courses for specific language skills (about 10 class hours per week), including Chinese speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Besides, there are specialized Chinese language courses for students at intermediate and advanced levels, including Chinese grammar, vocabulary, phonetics, rhetoric, and ancient Chinese. The Program is committed to helping students grasp the right methods to learn Chinese and enhancing their systemic understanding of the Chinese language. Meanwhile, learning Chinese is not only about the language itself but requires students to have an in-depth understanding of China's national conditions, history, Chinese language culture, Sichuan local culture, etc. Therefore, as students' language competence continues to improve, the Program will also offer a wide range of over 30 general education courses and elective courses, such as Overview of China, Chinese Culture, Business Chinese, Ancient, Modern, and Contemporary Chinese Literature, Chinese Economy, Chinese History, Ancient Chinese Philosophy, Chinese Minority Art, Chinese Idioms and Proverbs, Chinese Character Knowledge and Culture, Bashu Culture, Sichuan Dialect, Chinese Painting and Calligraphy, Tai Chi, and Martial Arts, which are available for students based on their interests. Through rich courses and intensive training, the students will be able to rapidly improve their Chinese proficiency within a short period and further deepen their insight into the knowledge of the Chinese language as well as the culture and national conditions of China. The Program is divided into eight stages in three levels (elementary, intermediate, and advanced), fully meeting the learning needs of students at different levels. Chinese-level exams will be arranged at the beginning of each semester. Students' personal desire, learning purpose, and learning requirements will be given due consideration. Course Overview This Program consists of main and elective courses. The main courses are mainly delivered in the mornings, with about 20 class hours per week. The elective courses are mainly arranged in the afternoons. Students can choose elective courses independently based on their levels and interests. Class classification and course arrangements are explained as follows: 1. Elementary class (Elementary 1 / Elementary 2) Main courses: 9 courses, such as Elementary Integrated Chinese, Reading and Writing of Chinese Characters, and Chinese Listening and Speaking; General education courses: 2 courses: Tai Chi and Martial Arts. After a systematic study of such program courses, elementary students will be fluent in basic daily communication in Chinese and be able to read and write some Chinese. After completing such program courses, students attending Elementary 2 can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 3. 2. Intermediate class (Intermediate 1 / Intermediate 2) Main courses: 8 courses, such as Intermediate Integrated Chinese, Chinese Listening and Speaking, Basic Chinese Writing, and Chinese Reading; General education courses: 5 courses, such as Computer and Network Applications in Chinese, Chinese Culture, and Overview of China; Elective courses: 10 courses, such as Chinese Idioms and Proverbs, Chinese Character Knowledge and Culture, Chinese Minority Art, Bashu Culture, Sichuan Dialect, Cross-cultural Psychological Adaptation, News Listening and Reading, Chinese Painting and Calligraphy, and HSK Level 5 Lectures. After a systematic study of such program courses, intermediate students will be fluent in communication in Chinese and proficient in reading and writing Chinese. Students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 4 or 5. 3. Advanced class (Advanced 1 / Advanced 2 / Advanced 3 / Advanced 4) Main courses: 12 courses, such as Advanced Integrated Chinese, Advanced Spoken Chinese, Modern Chinese Vocabulary, and Modern Chinese Pronunciation; General education courses: 2 courses: Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Listening and Speaking, and Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Reading and Writing; Elective courses: 20 courses, such as Advanced Reading, Advanced Audio-visual, Ancient Chinese Literature, Contemporary Chinese Literature, Modern Chinese Literature and Society, Ancient Chinese History, Modern and Contemporary Chinese History, Business Chinese, Contemporary Chinese Economy, and Topics in Contemporary China. After a systematic study of such program courses, advanced students will be able to communicate fluently in Chinese on all kinds of topics, with professional reading and writing skills. Meanwhile, such students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 5 or 6. To make students better communicate with native Chinese people in Chinese, understand the real, lively, and diverse Chinese society at present, and fit well into local life, a series of language practice courses have been introduced for intermediate and advanced students, and teachers may lead students to visit communities, educational institutions and cultural venues, to have a face-to-face exchange with different Chinese residents so that students can introduce their countries to Chinese people while learning about Chinese society and culture. Evaluation, Credit, Grade, and Certificate Evaluation of the Program: final examination grade (50%) and whole-process assessment (50%). Students of the Program must meet the attendance requirements. Those absent for over one-third of the courses will be ineligible for the course assessment examinations. Those passing the course assessment examinations will get credits for corresponding courses and be granted by Sichuan University the course transcript and study certificate.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. University Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.doc). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write “None” if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. -The form must be handwritten or digitally signed. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Passport-sized photo A 2 inches photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Non-criminal record (Valid within six months) -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical examination letter(Valid within six months) -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s recommendation, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. At the time of application, applicants must hold a valid foreign passport or other valid proof of foreign nationality (Please see: Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027). 2 Applicants should be in good physical and mental health, demonstrate goodwill toward China, and hold a valid high school graduation certificate. The high school educational qualification must have been obtained through full-time, in-person education. 3 Academic performance Outstanding academic performance. Proof should be provided by (but not limited to) the following document(s): High school/University (if applicable) transcripts (in Chinese or English). Certificate of National/Regional Graduation Examination/Matriculation Examination (e.g. ATAR/ Abitur/ BAC/ CSAT/ UEC/ STPM/ others). Results of international standardized tests (e.g. CSCA/SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB/others). Award Certificate(s) from international- or national-level Olympiads in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, informatics, etc. (if applicable). Other Supporting Materials. 3 Language proficiency Applicants must have a high level of English language proficiency. For those with a native language other than English, a test report of English language proficiency will need to be provided (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/others). 4 Aged 18 or above (by September 1, 2027). Applicants under 18 must present Guarantee Statement of Guardian in China and relevant supporting documents at the time of registration. 5 Applicants must meet the requirements outlined in Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China, as well as Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027. Applicants who do not meet the above requirements or fail to submit all required materials to the application system in accordance with the Submission Requirements for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027, will be deemed ineligible to apply. Note: All divisions and colleges of Tsinghua University require students to have a strong foundation in mathematics and English; Other High School Subject Required: Physics

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements 1)Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 30 by September 1st, 2026, be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit Guarantee Statement 2)Applicants should be a graduating senior high school student or hold a senior high school diploma with a satisfactory academic record. 2. Requirements about Nationalities 1)Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 2)In accordance with Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, a person whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad, shall not have Chinese citizenship if he/she was born outside China and has acquired foreign citizenship at birth. Starting in 2021, if such a person applies for the undergraduate’s program at XMU as an international student, in addition to meeting the University’s all other application requirements, he/she is required to have held a valid foreign passport or a proof of lawful acquisition of foreign citizenship for at least 4 years and have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2026) (9 months of residence in a foreign country counts as a full year). The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence. This requirement is also applicable to residents of the Chinese Mainland, Taiwan, Hong Kong or Macao who have emigrated to a foreign country and obtained foreign citizenship and are applying for the undergraduate programs at XMU as international students. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 OR the English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from the high school where English is the primary language of instruction. OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement. 4. China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report. Note: The test language should be consistent with the program's medium of instruction

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary private passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2023, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, the Chinese-citizen parent must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 2. General Requirements 2.1 In principle, between 18 and 25 years of age. Applicants must graduate from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, be friendly toward China, and have no record of violations of law or criminal offenses. 2.3 Applicants must provide qualifying Language Proficiency Certificate, a China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report: Mathematics, Chemistry. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.0 overall or above (academic module) with a minimum of 5.0 in each component. TOEFL-iBT: 75 or above with a minimum of 15 in Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing. Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE): 170 or above Duolingo: 100 or above. Submission of IB, A-level or other international standardized test score reports, or a full high-school English-medium instruction certificate for applicants with full English-taught high school education, can exempt the applicant from providing an English proficiency certificate. Other requirements:: Applicants must have scored 70% or above in Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Zoology & Botany) during high school. 4. Offered at the International Schoolof Medicine (located in YiwuCity).

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Comprehensive Requirements In principle, applicants for undergraduate programs should be under 25 years old. The applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, who is physically and mentally healthy and has good conduct. With a valid foreign passport, they should have completed the study of the previous stage (those who have not graduated while applying must provide the pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before the registration). 2.Nationality Requirements Foreign students should meet the nationality requirements stipulated in the document No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education.Since 2021, any applicant who applies to study in undergraduate or college diploma programs in China's higher education institutions as an international student shall, in addition to meeting other eligibility criteria of the institutions, have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years (inclusive) and have a record of actual residence abroad for two years or more in the past four years (by April 30 of the admission year). Nine consecutive months of residence abroad in a year may be considered as one year, and the calculation is based on entry and exit stamps. 3.Language Requirements English-taught Degree Programs: Applicants (except for English native speakers) must provide proof of English language proficiency such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO Proof or proof of previous study conducted in English. Undergraduate applicants should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 90.Applicants for master’s and doctoral programs should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 100. 4.Academic Proficiency Test for International Undergraduate Programs in China (CSCA) In accordance with the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs must provide valid CSCA transcripts, download here . For the examination subjects and test paper languages corresponding to each major, please refer to the directory of admitted majors. As a mandatory part of the application, no minimum score has been set at this time.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. High School Graduation Certificate If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. High School Academic Transcripts If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Passport -Photocopy of poassport identfcation page (Passports must have a validity of at least 6 months from the date of submission of the application). * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Photocopy of high school or obove graduation diploma -Photocopy of high school or obove graduation diploma in Chinese or English. If the document is in a language other than Chinese or English, a translation and notarization is required. * 4. Photocopy of high school or obove academic transcripts -Photocopy of high school or obove academic transcripts in Chinese or English. If the document is in a language other than Chinese or English, a translation and notarization is required. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -Some universities may require a certificate covering only the past 3 months, in which case the certificate is valid for 3 months only. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants shall be aged between 18 and 30 years old, non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders, healthy and well-behaved, with an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma, without any criminal records. Applicants should abide by the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and related rules of university, honor the Chinese social morality and customs, and will not participate in any activities which are inappropriate to the capacity as a student. 2. For non-native English speakers who apply for English-taught programs, they should provide a score report of English Language Test (TOEFL 80+/IELTS 5.5+). The certificate must be in valid period. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test reports, they will be required to participate in an English test organized by IEC. 3. According to the Document No. 12〔2020〕of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China (see Appendix 1), If the applicant's parents or one of the parents are Chinese or the applicant has emigrated from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality for, they must be naturalized for 4 years or more and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during the past 4 years (Actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps). ---- Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship and become foreign citizens should provide: (1) Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship; (2) Documents certifying the acquirement of foreign citizenship; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. ---- Applicants who have acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen should provide: (1) Documents certifying acquiring foreign citizenship at the time of birth; (2) Documents certifying parent's (with Chinese citizenship) permanent residence in foreign country before the birth of the applicant; (3) Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required.

fields.description: Program Description The Chinese Language Program offered by the International Department aims to provide international students with a systematic and comprehensive Chinese learning experience, dedicated to cultivating international talents who understand and are friendly towards China. Based on solidifying listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Chinese, the curriculum organically integrates rich content on China's national conditions and culture. Our experienced teaching team will guide you in deeply exploring contemporary Chinese society, its developmental vitality, and historical context through language learning. By combining classroom teaching with social practice, you will gain the ability to use Chinese in real-life environments, understand China, enhance your language skills, and form a more comprehensive and profound understanding of the country.

Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. --Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or EF SET. -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. Guardian's Letters for Students Under 18 -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in Hangzhou -Need Chinese guardian living in Hangzhou to sign two guardian documents (download from attachments) one is consent letter signed by parents, another is commitment letter from guardian and provide scan copies of them. -Aso the university will call the guardian to verify. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. International Student Health Report Download from attachment, fill in information, print it, sign it and send us scan copy of it. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. Documents for Students Who Ever Study in China If you ever study in China you also need to provide the following 5 documents issued by your previous school: 1: A statement of Daily performance 2: Original official transcript 3: Attendance rate certificate 4: Enrollment certificate 5: Completion certificate Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. fields.description: Program Description I. Academic Highlights This interdisciplinary dual-degree program brings together ECUST's internationally recognized strengths in Artificial Intelligence and Finance. Students learn from a distinguished faculty of AI and finance scholars, many of whom lead cutting-edge research in machine learning, financial data science, algorithmic systems, and smart decision-making. The School of Information Science and Technology and the School of Business jointly offer a research-rich environment, supported by state-of-the-art labs—including a National Engineering Laboratory for Big Data and dedicated Research Centers in Financial Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Smart Energy. Designed for the intelligent economy, the program equips students with dual literacy in AI technologies and financial markets. Graduates are prepared to tackle complex, real-world problems at their intersection — from automated trading and risk analytics to AI-driven investment platforms. Leveraging Shanghai's position as a global financial and tech hub, the program emphasizes hands-on, industry-connected learning and a global outlook. All core instruction is delivered in English, with opportunities for international exchange and collaboration. This is not merely a fusion of two disciplines, but a launchpad for future leaders in AI finance, quantitative innovation, and fintech worldwide. II. Educational Objectives This interdisciplinary program aims to cultivate versatile graduates who bridge artificial intelligence and finance. Students will develop strong quantitative and analytical foundations, enabling them to design AI-driven financial solutions, analyze complex market behaviors, and innovate at the intersection of technology and finance. Within five years of graduation, students are expected to: Solve real-world problems at the AI-finance nexus—such as algorithmic trading, risk modeling, fraud detection, and smart investment systems—using state-of-the-art machine learning and financial engineering methods. Work across disciplines collaboratively, leading or contributing to projects that require both computational thinking and financial logic, in multinational corporations, fintech firms, investment banks, or regulatory bodies. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, bridging the gap between AI developers and financial decision-makers in a global context. Act with ethical and professional responsibility, understanding the societal, legal, and economic implications of AI in financial markets, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy. Adapt to rapid change through lifelong learning, staying current with advances in AI, blockchain, quantitative finance, and digital assets, and seizing leadership opportunities in an evolving industry landscape. Graduates are well-prepared for global careers in quantitative analysis, fintech product development, AI-driven trading, financial data science, and technology management, or for pursuing advanced degrees in finance, AI, or related fields. III.Core Courses Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Algorithm, Discrete Mathematics, Algorithm and Data Structures, Database Principles, Software Engineering, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Micro-Economics, Macroeconomics, Financial Market, International Finance, Corporate Finance. University Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.doc). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Passport-sized photo A 2 inches photo taken recently of the applicant. * 3. Passport homepage (valid until December 31, 2026) * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. 14. Works(including self-introduction in English and Chinese, as well as a video demonstrating professional competence) Applicants to arts majors (including all majors of CUZ Huace School of Film) must also submit. * 15. Study plan in China Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description Program Overview This is a non-degree Chinese language program open to international students worldwide who are passionate about the Chinese language and wish to gain a deeper understanding of Chinese culture and the development of Chinese-style modernization. Students are placed in classes based on their proficiency levels, enabling them to systematically improve their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in a short period of time. Through extracurricular activities such as cultural immersion experiences and visits to companies in the Greater Bay Area, students will also have the opportunity to experience the unique charm of Chinese culture.

fields.description: Program Description I. Course Overview 1. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. BIFT divides students into three levels based on their Chinese proficiency: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced, with each level of different classes. 2. Objectives: Beginner Class focuses on basic Chinese knowledge training. Intermediate Class improves reading skills and develops writing skills while consolidating basic Chinese knowledge. Advanced Class guides students to understand Chinese culture more comprehensively and accurately and integrate into Chinese society while further consolidating and improving listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. 3. Duration: One semester/One year 4. Curriculum: A combination of listening and speaking courses and comprehensive courses will be used to teach the Chinese language systematically. At the same time, Chinese culture study tours or extracurricular language practice activities will be arranged on irregular basis. II. Class Duration According to students' number, each semester has 16 to 20 weeks and each week has 12 to 20 class hours. Customized courses regarding study tour and exchange projects are set up according to actual needs.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write "None" if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 7. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate(or pre-graduation certificate if you haven’t graduated yet) of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 8. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Aged between 18-50 with good health and hold a senior high school graduation diploma at least, and passing the professional basic examination and oral Chinese interview. 2.Language Requirements: Applicants who choose the English-taught courses are required to fulfill one of the following criteria: TOEFL (PBT) 550 / TOEFL (iBT) 80 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent. Applicants from English speaking countries or last degree courses was taught in English are exempted from the above language requirements. Applicants from the partner institutions are exempted from the above language requirements with the letter of proof which equivalent to CEFR B2. 3.CSCA requirements: The test includes two subjects: Professional Chinese and Mathematics. (1) Professional Chinese The Professional Chinese examination offers two tracks: Liberal Arts Chinese and Science Chinese. Applicants for undergraduate programs taught in Chinese at our university are required to select Liberal Arts Chinese. 1. Applicants seeking undergraduate education taught entirely in English are not required to take the specialized Chinese proficiency test; 2. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write "None" if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 7. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate(or pre-graduation certificate if you haven’t graduated yet) of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 8. Bank Statement -An official bank statement, issued and stamped by the bank, showing your financial guarantor’s account balance and ability to support your studies in China. -The account holder must be your financial guarantor, such as a parent. -The balance should cover at least one year’s tuition, accommodation, and living expenses. -Submit a scanned copy or a clear photo (a printed version with bank stamp is preferred). -Please also provide a copy of the financial guarantor’s passport or national ID card. -The document must be in English or Chinese. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description PROGRAM PERIOD January 6 - 26, 2027 (3 Weeks) 9:00 AM – 11:45 AM (GMT+8) Monday to Friday Registration Dates: January 4 - 5 COURSE CONTENT ※ Chinese Classes: Classes focus on enhancing oral expression, combined with grammar explanation and thematic discussion. Multiple levels are offered, starting from beginner. You will be placed into the appropriate level based on your online placement test result. (Each class requires at least 8 students.) ※ Cultural Lectures / Activities: Cultural activities introduce China's customs and culture in diverse formats, such as the culture of Chinese characters, Chinese cuisine, Chinese calligraphy, Chinese traditional medicine culture, and making Chinese traditional handicrafts, etc. ※ Language Practice: You will complete tasks assigned by teachers in real-world settings—such as visiting shopping malls or parks—where you will communicate directly with local Chinese speakers. This hands-on approach efficiently improves your everyday communication skills. fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Shanghai University is a comprehensive University featured in China’s national Double First-Class Initiative and the 211 Project. With over six decades of experience educating international students, it offers a highly globalized campus environment, distinguished faculty, a full spectrum of academic disciplines, and a well-established support system for international learners. The Pre-University program is a non-degree undergraduate preparatory Program for International Students offered by the College of International Education of Shanghai University. This program boosts international students’ Chinese competence and builds solid foundations in science and engineering, Humanities, Economics & Management. It helps students meet Chinese University undergraduate admission standards and transition smoothly into Shanghai University’s undergraduate studies. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Status Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China, hold a valid passport or citizenship certificate from their own countries for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence outside of China for more than 2 years within the recent 4 years (before April 30 of the year prior to admission). Note that actual residence outside of China for 9 months or more in a year may be counted as 1 year, based on the dates of the entry and exit stamps on the passport. 2. General Application Requirements (1) Generally, applicants shall be aged 20 or below. (2) Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have good moral character and no record of bad behaviour, and abide by China's laws and regulations and the University's rules and regulations. (3) Applicants must have sufficient financial resources to support their studies and living in China. (4) Applicants must have completed their high school studies and been awarded a high school diploma or a higher qualification. Applicants must have chosen the science stream in their high school studies, which, besides Mathematics and English language, should comprise pure science subjects like Biology, Chemistry and Physics. The admission criteria are detailed below: (5) In general, the applicants should be graduating from high school in the current year of the intended university enrollment, with good academic and behaviour records at school. (6) For international students under the age of 18 whose parents are not ordinarily residing in China, the parents must formally appoint a foreigner or a Chinese citizen who is ordinarily residing in China as the guardian for the international student, and provide supporting documents.

fields.description: Program Description I. Programme Introduction The Chongqing Medical University Foundation Programme for International Students is designed for international students who intend to apply for undergraduate programmes at CQMU. The programme aims to improve their English and Chinese proficiency, strengthen their ability to study basic courses related to medicine, and help them prepare for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). This is a non-degree training programme for international students studying in China. II. Duration and Curriculum 1. Duration: One semester, starting in spring. The specific registration and class commencement dates shall be subject to the University's notice. 2. Teaching language: English. 3. Curriculum: The core components are English language courses and preparation courses for the CSCA (Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry). The curriculum also includes basic Chinese, adaptation to studying in China, and an introduction to China's national conditions.

Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is valid for only 3 months. For instance, if you submit your -application in April, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than January. -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -You need to translated it into CHINESE if it is not in Chinese; Then you need to get it notarized by local notary office and then get it certified by local Chinese embassy; If your country has joined the HAGUE convention then just do the Chinese translation and Apostille; Then you may need to mail original copy of non-criminal record and translation & certified(or Apostille) documents to the university in China. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. * 5. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. You can download a template or sample from here . 7. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction With remarkable expansion of the number of foreign students coming to the university, GDUT provides a wide range of Chinese language programs on various levels of learning and training. Students are expected to improve Chinese proficiency at the end of each program with a closer look into the tradition and custom, to communicate with native Chinese, and to obtain sufficient skills and knowledge in the areas of HSK Tests. In addition, special-designed course work tailored to the needs of certain students may also be provided and arranged. Teaching Objective To acquaint students with the essentials of Chinese language, including consonants, vowels, intonation, pronunciation, Chinese character writing, commonly used vocabulary and basic grammar. To develop student's ability in listening, speaking, writing and translating, and prepare students both linguistically and culturally for daily contact with Chinese people. To promote the ability to successfully pass the HSK Test. Courses and Candidates Class Candidates Compulsory Courses Elective Courses Elementary Chinese(1) for beginners Basic Chinese intensive reading; Chinese listening comprehension for beginners; basic Chinese reading; Chinese Characters; Basic oral Chinese, etc. Chinese Painting, Chinese Calligraphy, Chinese folk songs and music, Martial Arts, Chinese History and Geography, Survey of China, Computerized Information Processing, Cantonese, etc. Elementary Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 4-6 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 2; Intermediate Chinese(1) for students who have studied Chinese language for 10-12 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 3; Intermediate Chinese intensive reading, Intermediate Chinese extensive reading, Intermediate spoken Chinese, basic Chinese writing. Chinese grammar, etc. Intermediate Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 16-18 months, or as an equivalent to HSK Grade 4; Advanced Chinese(1) for students who have studied Chinese language for 2 years, or as an equivalent to the level of HSK Grade 5; Advanced Chinese (1) is equivalent to the level of the third academic year of a four year study. Advanced Chinese, Audio-Visual Chinese, Advanced Chinese extensive reading, Survey of China, An Introduction to Chinese culture, Business Chinese, etc. Advanced Chinese(2) for students who have studied Chinese language for 2 years, or as an equivalent to the level of HSK Grade 6; Advanced Chinese (1) is equivalent to the level of the fourth academic year of a four year study. Class Time Morning:8:30-12:00, Afternoon:13:30-16:30(Monday-Friday). Notes : 1) The long-term class students should attend a class-dividing test. We have examinations twice a semester, and the test result will decide which class you are in. 2) If students complete their lessons within the period of study, certificate will be granted. 3) Students have the right to choose the classes and courses according to their own interest and language levels. 4)Notes For students who applied within one month or after the starting date: -If you are a beginner, you may need to wait until the university gets enough students to open a beginner class(there will be uncertainties). -If you have learned Chinese before, you might be able to come to China and study with the current class directly. -If you want one-semester program only but are only able to come to China when there is a very short time left, you are advised to switch to 1 1-year program. If you insist on only want one-semester program and are ok with just learn for the remaining time, it is also ok.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary private passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2023, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, the Chinese-citizen parent must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 2. General Requirements 2.1 In principle, between 18 and 25 years of age. Applicants must graduate from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, be friendly toward China, and have no record of violations of law or criminal offenses. 2.3 Applicants must provide qualifying Language Proficiency Certificate, a China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report: Mathematics, Physics. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.0 or above with a minimum of 5.0 in each component. TOEFL: 75 or above with a minimum of 15 in Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing. Cambridge English: Advanced (CAE)170 or above Duolingo: 100 or above Other requirements: Satisfactory grades in Mathematics and Physics at high school level. Solid physics and mathematics knowledge is recommended. 4. Offered on Zijingang Campus.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal statement In Chinese or English, should include study experience, reasons for application, personal strengths. No less than 800 words. * 2. Commitments for Zhejiang University Undergraduate Application The PDF version of the Commitments must be clearly and completely filled out and hand-signed. Applications without the Commitments will not be accepted. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Two recommendation letters from high school teachers Teachers’ signature, contact phone number and email address must put on the letter. * 4. A photocopy of passportfront page. The expiry date of the passport should be after March 1, 2027. * 5. Passport photo White background, 35mm×45mm in size. * 6. Photocopies of language proficiency certificates. Applicants for English-instructed programs must provide the certificate of TOEFL or IELTS test score. (Not required for English native speakers) * 7. Transcript for all the courses in senior high school (original copy or notarized copy) Transcript for all the courses in senior high school (original copy or notarized copy in Chinese/English); * 8. Senior high school diploma (original copy or notarized copy) Senior high school diploma (original copy or notarized copy in Chinese/English); Graduating high school students can provide pre-graduation Certificate instead (in Chinese/English). 9. Award-winning Certificates related to academic courses during your senior high school period. (If any) * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
